source.name: Final Girl Wiki (fan wiki, finalgirl.fandom.com)
source.note: Community-maintained; verify against physical cards. Effect text is card rules text as transcribed by the wiki; official flavour/lore excluded; flavour_unofficial lines are original.
additional: dudetakeyourturn.ca reviews (Falconwood Files, Marrek Murders, Don't Make a Sound, Hell to Pay, North Pole Nightmare, Raptor Games)
redesigninsert.com collector checklist and box guide

conventions.ids: snake_case slugs, unique within their collection
conventions.effect_null: card exists but effect not transcribed on source
conventions.killer_action_syntax: Steps separated by ' > ' (e.g. Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack)
conventions.epic: true = Epic Finale / Epic Dark Power (optional harder variant)
conventions.minor_dark_powers: Drawn from the Terror deck; placed on killer board; bonus_health absorbs damage first
conventions.item_variant: Items reused across boxes can differ; 'variant' names the wiki variant applied to this location (null = single version)
conventions.setup_cards: Names only; setup cards are board-placement diagrams with no rules text
conventions.effect_source: wiki = transcribed card rules text from the fan wiki; review_paraphrase = paraphrased from published reviews (lower confidence, may be incomplete); null = no effect available
conventions.terror_cards: Each killer and location has its own terror_cards list (qty = copies); 10 are dealt from the combined pool each game. is_minor_dark_power marks Minor Dark Power cards
conventions.special_cards: Box-specific decks: deck = mission | friend | savior_card | side_effect | amped_card | harvest_madness | ancient_curse | action_card | crafted_item | supply_item | item_trap | terror_trap | mission_item | affliction | victim_death_trap
conventions.source_url: Best-effort link to the card's wiki page (built from the card name; a few disambiguated pages may differ). Use it to fetch flavour text at runtime if wanted
conventions.flavour_unofficial: Original atmospheric line written for this dataset, based on each card's name, function and setting. NOT the official card flavour text (excluded for copyright); official text can be read via source_url

boxes.title: The Happy Trails Horror
boxes.flavour_unofficial: Summer camp, a lake, a legend nobody believed. Pack light and run fast.

boxes.title: The Haunting of Creech Manor
boxes.flavour_unofficial: A grand old house with a little girl inside, and something older watching her.

boxes.title: Slaughter in the Groves
boxes.flavour_unofficial: Sacred ground, careless tourists and a god who keeps score.

boxes.title: Carnage at the Carnival
boxes.flavour_unofficial: Step right up: the rides are rusted, the clowns are smiling and the strings are tight.

boxes.title: Frightmare on Maple Lane
boxes.flavour_unofficial: Quiet street, nice lawns, and a doctor who only makes house calls in your dreams.

boxes.title: Terror from Above
boxes.flavour_unofficial: They gathered on the wires first. Then they stopped waiting.

boxes.title: Into the Void
boxes.flavour_unofficial: Deep space, a small crew and a stowaway that grows every time you look away.

boxes.title: Panic at Station 2891
boxes.flavour_unofficial: An ice station at the end of the world, and nobody is quite who they seem.

boxes.title: A Knock at the Door
boxes.flavour_unofficial: A cosy cottage weekend until the masks show up at the door.

boxes.title: Once Upon a Full Moon
boxes.flavour_unofficial: Grandma's house is just through the woods. Stay on the path. Don't look at its eyes.

boxes.title: Madness in the Dark
boxes.flavour_unofficial: The asylum never really closed. The staff just changed.

boxes.title: Terror from the Grave
boxes.flavour_unofficial: The dead got up and they did not come back friendly.

boxes.title: The Killer From Tomorrow
boxes.flavour_unofficial: A shopping mall, a machine from the future and one person it must not reach.

boxes.title: Hell to Pay
boxes.flavour_unofficial: Pain is a door, and someone has opened it.

boxes.title: The Falconwood Files
boxes.flavour_unofficial: A small town with a big secret and a second, darker version of itself.

boxes.title: The Marrek Murders
boxes.flavour_unofficial: Clock in, clock out, try not to get locked in.

boxes.title: Don't Make a Sound
boxes.flavour_unofficial: Out in the canyon, every footstep is a dinner bell.

boxes.title: Terror from Destiny
boxes.flavour_unofficial: Death has a plan, and it already has your name on it.

boxes.title: A Rotten Harvest
boxes.flavour_unofficial: The corn is high, the harvest is cursed and the scarecrow has moved.

boxes.title: A Demon in the Shadows
boxes.flavour_unofficial: The abbey bells ring for prayer. Something below them answers.

boxes.title: Bad Times at Buddyland
boxes.flavour_unofficial: The pizza is cold, the animatronics are warm, and the party never ends.

boxes.title: The Green Terror
boxes.flavour_unofficial: Jungle heat, soldiers of fortune and a hunter you can't see.

boxes.title: The Raptor Games
boxes.flavour_unofficial: A billion-dollar prize, an island of living fossils and only one winner.

boxes.title: Shriek
boxes.flavour_unofficial: A fan convention full of masks, and one of them is real.

boxes.title: The North Pole Nightmare
boxes.flavour_unofficial: Santa is out on deliveries. His brother has come to visit.

boxes.title: Terror from Beyond
boxes.notes: Series 4 Vignette (in the S4 Ultimate Box). Killer: invading plant pods that take over human subjects. No card data published yet.
boxes.flavour_unofficial: Something fell from the sky, and it's growing into people.

killers.name: Hans the Butcher

finales.name: Death Blow
finales.effect: Hans now begins the Killer Phase by resolving the following: Target Final Girl > Move Three Times > Attack Three Times
finales.flavour_unofficial: The last swing. It comes for you and it doesn't stop.

finales.name: Bloodbath
finales.effect: Hans now begins the Killer Phase by resolving the following: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move Twice > Attack Twice
finales.flavour_unofficial: He stops picking targets and simply starts swinging.

finales.name: Butcher Bloodlust
finales.effect: Hans now begins the Killer Phase by resolving the following: Increase Bloodlust by 1 > Target Final Girl or Victim > Move Twice > Attack
finales.flavour_unofficial: Every kill feeds him and every heartbeat brings him closer.

finales.name: Dark, Darker, Darkest
finales.effect: Hans now begins the Killer Phase by resolving the following: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move Twice > Attack Draw a second Dark Power card when this is revealed.
finales.flavour_unofficial: The night thickens around him until there is nothing but his shape.

dark_powers.name: Blood Frenzy
dark_powers.effect: For every Victim that Hans kills, increase Bloodlust by 1.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Each scream drives him harder than the last.

dark_powers.name: Dark Obsession
dark_powers.effect: Whenever Hans attacks you at least once, he attacks an additional time.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Once he has you in reach, he will not settle for one blow.

dark_powers.name: Feed
dark_powers.effect: For every Victim that Hans kills, he recovers 1 Health.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Every body on the ground is a meal that patches him up.

dark_powers.name: Sledgehammer Massacre
dark_powers.effect: For every Knife Icon, Hans attacks you and each Victim in his space once.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: The hammer arcs wide enough to take the whole room.

minor_dark_powers.name: Unholy Rage
minor_dark_powers.effect: Hans does an additional Damage for each Knife Icon
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Something black and hungry boils behind the mask.

minor_dark_powers.name: Unholy Speed
minor_dark_powers.effect: Hans moves 1 additional space for each Boot Icon.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: You hear the hammer drag. Then you hear it much closer.

terror_cards.name: Unholy Rage
terror_cards.effect: Hans does an additional Damage for each Knife Icon Bonus Health: 2
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Something black and hungry boils behind the mask.

terror_cards.name: Unholy Speed
terror_cards.effect: Hans moves 1 additional space for each Boot Icon. Bonus Health: 2
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: You hear the hammer drag. Then you hear it much closer.

terror_cards.name: Dark Feast
terror_cards.effect: Increase Horror by 1. ↓ For every Victim that is Dead, Hans recovers 1 Health.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: He lingers over the fallen, and gets stronger for it.

terror_cards.name: "Hans wants me. He's always wanted me."
terror_cards.effect: Target Final Girl > Move Twice > Attack
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: He has been waiting years for this, and he only wants her.

terror_cards.name: "He just came out of nowhere!"
terror_cards.effect: Place Hans with the farthest Target possible. ↓ Increase Horror by 1. ↓ Draw the next Terror card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: One blink and he is across the camp.

terror_cards.name: "He just keeps coming!"
terror_cards.effect: Increase Horror by 1 ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Run, hide, bar the door. He still comes.

terror_cards.name: "He kept swinging his hammer and killing and killing..."
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The screaming stops only when there is no one left to scream.

terror_cards.name: "He wants fresh blood!"
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Target Victim > Move Twice > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: He goes looking for someone new to break.

terror_cards.name: "He's just...standing there!"
terror_cards.effect: Increase Horror by 2. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move Twice
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Motionless at the treeline, just watching. That's somehow worse.

terror_cards.name: Horrific Hammer Rush
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Target Victim > Move Twice > Attack Twice ↓ For each Victim killed during this attack: Increase Horror by 1.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The hammer comes down again and again, faster each time.

terror_cards.name: Taking Souvenirs
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Target Victim > Move Twice > Attack Twice ↓ For each Victim killed during the Killer phase: Increase Bloodlust by an additional 1.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: He keeps a little something from every one of them.

killers.flavour_unofficial: A giant in a pig-iron mask, dragging a hammer that has never once missed.

killers.name: Poltergeist

finales.name: Demonic Posession
finales.effect: The Poltergeist now begins the Killer Phase by resolving the following: Place the Poltergeist in your space > Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack If Carolyn is with you, Lose 1 Health at the beginning of every Killer phase.
finales.flavour_unofficial: It stops pretending to be a house and becomes something else.

finales.name: Nothing is Easy
finales.effect: The Poltergeist now begins the Killer Phase by resolving the following: Place the Poltergeist in your space > Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack All 0-Cost Cards now cost 1 Time
finales.flavour_unofficial: Every door sticks, every step drags, every exit argues back.

finales.name: Relentless Assault
finales.effect: The Poltergeist now begins the Killer Phase by resolving the following: Place the Poltergeist in your space > Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack Twice
finales.flavour_unofficial: The walls, the floor and the furniture all come for you at once.

finales.name: She Will Soon Be Lost
finales.effect: The Poltergeist now begins the Killer Phase by resolving the following: Draw a Terror card. If you are unable to do so, you immediately lose the game. Add 3 Terror cards to the Terror deck when this card is revealed.
finales.flavour_unofficial: Carolyn's voice grows fainter. You are running out of time to reach her.

dark_powers.name: Forgetting Something?
dark_powers.effect: You may not win the game unless you reach an Exit Space with Carolyn and the Mr. Floppy Item card.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: You can't leave without Carolyn. The house makes sure you remember.

dark_powers.name: Eternal Despair
dark_powers.effect: Whenever you resolve a Horror roll, lose 1 Time for every 1 showing on a die (after rerolls).
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Each failure of nerve costs you precious seconds.

dark_powers.name: Invisible Barrier
dark_powers.effect: You may not enter an Exit Space with Carolyn unless you have full health.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: The front door is right there, and it will not let her through.

dark_powers.name: Stiff Wind
dark_powers.effect: All of your moves of 2 or more spaces are reduced by 1 space.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: A howling draught pushes back against every step.

minor_dark_powers.name: Psychic Confusion
minor_dark_powers.effect: If Carolyn is with you, discard and draw the next Terror card. Roll 1 fewer die when resolving a Search card. Prior to playing a Search card, you may spend 3 Time to ignore this penalty. Discard this card when you find Carolyn.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Your thoughts scatter like dropped marbles.

minor_dark_powers.name: Unseen Forces
minor_dark_powers.effect: If Carolyn is with you, discard and draw the next Terror card. Your first space moved each Action phase is panicked. Discard this card when you find Carolyn.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Hands you cannot see push, pull and trip you.

terror_cards.name: Psychic Confusion
terror_cards.effect: If Carolyn is with you, discard and draw the next Terror card. Roll 1 fewer die when resolving a Search card. Prior to playing a Search card, you may spend 3 Time to ignore this penalty. Discard this card when you find Carolyn.
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Your thoughts scatter like dropped marbles.

terror_cards.name: Unseen Forces
terror_cards.effect: If Carolyn is with you, discard and draw the next Terror card. Your first space moved each Action phase is panicked. Discard this card when you find Carolyn.
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Hands you cannot see push, pull and trip you.

terror_cards.name: "Carolyn? Where are you?!?!?"
terror_cards.effect: If Carolyn is not with you, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Shuffle Carolyn into the Item deck of the nearest Search Space. Do NOT reveal the top card of the deck.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: She was right behind you. Now the hallway is empty.

terror_cards.name: Corporeal Form
terror_cards.effect: A Behemoth (2 Health) appears! You may play Action cards that inflict damage if you wish. Then, if the Behemoth is still alive: ↓ You take Damage equal to the Killer's attack value +1. You may defend as normal. ↓ If you take damage, discard an Item of your choice. ↓ The Behemoth disappears.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The darkness gathers itself into something with weight and teeth.

terror_cards.name: "Did that clown... just move?"
terror_cards.effect: A Clown Doll (1 Health) appears! You may play Action cards that inflict damage if you wish. Then, if the Clown Doll is still alive: ↓ You take Damage equal to the Killer's attack value. You may defend as normal. ↓ If you take damage, increase Bloodlust by 1. ↓ The Clown Doll disappears.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: You put it on the shelf. You're sure you did.

terror_cards.name: "Everything was flying around!"
terror_cards.effect: Increase Horror by 1. ↓ Place the Poltergeist with the closest Victim, or in your space if there are no Victims. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Books, plates and chairs fill the air like birds.

terror_cards.name: "I have to kill you! It told me to kill you!"
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ All Victims in spaces adjacent to you move to your space. ↓ If there are any Victims in your space, you may play ONE Action card that inflicts damage. Kill 1 Victim for each Damage. Do NOT increase Bloodlust. ↓ Take 1 Damage for each Victim in your space. Then they all panic.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Something is speaking through them now.

terror_cards.name: Nothing Is As It Seems
terror_cards.effect: If Carolyn is with you, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Shuffle each Item deck and reveal the top card of each. ↓ If Carolyn or Mr. Floppy is revealed, then increase Bloodlust by 2.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The room isn't the room you walked into.

terror_cards.name: "The ground is shaking!"
terror_cards.effect: Place the Poltergeist in your space. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack ↓ If you take any damage, all of your moves during the next Action phase are panicked.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The floorboards buck and the house drops you at its feet.

terror_cards.name: "The shadows are closing in"
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: Increase Horror by 2. ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The corners grow longer, and the light gets smaller.

terror_cards.name: Unstoppable Evil
terror_cards.effect: Roll a die. ↓ Take Damage equal to your roll. (you may defend) OR Kill that many Victims (you choose which Victims) If there are not enough Victims, you must choose to take the damage.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It doesn't care what you do. It just hurts.

terror_cards.name: "Where the hell did this storm come from?"
terror_cards.effect: Lightning strikes your space and each space adjacent to you! ↓ One Victim in each space is killed and you lose Health equal to the Poltergeist's current Attack Value.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Indoors, a storm. Lightning from the ceiling.

killers.flavour_unofficial: A cold spot, a slammed door, and a child's name whispered in the dark.

killers.name: Inkanyamba

finales.name: Drag Her To Hell
finales.effect: Inkanyamba now begins the Killer Phase by resolving the following: Increase Killer Wrath by 2 > Unleash Killer Wrath > Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack When this is revealed, remove all Atonement cards from the game.
finales.flavour_unofficial: He wants one soul above all others, and he will drag her down himself.

finales.name: Savage Whirlwind
finales.effect: Unleash Killer Wrath > Increase Killer Wrath by 1 > Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack Twice
finales.flavour_unofficial: The air itself spins into a blade.

finales.name: Violent Tantrum
finales.effect: Unleash Killer Wrath > Increase Divine Wrath by 3 > Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack
finales.flavour_unofficial: His rage shakes the heavens and the heavens answer.

finales.name: We Need a Miracle
finales.effect: Unleash Killer Wrath > Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack When this is revealed, Increase Killer Wrath to 10. Then take up to 6 Time worth of Action cards into your hand.
finales.flavour_unofficial: If you were ever going to pray, now would be the time.

dark_powers.name: Dark Lightning
dark_powers.effect: Whenever Inkanyamba kills a Victim, kill a second Victim in the same or an adjacent space if able.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: One death is never enough. The sky takes a second.

dark_powers.name: Feast of Anger
dark_powers.effect: Whenever Killer Wrath Increases, Inkanyamba recovers 1 Health.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Anger is his food, and he is very well fed.

dark_powers.name: Rising Dread
dark_powers.effect: Whenever Killer Wrath increases, +1 Horror.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Every flare of his rage chills you to the bone.

dark_powers.name: Volatile Temper
dark_powers.effect: At the end of Upkeep, make a Horror roll. Success: No effect. No Success: Unleash Killer Wrath.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: His mood turns on a coin, and the coin is weighted.

minor_dark_powers.name: Boiling Anger
minor_dark_powers.effect: Once during each Upkeep, make a Horror roll: Success: No effect. No Success: Increase Killer Wrath by 1.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: His temper simmers and occasionally spills over.

minor_dark_powers.name: Outrageholic
minor_dark_powers.effect: Every time Killer Wrath is Increased, Increase it by an additional 1.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: He never gets a little angry. He gets angrier.

terror_cards.name: Boiling Anger
terror_cards.effect: Once during each Upkeep, make a Horror roll: Success: No effect. No Success: Increase Killer Wrath by 1. Bonus Health: 2
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: His temper simmers and occasionally spills over.

terror_cards.name: Outrageholic
terror_cards.effect: Every time Killer Wrath is Increased, Increase it by an additional 1. Bonus Health: 3
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: He never gets a little angry. He gets angrier.

terror_cards.name: Fickle Temper (x2)
terror_cards.effect: Make a Horror roll. ↓ 2 Successes: Choose Divine Wrath or Killer Wrath and Decrease by half, rounded up. 1 Success: Choose Divine Wrath or Killer Wrath and Decrease by 1. No Successes: Unleash Killer Wrath. Then, roll a die and Increase Killer Wrath by the number rolled. ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack If there are no Victims, target the Final Girl instead.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Will he spare you or smite you? Even he doesn't know.

terror_cards.name: "He's coming and there's nothing we can do!" (x4)
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ +1 Horror ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The water rises. The trees bend. He's here.

terror_cards.name: "I don't know how, but I've angered him."
terror_cards.effect: Target Final Girl > Move > Attack Twice ↓ Increase Killer Wrath equal to the amount of damage inflicted.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: You did something. You don't know what. He knows.

terror_cards.name: Punishment or Mercy
terror_cards.effect: Do the following based on the current level of Killer Wrath: ↓ 0-3: Increase Killer Wrath by 2 and Unleash Killer Wrath 4-5: Increase Killer Wrath by 2 6-9: Decrease Killer Wrath by half, rounded up. 10: Decrease Killer Wrath down to 1
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: He weighs every life on the scale of his wrath.

terror_cards.name: "They disrespected him, and now he wants their blood."
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack Twice ↓ Increase Killer Wrath equal to the number of Victims killed this turn.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The tourists laughed at the shrine. They're not laughing now.

terror_cards.name: Wrath of Blood
terror_cards.effect: Unleash Killer Wrath ↓ Increase Killer Wrath equal to the Bloodlust level. ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack If there are no Victims, target the Final Girl instead.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Blood spilled on holy ground calls him like a bell.

terror_cards.name: Wrath of Death
terror_cards.effect: Unleash Killer Wrath ↓ Increase Killer Wrath equal to your current health. ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack If there are no Victims, target the Final Girl instead.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Death walks beside him through the groves.

terror_cards.name: Wrath of Defilers
terror_cards.effect: Unleash Killer Wrath ↓ Increase Killer Wrath equal to the number of Victims that have been saved. ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack If there are no Victims, target the Final Girl instead.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Those who defile his home answer for it.

terror_cards.name: Wrath of Horror
terror_cards.effect: Unleash Killer Wrath ↓ Increase Killer Wrath equal to the Horror level. ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack If there are no Victims, target the Final Girl instead.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Fear is an offering and he accepts it gladly.

terror_cards.name: Wrath of Opportunity
terror_cards.effect: Unleash Killer Wrath ↓ Increase Killer Wrath equal to the number of Action cards in hand. ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack If there are no Victims, target the Final Girl instead.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: He waits for the moment you slip.

killers.flavour_unofficial: A river god in fury, and the groves are his temple.

killers.name: Geppetto

finales.name: Puppet Bombs
finales.effect: Geppetto now begins the Killer Phase by resolving the following: Killer: Target Final Girl > Move > Attack Twice When revealed, each Puppet explodes, dealing -2 Health to you and/or any Victims within 1 space of it.
finales.flavour_unofficial: His puppets carry gifts. The gifts are on fire.

finales.name: I Made Your Friends
finales.effect: Minions: Target Final Girl > Move > Attack Killer: Target Final Girl > Move > Attack During the Killer phase, Victims act as Puppets, but all other times they still act as normal Victims. You may attack and kill Victims if you wish, increasing Bloodlust as normal.
finales.flavour_unofficial: Those familiar faces? He built them, after a fashion.

finales.name: No Strings Attached
finales.effect: Minions: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack Killer: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move Twice > Attack Puppet movements are no longer bound to Geppetto. They can move anywhere with no restrictions. When moving Puppets, they may move 1 space more than normal.
finales.flavour_unofficial: The puppets cut their strings and come for you on their own.

finales.name: Remember Them?
finales.effect: Minions: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack Killer: Target Final Girl > Move > Attack Twice When revealed, spawn all remaining Puppets to the board. When moving Puppets, they move 1 space less than normal.
finales.flavour_unofficial: You recognise them. That's the worst part.

dark_powers.name: Join the Family
dark_powers.effect: During the Killer phase if all 3 Puppets are in your space, you lose all remaining Health. You still resolve your Final Health token as normal.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: He wants you in his collection, forever.

dark_powers.name: Immortal Master
dark_powers.effect: If all of the Puppets are on the board, Geppetto cannot be killed. Any damage that would remove his Final Health token is ignored.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: While his children stand, the master cannot fall.

dark_powers.name: Massive Abominations
dark_powers.effect: Each Puppet ignores the first Damage dealt to it each turn.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: He built them big, and he built them tough.

dark_powers.name: Weapons Graft
dark_powers.effect: Puppets now do 2 Damage when attacking.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Knives where fingers should be. He's very proud.

minor_dark_powers.name: "Am I a puppet?"
minor_dark_powers.effect: If you start your turn more than 2 spaces away from Geppetto, lose Health equal to his current Attack Value.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Stray too far from him and the strings start pulling at you.

minor_dark_powers.name: Puppets Everywhere
minor_dark_powers.effect: Whenever a Victim is killed in your space or an adjacent one, +1 Horror.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Every death nearby sounds like applause in his workshop.

terror_cards.name: "Am I a puppet?"
terror_cards.effect: If you start your turn more than 2 spaces away from Geppetto, lose Health equal to his current Attack Value. Bonus Health: 2
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Stray too far from him and the strings start pulling at you.

terror_cards.name: Puppets Everywhere
terror_cards.effect: Whenever a Victim is killed in your space or an adjacent one, +1 Horror. Bonus Health: 2
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Every death nearby sounds like applause in his workshop.

terror_cards.name: Boxed in With Nowhere to Go
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ +2 Horror ↓ Each Victim that is with or adjacent to a Puppet's space panics. If a Victim panics to a space with a Puppet, they are killed immediately.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Crates, cages and canvas walls close in on every side.

terror_cards.name: "Bring her to me!"
terror_cards.effect: The closest Puppet to you: Target Final Girl > Move > Attack ↓ If you were damaged by the Puppet, move 1 space closer to Geppetto. ↓ If you are in Geppetto's space or there are no Puppets in your space, discard this card. Otherwise, resolve this entire card again.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Puppets do as they are told.

terror_cards.name: "Dance puppet!"
terror_cards.effect: Make a Horror roll. ↓ Success: Move all Puppets 1 space towards you or the nearest Victim (your choice). Failure: Kill a Victim in your space. If there are none, +2 Horror.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Strings twitch. Wooden feet tap. They dance where he likes.

terror_cards.name: "Dear lord, are those our friends?"
terror_cards.effect: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack ↓ Roll a die for each Victim with or adjacent to a Puppet. 1-5: Move the Victim towards the Puppet. 6: Move the Victim 1 space in any direction. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Painted faces you used to know, stitched to wooden bodies.

terror_cards.name: Endless Maddening Laughter
terror_cards.effect: Laughter rings out in each space adjacent to you. All Victims in those spaces panic. ↓ Victims in a space with an Enemy are killed. ↓ If your are in a space with or adjacent to Geppetto, lose Health equal to his Attack Value. ↓ If no Victims were killed and you did not take any damage, resolve the next Terror card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The laughter is everywhere and it never takes a breath.

terror_cards.name: Make or Break
terror_cards.effect: Roll a die. ↓ You must lose Health equal to half the result (rounded up) OR kill that many Victims instead.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: He asks you to choose what you can afford to lose.

terror_cards.name: Master Showman
terror_cards.effect: Place Geppetto in your space. ↓ Place a Puppet in each adjacent space if able. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The show always comes to you.

terror_cards.name: Razor Puppet Strings
terror_cards.effect: Victims in or adjacent to Geppetto's space are killed. ↓ Lose 2 Health if you are in or adjacent to Geppetto's space. You may reduce the damage by 1 for each Walk or Sprint Action card you discard. ↓ If no Victims were killed and you did not take damage, resolve the next Terror card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A glint in the air, then nothing below the neck.

terror_cards.name: Replacement Parts
terror_cards.effect: Place 2 new Victims at Geppetto's starting location. Then, place Geppetto in the space with the closest Victim. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack ↓ For each Victim killed, +1 Bloodlust and Geppetto recovers 1 Health.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: He always has spares.

terror_cards.name: There Is No Escape
terror_cards.effect: +1 Horror ↓ Place Geppetto and each Puppet at an Exit space (distribute evenly). ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Every exit you reach, the show is already waiting.

terror_cards.name: "They have us completely surrounded!"
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ +1 Horror ↓ Target Victim > Move Twice > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Painted eyes in every direction.

terror_cards.name: "They're coming from everywhere!"
terror_cards.effect: Roll a die. If the result is less than the Horror level, spawn the remaining Puppets (regardless of status) in Geppetto's space. ↓ Puppets only: Target Final Girl > Move Twice > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Little wooden footsteps, from every side at once.

terror_cards.name: "They're gaining on me!"
terror_cards.effect: Roll a die. If the result is less than the Horror level, lose Time equal to the Horror Level. ↓ Puppets only: Target Final Girl > Move
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The clatter of puppet feet gets louder every second.

terror_cards.name: "You'll make a fun new toy..."
terror_cards.effect: +2 Horror ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: He has such plans for you.

killers.flavour_unofficial: A kindly old craftsman whose creations never stop smiling.

killers.name: Dr. Fright

finales.name: Dream Warfare
finales.effect: Dr. Fright now begins the Killer Phase by resolving the following: Target Final Girl > Move > Attack Twice Dr. Fright ignores all damage effects from Item cards.
finales.flavour_unofficial: The dream and the waking world are both his battlefield now.

finales.name: Everyone Must Die
finales.effect: Dr. Fright now begins the Killer Phase by resolving the following: Kill 2 Victims automatically (you may choose which). If none remain, you lose 4 Health. When this card is revealed, remove Dr. Fright from the board and place him on this card. For the remainder of the game, Dr. Fright may be attacked from any space if you are Asleep.
finales.flavour_unofficial: He is done picking favourites. Everyone goes.

finales.name: Face Your Fright
finales.effect: Dr. Fright now begins the Killer Phase by resolving the following: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack If you are Awake when this card is revealed, you fall Asleep. While this card is in play, you are Asleep for the remainder of the game. Reset the Boiler Room immediately upon exiting it.
finales.flavour_unofficial: He brings your worst fear to life and asks you to look at it.

finales.name: Time to Die
finales.effect: Dr. Fright now begins the Killer Phase by resolving the following: Target Final Girl > Move > Attack Twice During Upkeep, if you are Awake lose 2 Health and you fall Asleep.
finales.flavour_unofficial: He makes the appointment. You just show up.

dark_powers.name: Shock Factor
dark_powers.effect: If a Victim would panic, it is killed instead. (Max 3 per turn)
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Panic is a death sentence on this street.

dark_powers.name: Never Really Dead
dark_powers.effect: When this card is revealed, place Dr. Fright's black Final Health token back to the reserve pool and replace it with a white Final Health token. If Dr. Fright loses his last health, reveal 3 black Final Health tokens from the reserve pool and restore his health accordingly.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: You burned him, buried him, forgot him. He didn't forget you.

dark_powers.name: Pitchfork Assault
dark_powers.effect: Each time Dr. Fright damages you, +1 Horror.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Every cut leaves a little more fear behind.

dark_powers.name: The Frightmare is Inevitable
dark_powers.effect: Dr. Fright may attack you even if you are Awake.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Staying awake isn't enough any more.

minor_dark_powers.name: Endless Sleep
minor_dark_powers.effect: You fall Asleep. ↓ While this card is in play, you must remain Asleep. Reset the Boiler Room immediately upon exiting it.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Your eyelids drop and Maple Lane falls away.

minor_dark_powers.name: Hellish Pursuit
minor_dark_powers.effect: While Asleep, you must resolve one additional Boiler Room card at the end of the Killer phase if able.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: The boiler room has longer corridors tonight.

terror_cards.name: Endless Sleep
terror_cards.effect: You fall Asleep. ↓ While this card is in play, you must remain Asleep. Reset the Boiler Room immediately upon exiting it. Bonus Health: 1
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Your eyelids drop and Maple Lane falls away.

terror_cards.name: Hellish Pursuit
terror_cards.effect: While Asleep, you must resolve one additional Boiler Room card at the end of the Killer phase if able. Bonus Health: 2
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The boiler room has longer corridors tonight.

terror_cards.name: Better Stay Up Late
terror_cards.effect: If you are Awake, -1 Die for Horror rolls during the next Action phase. ↓ If you are Asleep, immediately resolve all remaining Boiler Room cards. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Too many cups of coffee, and your hands won't stop shaking.

terror_cards.name: Better Lock the Door
terror_cards.effect: Target Final Girl > Move ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack ↓ During the next Action phase, you may not move into any Search space occupied by a Victim.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Deadbolts won't save you, but they might slow him down.

terror_cards.name: Blurred Reality
terror_cards.effect: Until the next Killer phase, you and Dr. Fright may damage each other even if you are Awake. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Waking and dreaming bleed together until neither is safe.

terror_cards.name: "But if this is a dream then I can..."
terror_cards.effect: If you are Awake, immediately discard this card and resolve the next Terror card. ↓ Otherwise, you may increase Bloodlust by 1 to choose ONE of the following: * Take the top Item Card of any deck. * Move to any space you wish. * Gain 4 Time
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: If it's only a dream, maybe you make the rules for once.

terror_cards.name: "But you can't be here... You're dead!"
terror_cards.effect: Do the following based on how many Victims have died: 0: Fall Asleep 1-3: +1 Bloodlust 4 or more: +2 Bloodlust ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The dead come back to visit, and they look like he did it.

terror_cards.name: "Didn't you know they were already dead?"
terror_cards.effect: If you have not saved any Victims or your Final Girl card has been flipped, discard this and resolve the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Remove 1 Victim from a Saved Victim space on your Final Girl card. ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: They were never really with you. He made sure of that.

terror_cards.name: "Ewwwww! He's disgusting!"
terror_cards.effect: +2 Horror
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The smell reaches you before he does.

terror_cards.name: Franky's Coming for You
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Target Victim > Move ↓ If Dr. Fright is in a space with at least one Victim: +2 Horror Otherwise: +1 Horror
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A nursery rhyme, chanted by children who aren't there.

terror_cards.name: Grab Your Crucifix
terror_cards.effect: If you have a Crucifix, you may discard it to ignore the rest of this card. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Old faith, held tight in a shaking fist.

terror_cards.name: "I'm so sleepy..."
terror_cards.effect: If you are Awake, roll a die. If the result is less than the current Horror level, you fall Asleep. If you are Asleep, resolve a Boiler Room card and if you take damage, +1 Horror. ↓ Target Victim > Move
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Just five more minutes. Just close your eyes.

terror_cards.name: Marked for Death
terror_cards.effect: Until the next Killer phase, all Victims in your space immediately panic. ↓ Target Final Girl > Move ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack ↓ If Dr. Fright did not attack you and you are Awake, you fall Asleep.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Everyone standing near you has been chosen.

terror_cards.name: Never Sleep Again
terror_cards.effect: +1 Horror ↓ You fall Asleep. ↓ If you were already Asleep, you may reset the Boiler Room deck if you wish. If you do not, resolve one additional Boiler Room card at the end of the Killer phase.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: You promised yourself you'd never sleep again. You lied.

terror_cards.name: "OMG... He's slicing off his own fingers!"
terror_cards.effect: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move Twice ↓ Dr. Fright take 1 Damage, unless he only has a Final Health token remaining. ↓ If Dr. Fright took damage, +3 Horror and you and all Victims in his space panic.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: He grins while he does it, and it doesn't slow him down.

terror_cards.name: Slash Her
terror_cards.effect: Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack ↓ All Victims that are not in a Search space panic.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The blades come out and he aims for her.

killers.flavour_unofficial: A grinning burned man in a stained coat who waits behind your eyelids.

killers.name: Birds

finales.name: Endless Swarm
finales.effect: The Birds now begin the Killer phase by resolving the following: Spawn Bird When moving into a space you lose 1 Health if there are 3 birds in that space.
finales.flavour_unofficial: The flock never thins. It only thickens.

finales.name: Fowl Aggression
finales.effect: The Birds now begin the Killer phase by resolving the following: Spawn Bird > Attack > Spawn Bird For the remainder of the game, when Spawning Birds, roll one die and place that many birds in your space.
finales.flavour_unofficial: They have stopped circling. They are diving.

finales.name: Insurmountable Odds
finales.effect: The Birds now begin the Killer phase by resolving the following: Spawn Bird > Attack > Spawn Bird When Spawning Birds, you MUST select the higher result for number of birds to place.
finales.flavour_unofficial: There are more birds than there is sky.

dark_powers.name: Birdnado
dark_powers.effect: During Upkeep, if there are 10 or more total birds in your space and adjacent spaces, you lose 3 Health.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Wings knit into a living storm.

dark_powers.name: Run for Your Life!
dark_powers.effect: During Upkeep, panic the Victim farthest from you. If the victim panics to a space with 2 or more birds, the victim is killed.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: The flock drives people out of hiding and into the open.

dark_powers.name: They're Just Waiting to Strike
dark_powers.effect: During Upkeep, if there are 3 birds in your space, +2 Horror.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: They perch on every rail and wait for you to make a move.

minor_dark_powers.name: Bird Wall
minor_dark_powers.effect: Victims may not be saved at an Exit space if there are any bird tokens on the space. Each time a bird is killed place a bird token on this card. When this card has 5 or more bird tokens on it, remove this card from the game.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: The exit is covered in feathers and nobody gets through.

terror_cards.name: Bird Wall
terror_cards.effect: Victims may not be saved at an Exit space if there are any bird tokens on the space. Each time a bird is killed place a bird token on this card. When this card has 5 or more bird tokens on it, remove this card from the game.
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The exit is covered in feathers and nobody gets through.

terror_cards.name: "It feels hopeless"
terror_cards.effect: +2 Horror ↓ If there is at least one Special Victim in play: ↓ Spawn Bird
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: You can't see the end of them. Maybe there isn't one.

terror_cards.name: "The birds are attacking!"
terror_cards.effect: Attack in your space and all spaces where Birds outnumber Victims ↓ If no attacks occurred: Spawn Bird and +1 Bloodlust
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The glass goes first.

terror_cards.name: "They're trying to get in!"
terror_cards.effect: +1 Horror ↓ Spawn Bird Instead of spawning birds as normal, roll one die and place that many birds in the nearest Search space.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Beaks hammer at the windows, the doors, the walls.

terror_cards.name: "Where are they coming from?"
terror_cards.effect: Spawn Bird ↓ If 3 or fewer birds were spawned: ↓ Spawn Bird
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: There are so many more than there were a minute ago.

killers.flavour_unofficial: Feathers, beaks and a sky gone wrong.

killers.name: Evomorph

finales.name: Impenetrable Armor
finales.effect: The Evomorph now begins the Killer phase by resolving the following: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack Reduce all Damage inflicted on the Evomorph by 2, to a minimum of 1.
finales.flavour_unofficial: Its shell is now tougher than the hull around it.

finales.name: Blitz of Death
finales.effect: The Evomorph now begins the Killer phase by resolving the following: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack > Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack
finales.flavour_unofficial: A blur of teeth and chitin, then silence.

finales.name: Death in the Dark
finales.effect: The Evomorph now begins the Killer phase by resolving the following: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack > Vanish When drawing Ambush cards, draw +1 and choose the card with the highest Danger.
finales.flavour_unofficial: The lights fail and the hunting begins.

finales.name: The Perfect Organism
finales.effect: The Evomorph now begins the Killer phase by resolving the following: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move Twice > Attack Twice
finales.flavour_unofficial: It is complete, and it is magnificent, and it is coming.

dark_powers.name: Razor Tail
dark_powers.effect: When revealed, place the Evomorph in the space with the most Victims without a X and kill every Victim there. Then, remove all Xs. Whenever the Evomorph attacks at least once, attack an additional time in each adjacent space.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: The tail moves faster than your eyes can follow.

dark_powers.name: Acid Blood
dark_powers.effect: When revealed, place the Evomorph in the closest space to you without an X and remove all Xs. Whenever you damage the Evomorph in your space, -1 Health.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Every wound you give it eats through the floor.

dark_powers.name: Razor Claws
dark_powers.effect: When revealed, place the Evomorph in the closest space to you without an X and remove all Xs. Whenever the Evomorph damages you, randomly discard 1 Action card.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Claws that could peel open a bulkhead.

dark_powers.name: Symbiotic Camouflage
dark_powers.effect: When revealed, place the Evomorph in the closest space to you without a X, and remove all Xs. When drawing Ambush cards, draw +1 and choose the one with the highest Danger.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: It wears the ship's shadows like skin.

minor_dark_powers.name: Dead Silence
minor_dark_powers.effect: Roll 1 fewer dice, to a minimum of 1 die, when resolving a Scan Action card.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: The quieter it gets, the harder it is to think.

minor_dark_powers.name: Sideswipe
minor_dark_powers.effect: Whenever the Evomorph Vanishes, perform the following Killer Action before it disappears: Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: It vanishes, and takes someone with it on the way out.

minor_dark_powers.name: Shadow Dread
minor_dark_powers.effect: Whenever you draw an Ambush card with 2 or less Danger, discard and draw another.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: The dark in every vent feels like it's looking back.

terror_cards.name: Dead Silence
terror_cards.effect: Roll 1 fewer dice, to a minimum of 1 die, when resolving a Scan Action card. Bonus Health: 2
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The quieter it gets, the harder it is to think.

terror_cards.name: Sideswipe
terror_cards.effect: Whenever the Evomorph Vanishes, perform the following Killer Action before it disappears: Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack Bonus Health: 3
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It vanishes, and takes someone with it on the way out.

terror_cards.name: Shadow Dread
terror_cards.effect: Whenever you draw an Ambush card with 2 or less Danger, discard and draw another. Bonus Health: 2
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The dark in every vent feels like it's looking back.

terror_cards.name: Acid Spray
terror_cards.effect: If the Evomorph is a Hatchling, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Target Final Girl > Move > Attack ↓ If the Evomorph damages you, discard a random Item. If you have no Items, -2 Health. ↓ Vanish
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Acid sprays the corridor and the floor hisses.

terror_cards.name: Exo-Skeleton
terror_cards.effect: Take a black Final Health token from the reserve and place it op TOP of the Evomorph's current Final Health token. ↓ This does not increase the Evomorph's health. Instead, when you must reveal the Final Health token, reveal both simultaneously. ↓ +1 Horror
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: You hit it. It doesn't seem to mind.

terror_cards.name: "Game over, man! Game over!"
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard this card and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ +1 Horror ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The crew is gone, and the ship is all it has left to search.

terror_cards.name: "It came out of the shadows!"
terror_cards.effect: If the Evomorph is a Hatchling, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack Twice ↓ Vanish
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: There was nothing there. Then there was.

terror_cards.name: "Oh god, where did it go!?"
terror_cards.effect: If the Evomorph is a Hatchling, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ +3 Horror ↓ Vanish
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: One moment it was right there, the next it's in the walls.

terror_cards.name: Scratches in the Dark
terror_cards.effect: Target Final Girl > Move Three Times ↓ For each space that the Evomorph passes through that contains at least 1 Victim (including its starting and ending spaces): +1 Horror.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Claws on metal, getting closer in the dark.

terror_cards.name: Shadow Blitz
terror_cards.effect: If the Evomorph is a Hatchling, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Vanish ↓ Immediately draw the next Ambush card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A shadow, a shriek, and someone missing.

terror_cards.name: Skull Burster

finales.flavour_unofficial: It learns from everyone it absorbs.

finales.name: Reductive Assimilation

finales.flavour_unofficial: It sheds what it doesn't need and comes back leaner.

finales.name: Regenerative Assimilation
finales.effect: When this card is revealed, any remaining Exposed VIctims are immediately assimilated. If there is only one Mutated Organism in play, +2 Horror at the beginning of the Killer phase. If the Horror level is ever above 6, you have been assimilated and lose the game.
finales.flavour_unofficial: Every cut seals over like it was never there.

This health cannot be lost until all other normal health is lost.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Its blood sizzles through steel.

minor_dark_powers.name: Extra Legs

minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: It moves wrong, on too many limbs.

minor_dark_powers.name: Thick Skin

minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: You might as well be hitting a tyre with a stick.

killer_items.name: Test Kit

killer_items.flavour_unofficial: A drop of blood and a hot wire. It will tell you the truth.

terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Paranoia picks a target faster than reason does.

terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It can smell the fear in the station.

terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Survival turns people into something else, too.

terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Every face looks guilty in the flickering light.

killers.flavour_unofficial: It is in the station, and maybe it's in the person next to you.

killers.name: The Intruders

finales.name: We Know Where You Live
finales.effect: The Active Killer now begins the Killer phase by resolving the following: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack Twice > Active Killer UP When revealed, all Killers: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack
finales.flavour_unofficial: They have your address, your schedule and a key.

finales.name: Hunt Sweet Hunt
finales.effect: The Active Killer now begins the Killer phase by resolving the following: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move Twice > Attack > Active Killer UP Each Attack does 1 additional Damage.
finales.flavour_unofficial: They're in no rush. They know the house better than you do.

finales.name: Release the Beast
finales.effect: The Intruders now begin the Killer phase by resolving the following: All Killers: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack All Killers are now considered Active for the rest of the game. Perform the Killer actions starting with the top-most Killer.
finales.flavour_unofficial: They let off the leash whatever they've been keeping in the van.

finales.effect: The Active Killer now begins the Killer phase by resolving the following: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack > Active Killer DOWN > Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack
finales.flavour_unofficial: They say it calmly, like it's simply a fact.

dark_powers.name: Won't Stay Down
dark_powers.effect: When a Killer dies, immediately restore 2 normal health and a random black Final Health token for that Killer. Then, remove this card from the game.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: You put one down. It gets back up.

dark_powers.name: Maskaphobia
dark_powers.effect: Once per turn, when a Killer moves into your space, +1 Horror. You may not purchase Focus while a Killer is in your space.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: The masks are worse up close.

dark_powers.name: No Remorse
dark_powers.effect: Roll a die at the start of each Upkeep phase. If the result is greater than the number of Killers, +1 Bloodlust.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: They don't feel bad about any of it.

dark_powers.name: Strength in Numbers
dark_powers.effect: Each Attack does 1 additional Damage for each other Killer on the same or adjacent space.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: They hunt as a pack, and every member makes the others stronger.

minor_dark_powers.name: Amphetamines
minor_dark_powers.effect: At the beginning of the Killer phase, the Killer with the lowest health recovers 2 Health.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: They're wired, twitchy and impossible to outrun.

finales.flavour_unofficial: Just one more. It always says just one more.

finales.flavour_unofficial: It swells, it stretches, it no longer fits in the woods.

finales.flavour_unofficial: It has a sweet tooth, and you smell sweet.

finales.flavour_unofficial: It isn't hungry any more. It hunts because it loves to.

dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Tracking or slaying, it does both at once now.

dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: It is starving, and it knows exactly where the food is.

dark_powers.name: Sixth Sense
dark_powers.effect: The Big Bad Wolf ignores damage effects from Reaction Cards (such as Retaliate).
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: It knows where the blow will land before you swing.

minor_dark_powers.name: "What big ears you have!"

minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: It hears your heartbeat from across the woods.

minor_dark_powers.name: "What big eyes you have!"
minor_dark_powers.effect: When you move into or begin your turn in the Big Bad Wolf's space: Discard a random Action card if able.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Those glowing eyes find you even in the dark.

minor_dark_powers.name: "What big teeth you have!"
minor_dark_powers.effect: If the Big Bad Wolf attacks you and you prevented all of the damage, you lose 1 Health.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Block the bite and it simply bites harder.

terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The old line, said with a mouth full of teeth.

terror_cards.effect: Move yourself and all Victims one space closer towards the Big Bad Wolf. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack Three Times ↓ The Big Bad Wolf recovers 1 Health for each Victim killed.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action

terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A friendly voice on the path, a little too friendly.

terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: She's in the bed, under the covers. She has never looked so big.

terror_cards.effect: Track Mode: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > +2 Horror Slay Mode: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack Twice
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Every wall in the woods is made of straw to it.

terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Two red points in the undergrowth, getting higher off the ground.

terror_cards.name: On the Hunt
terror_cards.effect: Track Mode: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move Twice > +1 Bloodlust Slay Mode: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move Twice > Attack
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It has your scent and it isn't giving it up.

If you are also in the space, you take any remaining damage after all the Victims are killed.

terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The bark of every tree it passes is scored with long grooves.

terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: You hear the jaws snap shut. You don't hear the scream.

killers.flavour_unofficial: Something enormous on two legs, wearing the fairytale like a borrowed coat.

finales.flavour_unofficial: The doors are open and the patients are in charge.

finales.flavour_unofficial: She keeps her patients agitated. It's how she likes them.

finales.name: Hold Her Down
finales.effect: The Ratchet Lady now begins the Killer Phase by resolving the following: * Minions: Target Final Girl > Move * Killer: Target Final Girl > Move > Attack x2 When revealed, all remaining Victims become Maniacs. Then, remove all Calm Action cards from the game.
finales.flavour_unofficial: Straps, orderlies and a needle with your name on it.

finales.name: It's Raining Maniacs

finales.flavour_unofficial: They pour out of every ward, all of them hers.

dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: While her patients surround her, nothing touches the nurse.

dark_powers.name: Bloodfear

dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Your fear is her favourite medicine.

dark_powers.effect: Killer Phase: the first time the Ratchet Lady recovers at least 1 Health, recover an additional Health.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: One shot and she's on her feet again, wide awake.

dark_powers.name: Manic Burst
dark_powers.effect: Whenever a Maniac is placed on the board, immediately trigger the Minion Action for it.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Every new patient comes out of the ward swinging.

minor_dark_powers.name: Blood Drive
minor_dark_powers.effect: Health: 1 Each time a Victim becomes a Maniac, the Ratchet Lady recovers 1 Health.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Each mind that breaks gives her strength.

minor_dark_powers.name: Insanity-Lust
minor_dark_powers.effect: Health: 1 Whenever at least 1 Victim becomes a Maniac, 1 Bloodlust.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: She craves it every time someone snaps.
