terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Each mind that breaks gives her strength.

terror_cards.name: Insanity-Lust
terror_cards.effect: Health: 1 Whenever at least 1 Victim becomes a Maniac, 1 Bloodlust.
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: She craves it every time someone snaps.

terror_cards.name: Blood Jolt
terror_cards.effect: 2 Horror ↓ The Ratchet Lady recovers 2 Health.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A quick injection and she's livelier than ever.

terror_cards.name: Bloodletting
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Ratchet Lady only: Target Victim > Move > Attack ↓ Ratchet Lady only: Target Victim > Move > Attack ↓ For each Victim killed, 1 Bloodlust
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: She takes a little from everyone. She takes a lot from some.

terror_cards.name: Blood Transfusion
terror_cards.effect: Roll a die and place it at the bottom of this card (if all dice are on the card, resolve as if you had rolled a 4). ↓ 1-3 Resolve this card again. 4-5 Lose 1 Health > Ratchet Lady recovers Health equal to the number of dice on this card. 6 Ratchet Lady suffers 1 Damage > You recover Health equal to the number of dice on this card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: What's yours is hers, whether you agree or not.

terror_cards.name: "Don't worry, this won't hurt..."
terror_cards.effect: Ratchet Lady only: Target Final Girl > Move x2 > Attack x2 ↓ If the Ratchet Lady damages you, the closest Victim becomes a Maniac.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The bedside manner is lovely. The needle is not.

terror_cards.name: "Join me in the dark places"
terror_cards.effect: Ratchet Lady only: Target Final Girl > Move ↓ All Victims in spaces that the Ratchet Lady moves through, including her starting and ending spaces, become Maniacs. ↓ If at least one Victim became a Maniac, 1 Bloodlust
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: She invites you down the corridor where the lights don't work.

terror_cards.name: "Join us or die!"
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack ↓ For each Victim that would be killed, roll a die: 1-4 The Victim becomes a Maniac. Increase Bloodlust as if the Victim was killed. 5-6 The Victim dies but do NOT increase Bloodlust.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The patients don't want to be cured. They want company.

terror_cards.name: "Keep her busy..."
terror_cards.effect: Maniacs only: Target Final Girl > Move x2 ↓ Ratchet Lady only: Target Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Her orderlies keep you occupied while she works.

terror_cards.name: "Leave her to me!"
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Maniacs only: Target Victim > Move > Attack ↓ Ratchet Lady only: Target Final Girl > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: She prefers to handle the difficult ones personally.

terror_cards.name: "Let me tend to your wounds..."
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Ratchet Lady only: Target Victim > Move > Attack ↓ Ratchet Lady only: Target Victim > Move > Attack ↓ For each Victim killed, the Ratchet Lady recovers 1 Health.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: She means well. She absolutely does not mean well.

terror_cards.name: March of the Maniacs
terror_cards.effect: Spawn a Maniac at each empty Escape space. ↓ The closest Victim to you becomes a Maniac. ↓ The closest Victim to the Ratchet Lady becomes a Maniac. ↓ For each Maniac you were unable to place due to running out of meeples, 1 Bloodlust. ↓ Panic all Maniacs.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: They come shuffling in from every exit, gowns flapping.

terror_cards.name: Screams in the Dark
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ The 2 closest Victims to the Ratchet Lady become Maniacs. ↓ Maniacs only: Target Final Girl > Move x2
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Somewhere in the dark wards, someone won't stop screaming.

terror_cards.name: "We are helping!"
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ The 2 closest Victims to you become Maniacs. ↓ Maniacs only: Target Final Girl > Move ↓ Lose 1 Time for every Maniac in your space.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The patients insist they're on your side.

terror_cards.name: Whispers in the Dark
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ The closest Victim to the Ratchet Lady becomes a Maniac. ↓ Maniacs only: Target Final Girl > Move > Attack ↓ 1 Bloodlust
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Voices behind every padded door, saying your name.

special_cards.name: Calm
special_cards.effect: [Results] 2 Successes: Up to 2 Maniacs in your space or an adjacent space become Victims. 1 Success: 1 Maniac in your space or an adjacent space becomes a Victim > End Turn No Successes: 1 Maniac in your space or an adjacent space becomes a Victim > +1 Bloodlust > End Turn OR +1 Horror > -2 Time
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: Soft words, steady hands. Sometimes it brings them back.

killers.flavour_unofficial: A smiling nurse with a full syringe and a very long patient list.

killers.name: Zombies

finales.name: I'm Overwhelmed!
finales.effect: The Zombies now begin the Killer Phase by resolving the following: (Move all Zombies before resolving attacks) Minions: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack Killer: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack When this card is revealed replace you Final Health token with a white Final Health token.
finales.flavour_unofficial: They pour over you like a tide.

finales.name: Their Numbers Are Endless!
finales.effect: The Zombies now begin the Killer phase by resolving the following: (Move all Zombies before resolving attacks) Minions: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack Killer: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack If there is no Enemy in your space at the end of the Action phase, you lose 1 Health.
finales.flavour_unofficial: For every one you put down, three more shamble in.

finales.name: They've All Been Bitten!
finales.effect: The Zombies now begin the Killer Phase by resolving the following: (Move all Zombies before resolving attacks) Minions: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack Killer: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack When this card is revealed replace each remaining Victim on the board with a Zombie. If there are no Victims, Spawn Zombie.
finales.flavour_unofficial: The bites are spreading faster than the rumours.

dark_powers.name: Legion
dark_powers.effect: When Spawning Zombies, spawn one additional Zombie in the Exit space nearest to you.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: The crowd at the window keeps growing.

dark_powers.name: Runners
dark_powers.effect: Zombies no longer ignore Move icons on Terror cards. When resolving actions on Terror cards, always move all Zombies before resolving attacks.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: These ones don't shamble. These ones sprint.

dark_powers.name: Super Horde
dark_powers.effect: If a Horde moves into a space with another Horde, merge them into 1 Horde combining their health. If any Horde ever has 12 or more health, you immediately lose the game.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: The hordes meet and merge into something unstoppable.

minor_dark_powers.name: "Mom? Is that you?!?!?"
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: A familiar face in the crowd of the dead. It reaches for you.

terror_cards.name: "Mom? Is that you?!?!?"
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A familiar face in the crowd of the dead. It reaches for you.

terror_cards.name: "Don't forget... double tap!"
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Make sure they stay down. Always make sure.

terror_cards.name: "I'm surrounded!"
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Groaning on every side, and nowhere left to step.

terror_cards.name: "I'm the meat in a zombie sandwich!"
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: They're in front of you and behind you, and the gap is closing.

terror_cards.name: "There's dead people everywhere!"
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The street is a graveyard that won't lie still.

terror_cards.name: "There's no more room in Hell!"
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Hell is full, so the dead walk the earth.

terror_cards.name: "They just keep coming!"
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: They don't need to be fast. They just never stop.

terror_cards.name: "They're coming to get you!"
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The old taunt from a dark cemetery, now terribly literal.

killers.flavour_unofficial: They are slow, they are many and they are hungry.

killers.name: The H.U.N.T.E.R.

finales.name: Relentless Pursuit
finales.effect: The H.U.N.T.E.R. now begins the Killer phase by resolving the following: The H.U.N.T.E.R. recovers Health > Target Final Girl > Movement > Attack When revealed: Raise Bloodlust by 6 points.
finales.flavour_unofficial: It doesn't sleep, doesn't eat and doesn't give up.

finales.name: Adaptive A.I.
finales.effect: The H.U.N.T.E.R. now begins the Killer phase by resolving the following action: Bloodlust raises by 1 point > Target Final Girl > Movement > Attack Active condition: When attacking, the Mark X does an additional point of damage. Any damage the Mark X receives from the Mark V is reduced by 1, to a minimum of 1.
finales.flavour_unofficial: It learns from every miss and corrects its aim.

finales.name: "Termination Mode...Active."
finales.effect: The H.U.N.T.E.R. now begins the Killer phase by resolving the following: Raise Bloodlust by 1 point > Target Final Girl > Movement > Attack twice
finales.flavour_unofficial: A red light blinks on, and the voice goes flat.

finales.name: Mark X-1000
finales.flavour_unofficial: The upgraded model steps out of the smoke, faster and colder.

dark_powers.name: Titanium-Laced Bio Tissue
dark_powers.effect: Cybernetic Parts require 3 damage points to remove. Hunter Ally Effect: Each time you Repair, restore an additional point of health.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Every part of it is built to be hard to break.

dark_powers.name: M134 Minigun Armament
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: A rotating barrel the size of your arm starts to spin.

dark_powers.name: Cybernetic Agility
dark_powers.effect: The Mark V moves 1 additional space for each Movement. Mark V Ally Effect: When the Mark V moves at least 1 space, it may move an additional space.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Servos whine and it closes the gap impossibly fast.

dark_powers.name: Reinforced Endoskeleton
dark_powers.effect: The Mark V ignores all Reduce Health effects. (Damage effects still apply.) Mark V Ally Effect: The Mark V ignores all Reduce Health effects. (Damage effects still apply.)
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Under the skin, the frame is unbreakable.

minor_dark_powers.name: Titanium Shield
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Bullets spark off it as if they were sleet.

minor_dark_powers.name: Advanced AI
minor_dark_powers.effect: Whenever Bloodlust increases because the Hunter inflicted damage to you or an Ally, increase Bloodlust an additional time. Extend the Killer's health by 2 points.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Each kill teaches it something new.

terror_cards.name: "Deploy Counter-Measures"
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It anticipates your traps and steps right around them.

terror_cards.name: "Intimidation Mode...Active" (x2)
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It looms, it stares, and your courage falters.

terror_cards.name: Shock & Awe
terror_cards.effect: Roll 1 fewer dice (to a minimum of 1) when resolving Reaction cards. Target Final Girl > 2 Movement > Attack
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Light, noise and violence, all at once.

terror_cards.name: "Target Acquired" (x3)
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Crosshairs settle on someone. It is never good news.

terror_cards.name: Titanium Shield
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Bullets spark off it as if they were sleet.

terror_cards.name: Advanced AI
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Each kill teaches it something new.

terror_cards.name: "Eliminate All Obstacles"
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Anything between it and its target is simply in the way.

terror_cards.name: "Have You Seen This Person?"
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It shows a photo to every stranger, very politely.

terror_cards.name: "Terminate Mark V"
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The two machines meet and one of them must be destroyed.

terror_cards.name: "Move or Be Eliminated"
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It gives you one warning, in a voice like a vending machine.

terror_cards.name: "Analyze...Targeting Weaknesses"
terror_cards.effect: Target Final Girl > Movement > Attack
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It scans you and catalogues every weakness.

terror_cards.name: Hunter Mark X
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The newer model arrives, and the old one was bad enough.

terror_cards.name: System Reboot
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It goes dark, flickers, and comes back angrier.

terror_cards.name: "Impersonation Mode...Active"
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It wears a familiar face and a familiar voice.

killers.flavour_unofficial: A machine sent back through time with one name in its memory.

killers.name: Razorface

finales.name: Chains of Torment
finales.flavour_unofficial: Hooks on chains, and every one of them finds a mark.

finales.name: Taste Our Pleasures
finales.effect: Very dangerous finale (exact effect not reported).
finales.flavour_unofficial: He offers you a taste of what he calls pleasure.

finales.name: I Feast on Your Pain
finales.effect: Double attack with a Bloodlust-based bonus (inactive when Bloodlust is maxed).
finales.flavour_unofficial: Your suffering is his feast, and he eats twice.

finales.name: Legendary Suffering
finales.flavour_unofficial: The pain he brings will be told as legend in his realm.

dark_powers.name: Helleport
dark_powers.effect: Kills a victim whenever any remain, regardless of range.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: He steps between worlds and someone vanishes screaming.

dark_powers.name: Soulbound
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Your soul is tied to his realm now, whether you like it or not.

dark_powers.name: Life Drain
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Every wound he gives you makes him a little stronger.

dark_powers.name: Infinite Despair
dark_powers.effect: Gain at least 1 Horror each turn, possibly 2.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: There is no bottom to this despair.

minor_dark_powers.name: The Pain of Judgement
minor_dark_powers.effect: Kills victims easily while victims remain on the board.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: He weighs the living and finds them wanting.

minor_dark_powers.name: The Pain of Salvation
minor_dark_powers.effect: Mainly penalises Focus actions.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Redemption, he insists, must hurt.

terror_cards.name: Enticed By Ecstasy
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: He offers ecstasy, and it is very hard to refuse.

terror_cards.name: Sadistic Manifestation
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: His cruelty takes physical form.

terror_cards.name: Pleasure in Pain
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Pain and pleasure, he says, are the same thing.

terror_cards.name: New and Darker Experiences
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: He promises to show you sensations you never imagined.

terror_cards.name: What is your pleasure?
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: He asks politely what you desire. Don't answer.

terror_cards.name: Violent Tastes (x2)
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: His tastes run to the extreme.

terror_cards.name: Scarlet Hymn
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A hymn sung in blood by voices that should be dead.

terror_cards.name: See the purpose in your pain
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: He insists your pain has meaning. That doesn't help.

terror_cards.name: Brutal Reward (x2)
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: For every wound, a reward. For every reward, a wound.

terror_cards.name: Ecstatic Torture (x2)
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Rapture and agony, wound together like wire.

terror_cards.name: Pain and Pleasure Indivisible
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: In his realm, you cannot have one without the other.

terror_cards.name: The Pain of Judgement
terror_cards.effect: Kills victims easily while victims remain on the board.
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: He weighs the living and finds them wanting.

terror_cards.name: The Pain of Salvation
terror_cards.effect: Mainly penalises Focus actions.
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Redemption, he insists, must hurt.

terror_cards.name: Sadistic Manifestation
terror_cards.effect: Two attacks if the farthest victim has a companion.
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: His cruelty takes physical form.

special_cards.name: Experience Unbound
special_cards.effect: Affliction: Razorface recovers 3 Health when it is purged.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: Purging this one only feeds him.

killers.notes: Starts with 3 Afflictions; cannot be killed until all are purged (then his Final Health is revealed). Minor Dark Powers are nullified once an Affliction is purged. Running out of Afflictions to draw loses the game.
killers.flavour_unofficial: A priest of pain in a face full of nails, and he has come to collect.

killers.name: Slayer

finales.name: Interdimensional Rift Collapse
finales.effect: Slayer enters the real world; all victims in the Mirror Dimension die (you take damage if there). Attacks twice after moving; no Open Rift needed to hit him.
finales.flavour_unofficial: The barrier between worlds tears open and he steps through.

finales.name: Welcome to My World
finales.effect: All victims are pulled into the Mirror Dimension (excess beyond 6 meeples die); keeps the draw action and Horror rises each turn.
finales.flavour_unofficial: The town is gone. You're in his version now.

dark_powers.name: Mind Control
dark_powers.effect: Each Upkeep, victims in the Mirror Dimension move 1 space toward him.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: His voice in their heads pulls them closer.

dark_powers.name: Renewed Determination
dark_powers.effect: After his draw action he moves 1 space toward you or the nearest victim.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Whatever he wants, he wants it more now.

dark_powers.name: Master Plan
dark_powers.effect: Punishes having many victims in the Mirror Dimension (exact effect not reported).
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: He has been planning this for years.

minor_dark_powers.name: Interdimensional Interference
minor_dark_powers.effect: Mainly affects you while in the Mirror Dimension (exact effect not reported).
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: The other side scrambles your senses.

minor_dark_powers.name: Interdimensional Focus
minor_dark_powers.effect: The Finale's draw action resolves twice.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: He sharpens his attention to a single point.

terror_cards.name: It Can Detect Blood
terror_cards.effect: Slayer targets and attacks the Final Girl.
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: He senses every drop you spill.

terror_cards.name: Run! Up That Hill!
terror_cards.effect: Fast movement followed by an attack.
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Running uphill, lungs burning, with him close behind.

killers.notes: Killer action pulls the nearest victim into the Mirror Dimension and attacks his space; moves only when cards say so. Can only be damaged while you are in the Mirror Dimension (Retaliate excepted); lose 1 Health each Upkeep spent there. Open Rift action card needed to cross.
killers.flavour_unofficial: A scientist turned into something from the other side of a rift.

killers.name: The Tormentor

finales.name: No Escape
finales.effect: Traps keep advancing but no new traps spring; she does not attack and locks exits — all exits locked means you lose.
finales.flavour_unofficial: She doesn't fight. She simply locks every door.

finales.name: Game Over
finales.effect: Move > Attack > Move > Attack.
finales.flavour_unofficial: The game is over and she has finally come down to play.

finales.name: The Ultimate Trap
finales.effect: You start in a death trap and she can target you with attacks.
finales.flavour_unofficial: You wake up in the device she made just for you.

dark_powers.name: Endless Traps
dark_powers.effect: A victim is always kept in a trap; running out of traps means you lose.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: There is always another trap, another victim, another test.

terror_cards.name: Click
terror_cards.effect: Opens one of the three locked exits, then draw another Terror card; two of the three also trigger Events. Shuffled in after the 10-card deck is built.
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A mechanical click somewhere in the warehouse. A door, maybe.

terror_cards.name: Let's Open Some of These Boxes
terror_cards.effect: Spend Time before rolling; needs a 5 or 6 to succeed.
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Unboxing has never been this dangerous.

special_cards.name: Infestation Box
special_cards.effect: Victim death trap: 2 damage to the box, then 3 Time to open, then a successful Move action. Each advance adds Horror; completion kills the victim and raises Bloodlust.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: Something inside the box is scratching to get out.

killers.notes: Killer action advances all death traps one step; no standard attacks until the Finale. 7 Victim Death Trap cards and 4 Final Girl Death Trap cards; an unbroken Final Girl trap ends the game. Uses Secret Envelopes.
killers.flavour_unofficial: A puppeteer who prefers you to do the hard work yourself.

killers.name: The Eyeless

finales.name: It Can Hear Everything
finales.effect: Double attack; Noise of 4+ puts the target on you.
finales.flavour_unofficial: Every sound you make is a flare in the dark.

finales.name: No More Running
finales.effect: Double attack; Movement cards are used on victims instead of you.
finales.flavour_unofficial: You can't run any more. It's too close.

finales.name: It Knows My Moves
finales.effect: Double attack; strips Reaction cards quickly.
finales.flavour_unofficial: It has learned how you move, and it's waiting.

finales.name: Epic Finale (name not reported)
finales.effect: Any damage you take kills you outright.
finales.flavour_unofficial: One wrong sound and it's over.

dark_powers.name: Reactive Swipe
dark_powers.effect: Lose 1 Health whenever you run from the Eyeless while it shares your space.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Turn your back on it and it lashes out.

dark_powers.name: Hard Skin
dark_powers.effect: Ignores the first damage it takes each turn.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Your first blow just glances off.

dark_powers.name: Quick Counter
dark_powers.effect: You take damage whenever you attack it, hit or miss (ranged included).
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Hit it and it hits back faster.

minor_dark_powers.name: Fear Senses
minor_dark_powers.effect: Noise resets to 1 instead of 0 during Upkeep.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Even silence isn't silent enough now.

minor_dark_powers.name: Blinding Speed
minor_dark_powers.effect: When a victim is killed, victims in its space must panic; panicking victims die in the Panic phase.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: It moves so fast that people run straight into danger.

terror_cards.name: Unlimited Endurance
terror_cards.effect: Extends the timer but restores damage dealt to the Eyeless (shortens the timer if undamaged).
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It doesn't tire. It doesn't heal slowly either.

terror_cards.name: Is That a Severed Arm
terror_cards.effect: Conditionally draws the next Terror card.
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Something in the sand that used to be someone.

terror_cards.name: How Many Are There
terror_cards.effect: Sand Snake exception: the Killer is attacked first; Bloodlust rises if no victims die.
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: How many of them are there under the ground?

killers.notes: Basic action moves 1 toward target. Tracks Noise (Action cards +1, items +1 or +3; resets in Upkeep); some Terror cards add a noise-dependent second action. Sand Snakes: draw two Sand Snake cards each Killer phase; boulders and exits are safe. Up to 4 Sinkholes.
killers.flavour_unofficial: Blind, enormous and listening for you.

killers.name: Destiny
killers.flavour_unofficial: Death itself, patient and precise, with a plan already made.

killers.name: Grimlash

finales.name: God of Blood and Grain
finales.effect: Grimlash now begins the Killer Phase by resolving the following: Target Final Girl > Move > Attack Twice When revealed, kill all Victims.
finales.flavour_unofficial: He is the god of the reaping, and you are the crop.

finales.name: Ancient Abomination
finales.effect: Grimlash now begins the Killer Phase by resolving the following: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move Twice > Attack Whenever Grimlash resolves Attack, add the Harvest Madness level to Grimlash's Attack Value.
finales.flavour_unofficial: What crawls out of the field is older than the farm.

finales.name: Hunger of the Old Gods
finales.effect: Grimlash now begins the Killer Phase by resolving the following: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move Twice > Attack Twice At the end of the Killer phase, all Victims move 1 space towards Grimlash.
finales.flavour_unofficial: The old gods are hungry, and they've sent their servant.

finales.name: Withered Harbinger
finales.effect: Grimlash now begins the Killer Phase by resolving the following: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack Twice For every space Grimlash moves during the Killer phase, lose 1 Time.
finales.flavour_unofficial: A dried husk of a thing that brings the end with it.

dark_powers.name: Fields of Madness
dark_powers.effect: Your Horror Rolls are modified based on the Harvest Madness level: Level 0 or 1: -1 die (minimum of 1) Level 2: No Effect Level 3: +1 die
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: The fields twist your mind as you run through them.

dark_powers.name: Rite of the Corrupted
dark_powers.effect: During the Upkeep phase, 1 Harvest Madness if Harvest Madness did not increase this turn.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: The rites corrupt anyone who lingers on the farm.

dark_powers.name: Rite of the Old One
dark_powers.effect: Whenever your Harvest Madness increases to a new level, discard the next Terror card.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: The old one stirs whenever your mind slips.

dark_powers.name: Root-Bound Curse
dark_powers.effect: Whenever you resolve Health to either heal or reduce Harvest Madness, Grimlash recovers half that much Health, rounded up.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Roots tangle in your veins and twist every wound.

minor_dark_powers.name: Burning Sickle
minor_dark_powers.effect: Whenever Grimlash deals you damage, also deal 1 Damage to every Victim in your space.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: The sickle burns as it cuts.

minor_dark_powers.name: Flaming Eyes

terror_cards.effect: If the Volk'ar is Visible, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Resolve the Reveal icon.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It drops from the canopy right in front of you.

terror_cards.name: Psy Ops
terror_cards.effect: If the Volk'ar is Visible, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Discard all Track Action cards in your hand. ↓ Place a Movement card faceup and increase Horror level by 1.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It plays with your head before it plays with your body.

terror_cards.name: Savage Upgrade
terror_cards.effect: Reveal the set aside Terror cards, one at a time. Put the first Minor Dark Power card you find into play. ↓ Place a Movement card facedown. ↓ If you did not reveal a Minor Dark Power card, increase Bloodlust by 2.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It reaches for a heavier weapon.

terror_cards.name: Shifting Shadows
terror_cards.effect: Place a Movement card facedown. ↓ Panic all Victims that are alone.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The jungle shadows move in ways shadows shouldn't.

terror_cards.name: Sneak
terror_cards.effect: Increase Horror level by 1. ↓ Place a Movement card facedown.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A branch snaps behind you, quietly.

terror_cards.name: Stealth Blitz
terror_cards.effect: Place a Movement card facedown. ↓ Place a Movement card faceup. ↓ Place a Movement card faceup.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It's over in a flash of blades and leaves.

terror_cards.name: Twisting Shadows
terror_cards.effect: Place a Movement card facedown. ↓ Panic yourself.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Every shadow could be the one with teeth.

special_cards.name: Track Action
special_cards.effect: [Results] 3 Successes: Reveal the Origin card OR 2 other Movement cards 2 Successes: Reveal 2 Movement cards (not the Origin card) 1 Success: Reveal 1 Movement card (not the Origin card) No Successes: Increase Horror level by 1 > Place a Movement card facedown
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: Bent grass, a smear of glowing blood. You're on its trail.

killers.flavour_unofficial: An alien hunter who stalks the jungle for trophies, and you are prey.

killers.name: Raptors

finales.name: Claws Like Knives
finales.effect: Pack moves at full speed and attacks; 1 damage from a Pack attack cannot be blocked.
finales.flavour_unofficial: Every claw is a blade, and every blade finds flesh.

dark_powers.name: Blood Thirsty
dark_powers.effect: Pack Health increases when it kills.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Each kill makes the pack bolder.

dark_powers.name: Pack Conditioning
dark_powers.effect: Raptors in adjacent spaces join the Pack without entering its space.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: They've been trained to close ranks.

dark_powers.name: They're Everywhere
dark_powers.effect: Egg symbols always spawn raptors.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Eggs hatch in every nest on the island.

dark_powers.name: Scaly Hide
dark_powers.effect: Retaliate cannot damage the Pack.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Their hides turn your counter-attacks aside.

minor_dark_powers.name: Survival Instincts
minor_dark_powers.effect: Pack becomes progressively stronger.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: They learn, adapt and grow stronger with every hunt.

minor_dark_powers.name: Predatory Instincts
minor_dark_powers.effect: Pack becomes deadlier.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: They work out exactly where you'll run.

terror_cards.name: They're Stalking Me
terror_cards.effect: Forces you to hold a protection card.
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: You feel them watching from the tall grass.

terror_cards.name: No Escape
terror_cards.effect: Raptors attack, but only in an exit space.
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: They wait at the exits, every one.

terror_cards.name: They're Too Fast
terror_cards.effect: Pack moves faster (up to 3 spaces per boot).
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: They outpace anything on two legs.

terror_cards.name: Pinned Down
terror_cards.effect: Very harmful (exact effect not reported).
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Cornered between rocks with claws on both sides.

killers.notes: The Pack has a combined Health with no cap; raptors that join add their number to it. First Pack kill spawns 0-3 raptors. Raptors move toward the Pack and stop on victims/Final Girl. T-Rex starts in the Dino Pen, escapes via T-Rex symbols, then moves 2 after the Killer and kills what it hits (removes 1 Pack Health per kill). 8 Raptor Spawn cards, 3 Lava cards.
killers.flavour_unofficial: Clever, coordinated and very fast. A pack that hunts like one animal.

killers.name: Mort the Teenage Dirtbag

finales.name: Mort as Baghead
finales.effect: Mort is assigned 12 Health. Mort now begins the Killer Phase by resolving the following: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack ? The number of attacks is equal to 1 plus half the number of unrevealed Clues, rounded up.
finales.flavour_unofficial: A sack over his head and a stolen identity underneath.

finales.name: Mort as the Big Bad Wolf
finales.effect: Mort is assigned 8 Health. Mort now begins the Killer Phase by resolving the following: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack > Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack For each unrevealed Clue, increase Mort's Movement Value by 1.
finales.flavour_unofficial: He's got the costume down. He's got the teeth too.

finales.name: Mort as Dr. Fright
finales.effect: Mort is assigned 8 Health. Mort now begins the Killer Phase by resolving the following: Target Final Girl > Move > Attack x2 When revealed, remove Short Rest and Long Rest from the game. Then remove a 0 Cost Action for each unrevealed Clue (your choice).
finales.flavour_unofficial: A stolen dream doctor's glove, worn by a real nightmare.

finales.name: Mort as Geppetto
finales.effect: Mort is assigned 8 Health. Mort now begins the Killer Phase by resolving the following: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack x2 When revealed, move a Victim to your space for each unrevealed Clue. Then take 1 damage equal to the number of Victims in your space.
finales.flavour_unofficial: He's made himself some puppets. They are not good.

finales.name: Mort as Hans
finales.effect: Mort is assigned 10 Health. Mort now begins the Killer Phase by resolving the following: Target Final Girl > Move > Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack For each unrevealed Clue, increase Mort's Attack Value by 2.
finales.flavour_unofficial: A pig mask from the merch stand and a very real hammer.

finales.name: Mort as the H.U.N.T.E.R.
finales.effect: Mort is assigned 10 Health. Mort now begins the Killer Phase by resolving the following: Target Final Girl > Move > Attack x2 When revealed, randomly discard 1 Item for each unrevealed Clue.
finales.flavour_unofficial: Plastic armour and a red light, wielded like the real thing.

finales.name: Mort as Krampus
finales.effect: Mort is assigned 8 Health. Mort now begins the Killer Phase by resolving the following: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move x2 > Attack When revealed, for each unrevealed Clue, 1 Horror. During the Upkeep phase, roll a die. If the result is more than the Horror level, 1 Horror.
finales.flavour_unofficial: Horns, chains and a very bad attitude about Christmas.

finales.name: Mort as the Ratchet Lady
finales.effect: Mort is assigned ? Health. Mort now begins the Killer Phase by resolving the following: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack x2 Mort's health is 6 plus 2 additional for each unrevealed Clue.
finales.flavour_unofficial: A stolen nurse's uniform and a needle he shouldn't have.

finales.name: Mort as Razorface
finales.effect: Mort is assigned 8 Health. Mort now begins the Killer Phase by resolving the following: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack x2 When revealed, you receive 1 damage per unrevealed Clue.
finales.flavour_unofficial: A face full of nails, some of them real.

finales.name: Mort as the Tormentor
finales.effect: Mort is assigned 6 Health. Mort now begins the Killer Phase by resolving the following: Target Final Girl > Move > Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack x2 After resetting the Time marker each Planning phase, decrease the Time by 1 for each unrevealed Clue, to a minimum of 2.
finales.flavour_unofficial: He's set up a trap of his own at the convention centre.

dark_powers.name: Snitches Get Stitches
dark_powers.effect: After replacing Suspects with Informants from revealing a Clue, roll a die. On a 1-4, kill 1 Informant that was just placed.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: He hates people who talk, and the informants talk.

dark_powers.name: Anonymous Terror
dark_powers.effect: Each unrevealed Clue counts as 2 Clues when the Finale is revealed.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Every clue could mean anything, and he likes it that way.

dark_powers.name: Relentless Paranoia
dark_powers.effect: When saving an Informant, do not reduce the Horror level.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Nobody trusts anybody, and he planned it that way.

dark_powers.name: Toxic Whispers
dark_powers.effect: Roll 1 fewer die when resolving Interrogate or Coerce, to a minimum of 1.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: His whispers make every interview harder.

minor_dark_powers.name: Notorious Reputation
minor_dark_powers.effect: During the Panic phase, any Suspects or Informants in your space will panic. Discard this card when the Finale is revealed OR after resolving a two-star success roll on either an Interrogate or Coerce card (only one Minor Dark Power can be discarded per successful resolution).
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Everyone at the convention has heard of him, and they bolt.

minor_dark_powers.name: Quick Slash
minor_dark_powers.effect: Whenever you reveal a Clue, take 1 damage Discard this card when the Finale is revealed OR after resolving a two-star success roll on either an Interrogate or Coerce card (only one Minor Dark Power can be discarded per successful resolution).
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Every clue costs you a nick from a hidden blade.

minor_dark_powers.name: Stockholm Syndrome
minor_dark_powers.effect: Whenever a Suspect moves, all Informants in that space move wth them. While in a space with a Suspect, Informants will not ollow you and cannot be saved. Discard this card when the Finale is revealed OR after resolving a two-star success roll on either an Interrogate or Coerce card (only one Minor Dark Power can be discarded per successful resolution).
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: The informants feel oddly loyal to the masks.

terror_cards.name: Notorious Reputation
terror_cards.effect: During the Panic phase, any Suspects or Informants in your space will panic. Discard this card when the Finale is revealed OR after resolving a two-star success roll on either an Interrogate or Coerce card (only one Minor Dark Power can be discarded per successful resolution).
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Everyone at the convention has heard of him, and they bolt.

terror_cards.name: Quick Slash
terror_cards.effect: Whenever you reveal a Clue, take 1 damage Discard this card when the Finale is revealed OR after resolving a two-star success roll on either an Interrogate or Coerce card (only one Minor Dark Power can be discarded per successful resolution).
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Every clue costs you a nick from a hidden blade.

terror_cards.name: Stockholm Syndrome
terror_cards.effect: Whenever a Suspect moves, all Informants in that space move wth them. While in a space with a Suspect, Informants will not ollow you and cannot be saved. Discard this card when the Finale is revealed OR after resolving a two-star success roll on either an Interrogate or Coerce card (only one Minor Dark Power can be discarded per successful resolution).
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The informants feel oddly loyal to the masks.

terror_cards.name: A Mask In The Crowd
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Draw Suspect Token Place the Suspect in the space with the largest group of Victims. If tied, place it in the space with more Informants. ↓ Target Victim > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A mask in the crowd is just one of a thousand.

terror_cards.name: Cosplay Photo Op
terror_cards.effect: Move yourself and all Victims 1 space closer to the nearest Suspect. ↓ If you are in a space with a Suspect, lose 3 Time. ↓ 1 Horror
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Everyone wants a picture with the killer cosplayer.

terror_cards.name: "Do You Like Scary Movies?"
terror_cards.effect: Discard all Interrogate and Coerce cards from your hand. ↓ If no cards were discarded, 2 Bloodlust
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The old phone-call question, and it still chills.

terror_cards.name: Everybody's A Suspect
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Anyone in costume could be him. Everyone is in costume.

terror_cards.name: "I Want To See What Your Insides Look Like"
terror_cards.effect: Draw Suspect token Target Final Girl > Move > Attack ↓ If no one was attacked, 1 Horror
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: He wants to look inside you, and he means it literally.

terror_cards.name: Meta Massacre
terror_cards.effect: Draw Suspect token Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack ↓ Repeat this effect 3 times.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: He knows every rule of horror movies, and he breaks them on purpose.

terror_cards.name: Pandemonium
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Screams, a stampede and masks everywhere.

terror_cards.name: Swarm Of Masks
terror_cards.effect: Draw Suspect token Move the matching Suspect toward the closest Suspect (not itself), using Mort's current Movement Value. ↓ Repeat the above effect twice more (resolving Draw Suspect Token each time). ↓ For each space with more than 1 Suspect, 1 Horror (max 3).
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A crowd of identical masks surges forward.

terror_cards.name: Trade-Off
terror_cards.effect: Resolve one of the following: Lose 1 Health Increase 1 Horror Lose 3 Time Discard Interrogate or Coerce ↓ Then, resolve one of the following, but not from the same column as your choice above: Gain 1 Health Decrease 1 Horror Gain 3 Time Take Interrogate or Coerce ↓ Draw Suspect Token Target Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: He offers you a deal. Every option hurts.

killers.flavour_unofficial: A fan with too many masks and far too many movies in his head.

killers.name: Krampus

finales.name: Bamf!
finales.effect: At the beginning of the Killer phase, Krampus must resolve the following action: Place Krampus in the farthest Target's space > Target Final Girl or Victim > 2 Attack
finales.flavour_unofficial: A puff of soot and he's right beside you.

finales.name: Soul Lust
finales.flavour_unofficial: He wants souls, and he takes them warm.

finales.name: Unholy Gifts
finales.effect: Krampus moves to the nearest present, eats it and recovers 2 Health; he moves and attacks twice.
finales.flavour_unofficial: His presents are wrapped in terror and he eats them whole.

finales.name: Past Midnight
finales.flavour_unofficial: It's past midnight now. Christmas is over and so are the rules.

dark_powers.name: Explosive Gifts
dark_powers.effect: Opening presents becomes dangerous.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Shake the box and it ticks.

dark_powers.name: Blood and Cookies
dark_powers.effect: Adds more presents to the board.
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: He leaves a treat on every doorstep. Don't eat it.

dark_powers.name: Tantalizing Gifts
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: The gifts look so very tempting.

dark_powers.name: Never Ending Gifts
dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: There's always one more present under the tree.

minor_dark_powers.name: Demonic Will
minor_dark_powers.effect: Carries 1 bonus Health; while in play his hit can kill you outright.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: He will not be denied.

minor_dark_powers.name: North Pole Magic
minor_dark_powers.effect: Krampus is placed directly in his target's space.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: He moves the way Santa does: impossibly.

minor_dark_powers.name: Anti-Christmas Spirit
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: Every bit of goodwill in the village curdles.

terror_cards.name: Down Through the Chimney
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Soot falls from the fireplace. Something follows it.

terror_cards.name: The Claws are Out (x2)
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: He sharpens them on the sleigh runners.

terror_cards.name: "It has what?"
terror_cards.effect: Increases Krampus's damage against you.
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It has what? It has teeth. It has many teeth.

terror_cards.name: Jingle Kills (x2)
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The bells on his chains ring a very different tune.

terror_cards.name: Coal Balls (x2)
terror_cards.effect: Can kill up to 3 victims or deal 3 damage to you.
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Naughty children get coal, and he throws it hard.

terror_cards.name: "Oh no, he's disguised as Santa!"
terror_cards.effect: Gathers victims into one space.
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The red suit fits a little oddly over the horns.

terror_cards.name: A Silhouette in the Distance (x2)
terror_cards.effect: Weak without presents on the board, but pulls presents toward Krampus.
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A dark shape on the rooftops, carrying a sack.

terror_cards.name: Cursed Caroling (x2)
terror_cards.effect: Throws presents based on his position relative to you.
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The carol turns to a dirge and the presents fly.

terror_cards.name: Demonic Will
terror_cards.effect: Carries 1 bonus Health; while in play his hit can kill you outright.
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: He will not be denied.

terror_cards.name: North Pole Magic
terror_cards.effect: Krampus is placed directly in his target's space.
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: He moves the way Santa does: impossibly.

terror_cards.name: Anti-Christmas Spirit
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Every bit of goodwill in the village curdles.

killers.notes: Pre-finale action: attack his space, move toward victims, then throw a present (lands via panic dice). Victims open presents automatically; Santa presents draw Santa Presents cards (good), Krampus presents draw Krampus Presents cards (bad).
killers.flavour_unofficial: Santa's dark brother, with chains, a basket and a list of his own.

locations.name: Camp Happy Trails

setup_cards.name: Capture the Flag
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Teams in the woods, flags in the trees and nobody counting heads.

setup_cards.name: Meditation Hour
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Quiet time by the water. A little too quiet.

setup_cards.name: Skinny Dipping
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: A moonlit swim, a pile of clothes on the dock.

setup_cards.name: The Bonfire
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Everyone around the fire, and something just beyond its light.

setup_cards.name: Treasure Hunt!
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Clues scattered across camp, and kids scattered with them.

events.name: Boyfriend
events.effect: The Victim closest to you is now your Boyfriend. If the Boyfriend dies in your space, start the next Action phase with 12 Time. If the Boyfriend leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: He means well. He mostly gets in the way.

events.name: Clingy Campers
events.effect: There is no penalty for the first Victim you save during the Action phase. For each additional Victim saved, lose 1 Health.
events.flavour_unofficial: They cling to you like burrs.

events.name: Dark Waters
events.effect: Place the Dark Waters token at the Lake. All Victims at the Lake are killed. Whenever a Victim enters the Lake, they are killed immediately.
events.flavour_unofficial: Something in the lake is pulling swimmers under.

events.name: Deathwish
events.effect: During the Upkeep phase, move the Victim closest to the Killer 1 Space towards it. Do not count Victims currently in the same space as the Killer.
events.flavour_unofficial: One camper seems set on finding the killer first.

events.name: Fresh Meat
events.effect: Place 2 new Victims at the Cabins, 2 new Victims at the Dock, and 2 new Victims at the Firepit. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A fresh busload of campers, right on time for the slaughter.

events.name: Girlfriend
events.effect: The Victim closest to you is now your Girlfriend. She will follow you into the Killer's space. While she is in your space, roll 1 extra die for each Horror roll. If the Girlfriend dies while in your space, increase Horror by 5.
events.flavour_unofficial: She's brave, loyal and probably not going to make it.

events.name: Secret Tunnel
events.effect: Choose two of the following spaces (Utility Shed, Cabins, or Docks) and place a Secret Tunnel token at each. You may move between these spaces as if they were adjacent. Enemies cannot use the secret tunnel.
events.flavour_unofficial: An old passage under the camp, half-forgotten and very useful.

events.name: Star Crossed Lovers
events.effect: When exactly 2 Victims are in a space and one of them is killed, the other immediately dies as well.
events.flavour_unofficial: Two kids who only have eyes for each other, at the worst moment.

events.name: Stubborn Kids
events.effect: 1 less Victim will follow you.
events.flavour_unofficial: They refuse to leave. They refuse to listen.

events.name: Vengeance
events.effect: The Victim farthest from the Killer is now The Damned. Whenever the Killer must choose a Target, The Damned is chosen instead. The Damned can only be saved if it is the last Victim alive. If The Damned dies, increase Bloodlust by an additional 2. If The Damned leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Someone has had enough of running and wants payback.

items.name: Aluminum Bat
items.effect: Whenever you inflict damage to the Killer with the Aluminum Bat, you may immediately discard a Minor Dark Power, including any Health markers remaining on the card.
items.flavour_unofficial: A good solid swing and a satisfying clang.

items.name: Archery Bow
items.effect: The Archery Bow cannot modify an Action card and must be used without one. It costs 2 Time to fire an arrow.
items.flavour_unofficial: Silent, accurate, and good for keeping your distance.

items.name: Axe
items.flavour_unofficial: The camp's woodpile tool, repurposed.

items.name: Bear Trap
items.effect: Spend 2 Time to place the Bear Trap token in your space (not the Lake). Discard this card. If the Killer enters the space with the Bear Trap, discard the token and immediately end the Killer phase. The Killer receives 2 Damage.
items.flavour_unofficial: Rusty jaws hidden under the leaves.

items.name: Energy Drink
items.effect: Discard this during the Action phase and choose one of the following: Gain 3 Time or Move 1 Space Wolfe Asylum only: Gain 3 Time or Move 1 Space or Ignore a Side Effects card
items.flavour_unofficial: Sugar, caffeine and a burst of very bad decisions.

items.name: Fireworks
items.effect: Spend 2 Time to place the Fireworks token in your space or an adjacent space (not the Lake). Discard this card. Whenever the Killer must choose a target, they will choose the Fireworks instead. Discard the Fireworks token when the Killer enters the space where it is located.
items.flavour_unofficial: A boom, a flash and a few precious seconds.

items.name: First Aid Kit
items.effect: Every time you use an Action card to recover health, recover an additional Health.
items.flavour_unofficial: Bandages, antiseptic and hope.

items.name: Flashlight
items.effect: Camp Happy Trails Once per Action phase, spend 1 Time to look at the top card of the Terror deck. Leave it or place it at the bottom of the deck. Creech Manor Once per Action phase, for 1 Time you may look at the top card of the Terror deck. Leave it or place it at the bottom of the deck.
items.flavour_unofficial: A narrow beam in a very big dark.

items.name: Knife
items.flavour_unofficial: A kitchen knife, a camping knife, any knife will do.

items.name: Lucky Dice
items.effect: Discard to re-roll any or all of your dice.
items.flavour_unofficial: Roll them again. This time luck is on your side.

items.name: Lucky Rabbit's Foot
items.effect: Discard during the Action phase to make a Horror roll. For each success, choose one of the following: * Gain 2 Time * Restore Health by 1 * Decrease Horror by 1 * Move 1 Space
items.flavour_unofficial: A charm for luck. You'll need every bit of it.

items.name: Map
items.effect: Discard during the Action phase and then, for each deck of Item cards, do one of the following: If the top card is facedown, reveal it. If the top card is faceup, you may remove it from the game and reveal the next card.
items.flavour_unofficial: A camp map with the shortcuts marked in pen.

items.name: Motor Boat Keys
items.effect: Place the Motor Boat token at the closest space to you bordering the water. Spend 2 Time to use the boat to travel to any other space bordering the water. Victims may come with you.
items.flavour_unofficial: A way off the lake, if you can reach the boat.

items.name: Mysterious Pills
items.effect: Discard this during the Action phase and choose one of the following: Decrease Horror by 1 or Restore Health by 2
items.flavour_unofficial: Unlabelled pills from an unlocked cabinet. What could go wrong?

items.name: Old Revolver
items.effect: The Old Revolver may only modify the Weak Attack Action card.
items.flavour_unofficial: Heavy, old and loud enough to make anyone flinch.

items.name: Pepper Spray
items.effect: If the Killer is in your space, you may discard this to immediately end the Killer phase. Ignore their remaining movement, attacks, and any other effects.
items.flavour_unofficial: Right in the eyes, then run.

items.name: Trashcan Lid
items.effect: Ignore a Damage.
items.flavour_unofficial: Dented, smelly and surprisingly good at stopping a blow.

items.name: Whistle
items.effect: Spend 1 Time to use the Whistle, once per Action phase. When used, all Victims adjacent to you will move to your space. Then, all Enemies: Target Final Girl > Move As long as you have the Whistle, one additional Victim will follow you.
items.flavour_unofficial: Loud enough to gather the campers, and everything else.

terror_cards.name: "Fire!"
terror_cards.effect: Roll a die to determine which space bursts into flames: 1-2: Cabins (CHT) Santa's House (SV) 3-4: Utility Shed (CHT) Santa's Workshop (SV) 5-6: Dock (CHT) Stables (SV) ↓ All Victims in that space are killed. Discard all Item cards from that space. If you or an Enemy are there, you each lose 1 Health.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Smoke on the horizon and flames between the cabins.

terror_cards.name: "I fell asleep. What did I miss?"
terror_cards.effect: Place 1 new Victim at the Cabins. ↓ Increase Horror by 2.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Somebody slept through the whole thing and has just wandered out.

terror_cards.name: "Let's go see if the rumors are true!"
terror_cards.effect: Place 2 new Victims in the space where the Killer started the game. ↓ Increase Horror by 1. ↓ Draw the next Event.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Teens head off to investigate the old legend. Bad idea.

terror_cards.name: "Maybe things are starting to go our way!"
terror_cards.effect: Draw the top card of any Item deck.
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Somebody has found something useful at last.

terror_cards.name: "Run for your life!"
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ All Victims that are not in your space must panic. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack ↓ Target Victim > Move
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The scream goes up and everyone scatters.

terror_cards.name: "That girl, What's-Her-Name... She can help us!"
terror_cards.effect: Place 2 new Victims in the space where you started the game. ↓ Increase Horror by 1. ↓ Draw the next Event.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Your reputation precedes you. People come looking.

terror_cards.name: "What's that noise? Let's go and see!"
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ All Victims move 1 space towards the closest Enemy. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack ↓ Target Victim > Move
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A noise in the woods. Of course they go and look.

terror_cards.name: "You can't save us... No one can!"
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ All Victims in your space must panic twice. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack ↓ Target Victim > Move
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: They've given up. Despair is catching.

locations.flavour_unofficial: Lakeside cabins, campfire stories and a very long walk to the road.

locations.name: Creech Manor

setup_cards.name: Creepshow
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: A spooky show put on by the family. The audience isn't all alive.

setup_cards.name: Dancing Queen
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Music in the ballroom and somebody dancing alone.

setup_cards.name: Strange Trophies
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Mounted heads that seem to follow you with their eyes.

setup_cards.name: The Dead Zone
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Some rooms in the house feel colder than death.

setup_cards.name: The Ladder
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: The only way up is a ladder you don't trust.

events.name: Clingy Victims
events.effect: You must have at least 1 Victim follow you if able.
events.flavour_unofficial: They won't let you out of their sight.

events.name: Curiosity Killed the People
events.effect: Place 3 new Victims in the Foyer and panic them immediately. Discard the card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Three people walk in to see what the fuss is about.

events.name: Frozen in Fear
events.effect: Victims will no longer panic during the Panic phase.
events.flavour_unofficial: They're too scared to run. That might help, or not.

events.name: Ghost Hunters
events.effect: Replace the 3 Victims closest to you (or as many as able) with the Special Victim meeples. These Victims will not follow you until one of them has been killed. Each time one of these Victims is killed, increase Bloodlust by 1 more. Discard this card when the last Special Victim leaves play.
events.flavour_unofficial: A team with cameras and EMF meters. They're about to get their footage.

events.name: Helicopter Rescue
events.effect: Place the Helicopter token on the roof of the house. Once during the game, you may move from the Attic to the Helicopter as though they are adjacent. Any Victims (or Carolyn) with you may be saved. Unless you have saved Carolyn, you must return to the Attic and the token must be removed. The Helicopter is not considered an exit space.
events.flavour_unofficial: A chopper circling the roof. A real way out.

events.name: I Ain't Afraid of No Ghost
events.effect: Move each Victim 1 space towards the Attic.
events.flavour_unofficial: Somebody's feeling brave. Somebody's heading upstairs.

events.name: Light's Out
events.effect: Roll 1 fewer dice (minimum of 1) when resolving an Action card that allows movement. Ignore this effect if you have a Flashlight or Candle.
events.flavour_unofficial: The power cuts out and the dark gets heavy.

events.name: Liquid Courage
events.effect: Victims will follow you into the Killer's space.
events.flavour_unofficial: A stiff drink and suddenly they'll follow you anywhere.

events.name: No One Comes Back
events.effect: Place the Skull token in the Attic. All Victims in the Attic are killed. Whenever a Victim enters the Attic, they are killed immediately.
events.flavour_unofficial: The attic. People go up. People do not come down.

events.name: Pushed to the Edge
events.effect: Roll a die for each Victim in a Window Space. If the roll is a 1-4, that Victim jumps and is killed. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: They're at the windows and something wants them out.

items.name: A List of Things in the...
items.effect: Immediately roll a die. 1-2: Garage 3-4: Closet 5-6: Attic (CM) 1-2: Supply Cage 3-4: Receiving Area 5-6: Manager's Office (MW) Reveal all of the Item cards in the associated Item deck, keeping their order the same. Then, discard this card.
items.flavour_unofficial: A scribbled note leading you to something in the house.

items.name: Ancient Text
items.effect: You may lose 1 Health to gain 2 Time.
items.flavour_unofficial: Old words of power that cost something to read.

items.name: Candle
items.effect: Once per Action phase, you may move a Victim from an adjacent space to your space.
items.flavour_unofficial: A small flame to lead someone out of the dark.

items.name: Crucifix
items.effect: Discard to ignore the effects of a single Terror card.
items.flavour_unofficial: Silver and faith, held out at arm's length.

items.name: Energy Drink
items.effect: Discard this during the Action phase and choose one of the following: Gain 3 Time or Move 1 Space Wolfe Asylum only: Gain 3 Time or Move 1 Space or Ignore a Side Effects card
items.flavour_unofficial: Sugar, caffeine and a burst of very bad decisions.

items.name: First Aid Kit
items.effect: Every time you use an Action card to recover health, recover an additional Health.
items.flavour_unofficial: Bandages, antiseptic and hope.

items.name: Flashlight
items.effect: Camp Happy Trails Once per Action phase, spend 1 Time to look at the top card of the Terror deck. Leave it or place it at the bottom of the deck. Creech Manor Once per Action phase, for 1 Time you may look at the top card of the Terror deck. Leave it or place it at the bottom of the deck.
items.flavour_unofficial: A narrow beam in a very big dark.

items.name: Knife
items.flavour_unofficial: A kitchen knife, a camping knife, any knife will do.

items.name: Lucky Dice
items.effect: Discard to re-roll any or all of your dice.
items.flavour_unofficial: Roll them again. This time luck is on your side.

items.name: Lucky Rabbit's Foot
items.effect: Discard during the Action phase to make a Horror roll. For each success, choose one of the following: * Gain 2 Time * Restore Health by 1 * Decrease Horror by 1 * Move 1 Space
items.flavour_unofficial: A charm for luck. You'll need every bit of it.

items.name: Map
items.effect: Discard during the Action phase and then, for each deck of Item cards, do one of the following: If the top card is facedown, reveal it. If the top card is faceup, you may remove it from the game and reveal the next card.
items.flavour_unofficial: A camp map with the shortcuts marked in pen.

items.name: Mysterious Pills
items.effect: Discard this during the Action phase and choose one of the following: Decrease Horror by 1 or Restore Health by 2
items.flavour_unofficial: Unlabelled pills from an unlocked cabinet. What could go wrong?

items.name: Old Revolver
items.effect: The Old Revolver may only modify the Weak Attack Action card.
items.flavour_unofficial: Heavy, old and loud enough to make anyone flinch.

items.name: Padlock
items.effect: Place the Padlock token between any two rooms. Only you and Victims moving with you may move through the Padlock. If an Enemy attacks while in a room adjacent to the Padlock, ignore the attack and remove the Padlock token instead.
items.flavour_unofficial: Locked doors are your friend in this house.

items.name: Ritual Dagger
items.effect: You may discard the Ritual Dagger to kill a Victim in your space (increase Bloodlust as normal). If you do, remove all Minor Dark Power cards from play OR deal 1 Damage to the Killer.
items.flavour_unofficial: A blade meant for rituals, and it still remembers.

items.name: Rope Ladder
items.effect: Discard this card to: remove the Broken Ladder token OR to place the Rope Ladder token in a room with a one-way movement arrow. Movement is now to and from the space.
items.flavour_unofficial: A way down, or a way up, when the stairs fail.

items.name: Shotgun
items.effect: The Shotgun cannot modify an Action card and must be used without one. Once per turn, you may discard 2 cards from your hand and roll 6 dice. Deal 1 Damage to each enemy in your space for each Success rolled. If at least half of the dice are blank, discard the Shotgun.
items.flavour_unofficial: Two barrels and a lot of noise.

items.name: Trashcan Lid
items.effect: Ignore a Damage.
items.flavour_unofficial: Dented, smelly and surprisingly good at stopping a blow.

terror_cards.name: "It's a fake!"
terror_cards.effect: Discard a random Item. If you have no Items, discard and draw the next Terror card. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It looked so real. It wasn't.

terror_cards.name: "It's broken!"
terror_cards.effect: Place the Broken Ladder token covering the ladder on the board. The ladder may no longer be used and the spaces connected to it are no longer considered adjacent. ↓ Increase Horror by 1.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The ladder snaps and the way is cut off.

terror_cards.name: "It's coming. It's coming!"
terror_cards.effect: Target Final Girl > Move Three Times ↓ Kill one Victim in each space the Killer passes through including its current and final spaces.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Something rushes down the hall toward you.

terror_cards.name: "Something is coming through the wall!"
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: All Victims panic. ↓ Any Victims that exit through a window are killed. ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Plaster bulges and cracks as it pushes through.

terror_cards.name: "Something unholy happened in the..."
terror_cards.effect: Roll a die. Depending on the result, place the Killer in that room. 1-2: Attic 3-4: Closet 5-6: Ballroom ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The house remembers what happened in that room.

terror_cards.name: "The trees are alive!"
terror_cards.effect: If you are in a Window Space, then lose 1 Health. All Victims in a Window Space are killed. ↓ If at least one Victim was killed, increase Horror by 1. ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Branches scratch at the windows and then reach inside.

terror_cards.name: "The windows and doors just slammed shut!"
terror_cards.effect: If you are inside, you may not move during the next Action phase. If you are outside, you may not enter the house during the next Action phase. ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Bang, bang, bang. Every door in the house at once.

terror_cards.name: "Voices... I hear voices!"
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: All Victims able to move up to the next floor do so. ↓ Increase Horror by 1. ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Whispers in the walls, calling your name.

locations.flavour_unofficial: A creaking mansion of locked rooms, hidden stairs and restless air.

locations.name: Sacred Groves

setup_cards.name: Dueling Tour Guides
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Two rival guides competing for the biggest crowd.

setup_cards.name: Family Day
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Families, strollers and far too many people to protect.

setup_cards.name: Mob O' Tourists
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: A coachload of tourists spilling everywhere at once.

setup_cards.name: Swamp Thing
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Something stirs in the swamp at the edge of the groves.

setup_cards.name: Worship Service
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: A service at the shrine draws a crowd and a god's attention.

events.name: Closed for Maintenance
events.effect: When this card is revealed, you may discard ALL Action cards except Atonement to close a Sacred space. If you do, place the CLOSED token on the Sacred space of your choice. Move any Victims there to adjacent spaces of your choice (evenly distributed). Victims may no longer move into the space for any reason, but you and all Enemies may continue to move to and from the space as normal.
events.flavour_unofficial: Some paths are roped off. Some exits are closed.

events.name: Fire and Brimstone
events.effect: Roll a die and place the Fire and Brimstone token on the: 1-2: Burial Grounds 3-4: Sacred Shrine 5-6: Holy Groves Each Victim in that space counts as 2 Victims when calculating Divine Wrath Increases.
events.flavour_unofficial: Fire falls from a clear sky.

events.name: Flash Photography
events.effect: Whenever at least 1 Victim in your space panics, discard 1 random Action card.
events.flavour_unofficial: The flash of a camera and a very angry god.

events.name: Hallowed Ground
events.effect: Roll a die and place the Hallowed Ground token on the: 1-2: Burial Grounds 3-4: Sacred Shrine 5-6: Holy Groves Anytime you end the Action phase on that space, gain 2 Time.
events.flavour_unofficial: One patch of ground is still truly holy.

events.name: Loud and Obnoxious
events.effect: Whenever Divine Wrath Increases, Increase it by an additional 1.
events.flavour_unofficial: Some tourists just can't keep their voices down.

events.name: The Gods Hate Failure
events.effect: Whenever you completely fail a Horror roll (after conversions and rerolls), Increase Divine Wrath by 1.
events.flavour_unofficial: Fail in front of the gods and they remember.

events.name: The Holy Man
events.effect: The Victim farthest from the Killer is now the Holy Man. The Holy Man will not follow you. Every Upkeep phase, move the Holy Man one space towards the Killer. When the Holy Man is in the same space as the Killer, immediately remove him from the board. If you were in his space, Decrease Killer Wrath and Divine Wrath to 1. If you were not in his space, Increase Killer Wrath and Divine Wrath by a total of 10 (your choice). If the Holy Man leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A wise man who knows the old ways.

events.name: The Tour Guide
events.effect: The Victim closest to you is the Tour Guide. Once per turn, whenever you move at least 1 space, you may move an additional space as long as the Tour Guide remains with you for your entire movement. If the Tour Guide is killed, Increase Divine Wrath by 6. If the Tour Guide leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: She knows every path, and she won't stop talking.

events.name: The Uber Tourist
events.effect: The Victim farthest from the Killer is now the Uber Tourist. Whenever the Killer must choose a Target, the Uber Tourist is chosen instead. If the Uber Tourist is saved, Decrease Divine Wrath or Killer Wrath by 4. If the Uber Tourist is killed, Increase Divine Wrath by 4. If the Uber Tourist leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A tourist with an influencer's ego and zero sense.

events.name: Unholy Bloodshed
events.effect: Anytime at least 1 Victim is killed at a Sacred space, Unleash Divine Wrath.
events.flavour_unofficial: Blood spilled at the shrine stains more than stone.

items.name: Airhorn
items.effect: For 1 Time you may panic all Victims in your space or an adjacent space.
items.flavour_unofficial: One blast and every tourist in earshot runs.

items.name: Aluminum Bat
items.effect: Whenever you inflict damage to the Killer with the Aluminum Bat, you may immediately discard a Minor Dark Power, including any Health markers remaining on the card.
items.flavour_unofficial: A good solid swing and a satisfying clang.

items.name: Ceremonial Dagger
items.effect: Whenever you damage the Killer, choose Killer Wrath or Divine Wrath and Decrease by 1.
items.flavour_unofficial: A holy blade that chooses whose wrath it feeds.

items.name: Energy Drink
items.effect: Discard this during the Action phase and choose one of the following: Gain 3 Time or Move 1 Space Wolfe Asylum only: Gain 3 Time or Move 1 Space or Ignore a Side Effects card
items.flavour_unofficial: Sugar, caffeine and a burst of very bad decisions.

items.name: First Aid Kit
items.effect: Every time you use an Action card to recover health, recover an additional Health.
items.flavour_unofficial: Bandages, antiseptic and hope.

items.name: Incense
items.effect: Whenever Killer Wrath or Divine Wrath Increases, Increase by 1 less (for a minimum Increase of 1).
items.flavour_unofficial: The smoke soothes angry gods, a little.

items.name: Map
items.effect: Discard during the Action phase and then, for each deck of Item cards, do one of the following: If the top card is facedown, reveal it. If the top card is faceup, you may remove it from the game and reveal the next card.
items.flavour_unofficial: A camp map with the shortcuts marked in pen.

items.name: Mysterious Pills
items.effect: Discard this during the Action phase and choose one of the following: Decrease Horror by 1 or Restore Health by 2
items.flavour_unofficial: Unlabelled pills from an unlocked cabinet. What could go wrong?

items.name: Old Rifle
items.effect: The Old Rifle can only modify the Weak Attack Action card. If you are at a Sacred space, +2 to the maximum range.
items.flavour_unofficial: A rifle that's been in the gift shop for decades.

items.name: Out of Order Signs
items.effect: For 1 Time, place or retrieve an Out of Order token on a connection between your space and an adjacent one. Victims will not pass through unless they are following you.
items.flavour_unofficial: Rope off the paths and steer the crowds.

items.name: Pepper Spray
items.effect: If the Killer is in your space, you may discard this to immediately end the Killer phase. Ignore their remaining movement, attacks, and any other effects.
items.flavour_unofficial: Right in the eyes, then run.

items.name: Prayer Book
items.effect: When you play Atonement, add 1 Success to your roll.
items.flavour_unofficial: Words of atonement for when the gods are angry.

items.name: Shaman's Bones
items.effect: Look at the next Terror card and either place it on the top or bottom of the Terror deck.
items.flavour_unofficial: Bones that rattle out the future.

items.name: Trashcan Lid
items.effect: Ignore a Damage.
items.flavour_unofficial: Dented, smelly and surprisingly good at stopping a blow.

items.name: Tribal Mask
items.effect: Whenever you receive damage, choose Killer Wrath or Divine Wrath and Decrease by the amount of damage received.
items.flavour_unofficial: Wear the god's face and share his favour.

items.name: War Club
items.effect: Whenever you inflict damage with the War Club, choose Killer Wrath or Divine Wrath and Decrease it by the damage inflicted.
items.flavour_unofficial: Heavy, carved and made for exactly this.

items.name: Whip
items.effect: (SG) 0-1 (MW) If you damage an Enemy with the Whip, you may move them 1 space.
items.flavour_unofficial: Crack it and they jump.

terror_cards.name: Fickleness of the Gods
terror_cards.effect: Place this card next to the Divine Wrath card. At the end of the Upkeep phase, make a Horror roll. ↓ 2 Successes: Decrease Divine Wrath or Killer Wrath by 1. 1 Success: No effect. No Successes: Unleash Divine Wrath. Increase Divine Wrath by # of Victims at Sacred spaces. You may spend 3 Time during the Action phase to discard this card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The gods change their minds on a whim.

terror_cards.name: Fury of the Gods
terror_cards.effect: Draw an Event card. ↓ Increase Divine Wrath by # of Victims at Sacred spaces. ↓ Unleash Divine Wrath ↓ Increase Divine Wrath by # of Victims at Sacred spaces.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The sky darkens and the gods let loose.

terror_cards.name: "If I climb on top of that statue I can get a killer selfie!"
terror_cards.effect: Increase Divine Wrath by # of Victims at Sacred spaces. ↓ Unleash Divine Wrath ↓ Place 2 new Victims at the Burial Grounds. ↓ All Victims adjacent to the Burial Grounds move there.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A tourist climbs the statue for a selfie. The god sees.

terror_cards.name: "Let me just carve my initials right here..."
terror_cards.effect: Increase Divine Wrath by # of Victims at Sacred spaces. ↓ Unleash Divine Wrath ↓ Place 2 new Victims at the Sacred Shrine. ↓ All Victims adjacent to the Sacred Shrine move there.
