terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Someone carves their name into sacred wood.

terror_cards.name: "No one will notice if I break off one of these pretty branches..."
terror_cards.effect: Increase Divine Wrath by # of Victims at Sacred spaces. ↓ Unleash Divine Wrath ↓ Place 2 new Victims at the Holy Groves. ↓ All Victims adjacent to the Holy Groves move there.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A tourist snaps off a sacred branch as a souvenir.

terror_cards.name: Punishment of the Gods
terror_cards.effect: Unleash Divine Wrath ↓ Unleash Divine Wrath ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack ↓ Draw an Event card
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The gods punish the whole grove for the sins of a few.

terror_cards.name: Rage of the Gods
terror_cards.effect: Draw an Event card ↓ Increase Divine Wrath by # of Victims at Sacred spaces. ↓ Place the Killer at the Sacred space with the most Victims or in your space if none remain. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack Twice
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Rage in heaven means trouble on earth.

terror_cards.name: Tourist Trap
terror_cards.effect: All Victims adjacent to a Sacred space move there. ↓ Increase Divine Wrath by # of Victims at Sacred spaces. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The tourists stray too close to the sacred places.

locations.flavour_unofficial: A holy place full of tourists, statues and an angry river god.

locations.name: Carnival of Blood

setup_cards.name: Boxed In
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Every way out of the tent has been blocked.

setup_cards.name: Center Stage
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Somebody's in the spotlight, and it isn't the clown.

setup_cards.name: Late for the Show
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: The audience is trickling in, and the show has already started.

setup_cards.name: No Laughing Matter
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: The clowns have stopped being funny.

setup_cards.name: Ring Around the Rosie
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: A circle of children's games played on blood-stained sawdust.

events.name: Animal Panic!
events.effect: Each time the Horror level increases, roll a number of dice equal to the new Horror level and do the following: For each Success you may move a Victim of your choice 1 space. For every two dice that are not a Success kill one Victim.
events.flavour_unofficial: The animals break loose in a panic.

events.name: Clowns Everywhere
events.effect: During the Upkeep phase, Victims in The Big Top and any adjacent spaces panic. If they panic into the space with an Enemy, they are killed immediately.
events.flavour_unofficial: There are clowns in every shadow.

events.name: "Did you follow me here?"
events.effect: Place 4 new Victims at The Big Top. One of them is a Special Victim who is your plucky younger Sibling. While the Sibling is in your space, you may spend 2 Time to reroll one die. If the Sibling dies, increase Bloodlust by 1. If the Sibling leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Familiar faces turn up at the carnival. Did they follow you?

events.name: Employee Transport
events.effect: Place the Golf Cart token in any of the 4 corner spaces. During Upkeep: You and/or up to 2 Victims in the space with the Golf Cart may drive it up to 2 spaces, but the Golf Cart must stay on the outer path. If the Golf Cart is driven into a space with an Enemy, you may discard it to do 3 Damage to that Enemy.
events.flavour_unofficial: A golf cart for staff, keys left in.

events.name: Full Moon
events.effect: The Victim farthest from you is the world's hairiest man and is actually a Werewolf! The Werewolf will not follow you and cannot be targeted, saved, or killed. During Upkeep: panic the Werewolf. Then he does 2 Damage to one target in his space according to the following priority: Victim > You > Minion > Killer
events.flavour_unofficial: The moon is up and one of the carnies is changing.

events.name: "How dangerous can it be?"
events.effect: During the Upkeep phase, each Victim moves 1 space towards the closest Trap token.
events.flavour_unofficial: Every ride looks fun. Every ride is deadly.

events.name: It's Not Real
events.effect: Place 4 new Victims at the House of Mirrors. Place the Skull token at the Forest of Horrors. Any Victims at or moving into the Forest of Horrors are killed immediately.
events.flavour_unofficial: Your own reflection lies to you.

events.name: Mirrors Everywhere
events.effect: If you attack and there are one or more Victims in your space, a Victim dies for every 1 you roll.
events.flavour_unofficial: Which one is real? Hit the wrong one and glass rains down.

events.name: "Run! I'll hold them off!"
events.effect: The Victim closest to you is your Fiancé. If an Enemy would move into your space while the Fiancé is there, instead kill the Fiancé and the Enemy stays where they are. If your Fiancé is killed by a trap, increase Horror by 5.
events.flavour_unofficial: Someone you love steps up to take the hit for you.

events.name: So Much Junk
events.effect: When this card is revealed, find the Zappo Item card and put it in your backpack. Reset the Item deck(s) if necessary. If you lose Zappo, roll one fewer dice (minimum 1) when resolving Search Action cards for the remainder of the game.
events.flavour_unofficial: Somewhere in all this junk, a monkey is up to something.

items.name: Hidden Cobra Trap
items.effect: Put this next to your Final Girl card. During Upkeep: Lose 1 Health. The next time you recover health, you must instead discard this card.
items.flavour_unofficial: A coiled shape in a basket. It's alive.

items.name: Knockout Gas Trap
items.effect: You fall asleep! Immediately end the Action phase and set the Time marker to zero. Recover 1 Health from a good rest.
items.flavour_unofficial: A hiss, a sweet smell, and darkness.

items.name: Steel Bear Trap
items.effect: Lose 1 Health. You must spend 2 Time to remove the trap from your leg and cannot move again until you do.
items.flavour_unofficial: Steel jaws close round your ankle.

items.name: Aluminum Bat
items.effect: Whenever you inflict damage to the Killer with the Aluminum Bat, you may immediately discard a Minor Dark Power, including any Health markers remaining on the card.
items.flavour_unofficial: A good solid swing and a satisfying clang.

items.name: Bullwhip
items.effect: If you damage an Enemy with the Bullwhip, you may move them 1 space.
items.flavour_unofficial: The ringmaster's whip, perfect for keeping things at bay.

items.name: Crystal Ball
items.effect: Once per Action phase, roll a die. 1-4: Nothing happens. 5-6: Look at the next Terror card and place it on either the top or bottom of the Terror deck.
items.flavour_unofficial: The fortune teller's ball shows you what's coming.

items.name: Disguise & Makeup Kit
items.effect: When an Enemy specifically targets the Final Girl, you may use the Disguise & Makeup Kit to treat yourself as a Victim. The Enemy will then targe the nearest Victim instead.
items.flavour_unofficial: Greasepaint and a wig. Nobody looks twice at a clown.

items.name: Energy Drink
items.effect: Discard this during the Action phase and choose one of the following: Gain 3 Time or Move 1 Space Wolfe Asylum only: Gain 3 Time or Move 1 Space or Ignore a Side Effects card
items.flavour_unofficial: Sugar, caffeine and a burst of very bad decisions.

items.name: First Aid Kit
items.effect: Every time you use an Action card to recover health, recover an additional Health.
items.flavour_unofficial: Bandages, antiseptic and hope.

items.name: Found Footage
items.effect: Discard the Found Footage to cancel the effects of one Item Trap or Terror Trap card. If cancelling a Terror Trap card, discard the card without applying ANY of the card's effects.
items.flavour_unofficial: A tape that shows how the traps work.

items.name: Knife
items.flavour_unofficial: A kitchen knife, a camping knife, any knife will do.

items.name: Knife Bandolier
items.effect: When using the Knife Bandolier, you may divide the damage as you choose between any Enemies within range.
items.flavour_unofficial: A belt of throwing knives from the knife-thrower's act.

items.name: Mysterious Pills
items.effect: Discard this during the Action phase and choose one of the following: Decrease Horror by 1 or Restore Health by 2
items.flavour_unofficial: Unlabelled pills from an unlocked cabinet. What could go wrong?

items.name: Old Revolver
items.effect: The Old Revolver may only modify the Weak Attack Action card.
items.flavour_unofficial: Heavy, old and loud enough to make anyone flinch.

items.name: Pepper Spray
items.effect: If the Killer is in your space, you may discard this to immediately end the Killer phase. Ignore their remaining movement, attacks, and any other effects.
items.flavour_unofficial: Right in the eyes, then run.

items.name: Strongman Hammer
items.effect: You must have 4 or more Health to attack with the Strongman Hammer. It cannot be carried in your backpack. After resolving an attack with this weapon: Lose 1 Health > End Action Phase.
items.flavour_unofficial: The strongman's hammer. You'd better be strong too.

items.name: Super Lucky Dice
items.effect: Use this to reroll any or all the dice. Then, roll one die and do the following: 1-4: Discard this card. 5-6: Keep this card.
items.flavour_unofficial: The house never wins with these.

items.name: Telescoping 10' Pole
items.effect: Once per Action phase you may skip one space when moving. No effects are triggered in the skipped space and no Victims may follow you into or beyond the skipped space.
items.flavour_unofficial: A long pole for reaching the unreachable.

items.name: Throwing Axe
items.effect: You may use this to attack an Enemy in an adjacent space. If you do, discard it after resolving the attack.
items.flavour_unofficial: One flick of the wrist and it's across the tent.

items.name: Trashcan Lid
items.effect: Ignore a Damage.
items.flavour_unofficial: Dented, smelly and surprisingly good at stopping a blow.

items.name: Zappo the Carnival Monkey
items.effect: You may use Zappo to resolve a Search card from up to 2 spaces away from a Search space. If you use Zappo and an Item Trap is revealed, he flees in terror. Ignore the effects of the trap and discard Zappo.
items.flavour_unofficial: A clever monkey who knows where everything is hidden.

terror_cards.name: "I'm all wrapped up and I can't get free!"
terror_cards.effect: Target Final Girl > Move > Attack ↓ Place the Rope Trap token in your space. Immediately apply the trap's effects (see the Terror Trap Reference card) to you and any Victims in your space. ↓ If a Walk or Sprint card was discarded: Increase Horror by 2. [Trap Effect] Discard 1 Action card at random.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Ropes wrap tight round you and won't let go.

terror_cards.name: "It burns. It burns!"
terror_cards.effect: Place the Acid Trap token in your space. Immediately apply the trap's effects (see the Terror Trap Reference card) to you and any Victims in your space. ↓ Increase Horror by 2. [Trap Effect] You lose 1 Health.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The air fills with acid and the floor starts to sizzle.

terror_cards.name: "Where the hell did the blades come from?"
terror_cards.effect: Place the Spinning Floor Blade Trap token in your space. Immediately apply the trap's effects (see the Terror Trap reference card) to you and any Victims in your space. ↓ For each 1-4 that you rolled, increase Horror by 1. [Trap Effect] Roll 2 dice. For each result do the following: 1-4: You take 1 Damage. 5-6: You may move 1 space.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Spinning blades rise out of the stage.

terror_cards.name: "How can there be so many traps?"
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Item Trap cards in the Item discard pile, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Take all facedown card from the Item decks and all discard Item Trap cards and shuffle them together. Then, evenly distribute them back to the Item decks and place the faceup Items back on top. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack ↓ Increase Horror by 1.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: There's a trap under every board in this place.

terror_cards.name: "How did the tiger get loose?"
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard this card and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ All Victims panic. ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack ↓ Do the following for the Animal Cages space and all spaces adjacent to it: Victims there are killed. Enemies there take 1 Damage. If you are there, lose 1 Health.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A roar, a crash, and a tiger loose on the midway.

terror_cards.name: "Is this a prop?"
terror_cards.effect: Draw an Event card. ↓ Discard a random Item card. If you have none, discard the top card from the nearest Item deck. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: You reach for it. It's not a prop.

terror_cards.name: Misty Ambush
terror_cards.effect: All Victims at or adjacent to the Forest of Horrors panic. For any 1's rolled, the Victim is killed. ↓ If at least one Victim is killed, increase Horror by 1. ↓ If no Victims were killed, resolve the next Terror card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Mist rolls out of the trees and takes people with it.

terror_cards.name: Welcome to the Greatest Show
terror_cards.effect: Draw an Event card ↓ All Victims move 1 space closer to The Big Top ↓ Place the Killer at The Big Top ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack > Move
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The ringmaster's voice booms and everyone moves where he wants.

special_cards.name: Hidden Cobra Trap
special_cards.effect: Put this next to your Final Girl card. During Upkeep: Lose 1 Health. The next time you recover health, you must instead discard this card.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: A coiled shape in a basket. It's alive.

special_cards.name: Steel Bear Trap
special_cards.effect: Lose 1 Health. You must spend 2 Time to remove the trap from your leg and cannot move again until you do.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: Steel jaws close round your ankle.

special_cards.name: Knockout Gas Trap
special_cards.effect: You fall asleep! Immediately end the Action phase and set the Time marker to zero. Recover 1 Health from a good rest.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: A hiss, a sweet smell, and darkness.

special_cards.name: "Where the hell did the blades come from?"
special_cards.effect: Place the Spinning Floor Blade Trap token in your space. Immediately apply the trap's effects (see the Terror Trap reference card) to you and any Victims in your space. ↓ For each 1-4 that you rolled, increase Horror by 1. [Trap Effect] Roll 2 dice. For each result do the following: 1-4: You take 1 Damage. 5-6: You may move 1 space.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: Spinning blades rise out of the stage.

special_cards.name: "It burns. It burns!"
special_cards.effect: Place the Acid Trap token in your space. Immediately apply the trap's effects (see the Terror Trap Reference card) to you and any Victims in your space. ↓ Increase Horror by 2. [Trap Effect] You lose 1 Health.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: The air fills with acid and the floor starts to sizzle.

special_cards.name: "I'm all wrapped up and I can't get free!"
special_cards.effect: Target Final Girl > Move > Attack ↓ Place the Rope Trap token in your space. Immediately apply the trap's effects (see the Terror Trap Reference card) to you and any Victims in your space. ↓ If a Walk or Sprint card was discarded: Increase Horror by 2. [Trap Effect] Discard 1 Action card at random.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: Ropes wrap tight round you and won't let go.

locations.flavour_unofficial: A travelling carnival where the attractions bite back.

locations.name: Maple Lane

setup_cards.name: A Quiet Place
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Everyone's shut indoors and the street is dead silent.

setup_cards.name: Block Party
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Tables on the lawns, music on the street, a perfect target.

setup_cards.name: Maple Lane
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Just another night on Maple Lane, which is the problem.

setup_cards.name: Revenge
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Somebody on this street has a long memory.

setup_cards.name: Playtime
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Kids playing in the yards long past bedtime.

events.name: Boyfriend
events.effect: Place this Special Victim in the Boyfriend's House. This is your Boyfriend! If the Killer would target you, the Killer instead targets the Boyfriend. During Upkeep, move the Boyfriend 2 spaces towards you. Then, if the Boyfriend is in your space, lose 2 Time.
events.flavour_unofficial: He shows up when you least need him, and of course you can't leave him.

events.name: Fire!
events.effect: Roll a die and place the Fire token in: 1-3: The Boyfriend's House 4-6: The Smalley's House Any Victims in the House Space or that panic into the House Space are killed. You or Enemies in the House Space take 1 damage. The House Space may no longer be entered or searched.
events.flavour_unofficial: A house goes up in flames and the street turns orange.

events.name: Friendly Neighbors
events.effect: Roll +1 Dice when resolving Convince Action cards.
events.flavour_unofficial: The neighbours are surprisingly willing to listen tonight.

events.name: It's Raining
events.effect: Panic Victims in the Intersection. Then, move every Victim that is on a Street space to its adjacent House Space.
events.flavour_unofficial: Rain hammers down and the street floods with panic.

events.name: "It's the 4th of July!"
events.effect: Move all Victims inside a House Space to the adjacent Street space.
events.flavour_unofficial: Fireworks, flags and the whole street out on the lawns.

events.name: Officer Kopp
events.effect: Place the Cop Car token on the Exit Space of your choice. Each Upkeep, move it one space towards the opposite exit. Victims in the space with the Cop Car will move with it and are considered saved when they reach the Exit Space.
events.flavour_unofficial: A squad car on the corner and a cop who's seen everything.

events.name: Party in the Burbs!
events.effect: Place 4 new Victims in any House Space that contains at least one Victim. If none do, place them in the Intersection.
events.flavour_unofficial: Somebody's throwing a party, and the whole street's invited.

events.name: The Smalleys
events.effect: Place 2 Special Victims in the Smalley's House. Each time one of the Smalleys is killed, +1 Bloodlust.
events.flavour_unofficial: The family next door, the Smalleys, need saving too.

events.name: Under Construction
events.effect: Roll a die and place a Roadblock token on the following Exit Space: 1: West 2: East 3: North 4: South 5: East or West 6: North or South Victims may not be saved from that space.
events.flavour_unofficial: Road works have blocked a way out.

events.name: "What is going on over there?"
events.effect: Place 1 new Victim on each Exit Space.
events.flavour_unofficial: The commotion draws people from every end of the street.

items.name: Archery Bow
items.effect: The Archery Bow cannot modify an Action card and must be used without one. It costs 2 Time to fire an arrow.
items.flavour_unofficial: Silent, accurate, and good for keeping your distance.

items.name: Bible
items.effect: +2 Dice when resolving a Convince Action card.
items.flavour_unofficial: Scripture helps when you need to talk someone round.

items.name: Bicycle
items.effect: When you take this card, place the Bicycle token on the Street space adjacent to you. If you do not have any items in your hands and you are with the Bicycle, you may move yourself and it to any other Street space on the board once per turn.
items.flavour_unofficial: Pedals and a bell. The fastest thing on Maple Lane.

items.name: Crucifix
items.effect: Discard to ignore the effects of a single Terror card.
items.flavour_unofficial: Silver and faith, held out at arm's length.

items.name: Energy Drink
items.effect: Discard this during the Action phase and choose one of the following: Gain 3 Time or Move 1 Space Wolfe Asylum only: Gain 3 Time or Move 1 Space or Ignore a Side Effects card
items.flavour_unofficial: Sugar, caffeine and a burst of very bad decisions.

items.name: Fireworks
items.effect: Spend 2 Time to place the Fireworks token in your space or an adjacent space (not the Lake). Discard this card. Whenever the Killer must choose a target, they will choose the Fireworks instead. Discard the Fireworks token when the Killer enters the space where it is located.
items.flavour_unofficial: A boom, a flash and a few precious seconds.

items.name: Knife
items.flavour_unofficial: A kitchen knife, a camping knife, any knife will do.

items.name: Lucky Dice
items.effect: Discard to re-roll any or all of your dice.
items.flavour_unofficial: Roll them again. This time luck is on your side.

items.name: Machete
items.effect: Victims will not follow you while the Machete is in your hand.
items.flavour_unofficial: A long blade that scares the neighbours as much as the doctor.

items.name: Megaphone
items.effect: Once per Action phase, you may move any Victim on the board 1 space. ↓ Killer (S1) or All Enemies (S3) target Final Girl > Move
items.flavour_unofficial: Bellow instructions and people actually move.

items.name: Odds and Ends
items.effect: If you are in a House, you may place a Booby Trap token in it (one per House). If an Enemy moves into the House, discard the token and the Enemy takes 2 Damage.
items.flavour_unofficial: A drawer of spare odds and ends, good for traps.

items.name: Pitchfork
items.effect: Discard at any time to prevent the damage from a single attack.
items.flavour_unofficial: Garden tools are surprisingly good at keeping something at bay.

items.name: Rifle
items.effect: The Rifle cannot modify an Action card and must be used without one. Spend 2 Time to make a Horror roll. Success: Deal 2 Damage to one Enemy on a Street space within range.
items.flavour_unofficial: Dad's hunting rifle, kept in the garage.

items.name: Trashcan Lid
items.effect: Ignore a Damage.
items.flavour_unofficial: Dented, smelly and surprisingly good at stopping a blow.

terror_cards.name: "Did you hear what happened on Maple Lane?"
terror_cards.effect: Draw an Event card. ↓ Draw an Event card. ↓ Draw the next Terror card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Word gets round fast on Maple Lane.

terror_cards.name: "I said don't look back!"
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Exit spaces that have at least 1 Victim, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Place the Killer on any Exit space that has at least 1 Victim. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Whatever you do, don't turn around.

terror_cards.name: "It came right through the yard!"
terror_cards.effect: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack ↓ If the Killer is in a House space, move it to any other House space in the quadrant with a Victim. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It tore straight through the fence and kept coming.

terror_cards.name: "It's too quiet..."
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: No dogs barking, no cars passing. Just quiet.

terror_cards.name: Road Closed for Construction
terror_cards.effect: Place a Roadblock token on the Exit space closest to you. ↓ Victims may not be saved at that Exit space. ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Cones and barriers where the exit used to be.

terror_cards.name: "They just got hit by a car!"
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims in any Street spaces, discard and draw another Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ 1 Victim in a Street space of your choice is killed. ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Brakes screech in the dark and someone doesn't get up.

terror_cards.name: "They told us to hide!"
terror_cards.effect: Increase Horror by 1. ↓ Place 1 new Victim in each House space that is not connected to an Exit space. ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Someone told them to hide. Someone was wrong.

terror_cards.name: "We are all gonna die!"
terror_cards.effect: Target Victim > Move > Attack ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack ↓ If any Victims are killed, increase Bloodlust by 2.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Someone says it, and the panic spreads like fire.

locations.flavour_unofficial: A sleepy suburban street where everyone has something to hide and nobody sleeps soundly.

locations.name: USS Konrad

setup_cards.name: Bloody Feast
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Somebody's been feeding on the crew in the mess hall.

setup_cards.name: Born in Flames
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: The engine room is on fire, and something is moving inside it.

setup_cards.name: Junction Danger
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: The corridors meet at a junction that's very easy to ambush.

setup_cards.name: Showdown
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: The crew gathers on the bridge for a last stand.

setup_cards.name: Space Rave
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: A party in the cargo bay with the music turned all the way up.

events.name: Cluttered Shafts
events.effect: While moving, you may move through an inactive Maintenance Shaft at the cost of 1 Health. Victims cannot follow you if you move in this manner.
events.flavour_unofficial: The shafts are full of junk, but there's just room to squeeze through.

events.name: Cramped Escape Pods
events.effect: If there is more than 1 Victim in an Exit space, you cannot save Victims in that space.
events.flavour_unofficial: The pods weren't built for this many people.

events.name: Emergency Override
events.effect: The Incinerator, Airlock, and Self Destruct all require one less Keycard to activate.
events.flavour_unofficial: Every emergency system on the ship is suddenly yours to command.

events.name: Faulty Wiring
events.effect: During the Upkeep phase, roll one die for the Furnace and one for the Trash Compactor. 1-2: Everyone at that space loses 1 Health. 3-6: No effect.
events.flavour_unofficial: Sparks fly from every panel and the lights are dying.

events.name: Good Cookin'
events.effect: Whenever you end the Action phase in the Mess Hall, recover 1 Health.
events.flavour_unofficial: There's a hot meal in the galley and the smell gives you strength.

events.name: Jonas the Cat
events.effect: Place the Special Victim meeple with the Victim that is farthest from you. This is Jonas. Jonas will not follow you. During the Upkeep phase, panic Jonas three times. If you end the Action phase in the same space as Jonas, you may choose one of the following: Lose 1 Horror or Gain 3 Time If Jonas the Cat leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: The ship's cat is somewhere aboard, and you can't leave him.

events.name: Master Access
events.effect: If any of the top cards of each Item deck are facedown, flip them faceup. Take any Keycard Item cards that are showing.
events.flavour_unofficial: The master keys open every locker on the ship.

events.name: Orphan Girl
events.effect: The Victim closest to you is now the Orphan Girl. While the Orphan Girl is in your space, +1 Victims will follow you and you may freely move through inactive Maintenance Shafts. If the Orphan Girl dies, gain 3 Horror. If the Orphan Girl leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A girl who survived when no one else did. She's tougher than she looks.

events.name: The Captain
events.effect: Place the Special Victim meeple on the Bridge. This is the Captain. While he is at the Bridge, it costs one less Keycard to activate the Self Destruct. If the Captain dies, +2 Bloodlust. If the Captain leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: The captain is still at her post, and she's not going without her crew.

events.name: Weapons Locker
events.effect: Look through the unused Item cards and place any weapons in the Armory's Item deck, either faceup on top of facedown underneath.
events.flavour_unofficial: The armoury is unlocked. Help yourself.

items.name: Emergency Access
items.effect: Move to an adjacent space through an inactive Maintenance Shaft.
items.flavour_unofficial: An emergency hatch that only opens one way.

items.name: Energy Drink
items.effect: Discard this during the Action phase and choose one of the following: Gain 3 Time or Move 1 Space Wolfe Asylum only: Gain 3 Time or Move 1 Space or Ignore a Side Effects card
items.flavour_unofficial: Sugar, caffeine and a burst of very bad decisions.

items.name: Flamethrower
items.effect: All damage must be distributed evenly between Victims, Enemies, and you (in that order) in the space that is attacked.
items.flavour_unofficial: Fire in a corridor, fire in a vent, fire everywhere.

items.name: Keycard
items.effect: Place a Keycard Token on this card when you take it. During the Action phase, you may place a Keycard Token on the Maintenance card (if your current space has a Gear Symbol) or on an adjacent Maintenance Shaft.
items.flavour_unofficial: A swipe card that opens doors to the rest of the ship.

items.name: Motion Tracker
items.effect: Roll +1 Dice when resolving a Scan card. Whenever an Enemy enters your space, you may discard the Motion Tracker to immediately move to an adjacent space. Any remaining Enemy movement is lost.
items.flavour_unofficial: A steady beep that gets faster when something is near.

items.name: Mysterious Pills
items.effect: Discard this during the Action phase and choose one of the following: Decrease Horror by 1 or Restore Health by 2
items.flavour_unofficial: Unlabelled pills from an unlocked cabinet. What could go wrong?

items.name: Personal Beacon
items.effect: Once per Action phase, you may trigger the following Killer Action: Target Final Girl > Move One Time
items.flavour_unofficial: A blinking light that tells everyone where you are.

items.name: Remote Access
items.effect: During the Action phase, you may move any Keycard Token on the board to either another Maintenance Shaft or a Maintenance card.
items.flavour_unofficial: Seal doors and vent rooms from the console.

items.name: Remote Beacon
items.effect: Spend 2 Time to place the Beacon token on any space up to three spaces from you. Whenever the Killer must choose a target, they will choose the Beacon instead. Discard the Beacon token when the Killer enters the space where it is located.
items.flavour_unofficial: Leave a little light in the dark to lure it away.

items.name: Remote Monitor
items.effect: Once per Action phase, you may look at the top card of the Terror or Ambush deck. Leave it or place it at the bottom of the deck.
items.flavour_unofficial: A camera feed to see what's in the next room.

items.name: Ship's Manifest
items.effect: While in a Search Space, discard the Ship's Manifest to look through that space's Item deck. Place the cards in any order that you wish, leaving the top card faceup.
items.flavour_unofficial: The cargo list says exactly where the good stuff is.

items.name: Super Loader
items.effect: When you have the Super Loader equipped: * Victims will not follow you. * Reduce all movement by 1, to minimum of 1. * Reduce all damage taken by 1, to minimum of 1. * You cannot play Short/Long Rest or Search.
items.flavour_unofficial: A walking exosuit, built for crates and now for fighting.

items.name: Super Loader Key
items.effect: If you are in the same space as the Super Loader, you may take and equip the Super Loader Item card.
items.flavour_unofficial: The key to the Super Loader, and the start of a fair fight.

items.name: Thermal Visor
items.effect: Discard to ignore an Ambush card and draw another. Whenever an Enemy enters your space, you may discard any 2 Action cards to take an available Guard Reaction card into your hand.
items.flavour_unofficial: Heat shows up in the dark. So does it.

items.name: Vibroclaw
items.effect: Whenever you successfully reduce damage from an attack with a Reaction card, deal +1 Damage to your attacker.
items.flavour_unofficial: A pneumatic claw for gripping cargo, or anything else.

minor_dark_powers.name: Slippery
minor_dark_powers.effect: The Killer can freely move through all Maintenance Shafts.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: It slides through the ducts as if they were greased.

terror_cards.name: Slippery
terror_cards.effect: The Killer can freely move through all Maintenance Shafts. Bonus Health: 2
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It slides through the ducts as if they were greased.

terror_cards.name: Catastrophic Hull Breach
terror_cards.effect: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move Once > Attack Once ↓ The farthest Exit space from you has a hull breach. Place the Skull token there. Anyone (Victims, Enemies, and you) that is in or enters that space is instantly killed. If the Killer dies this way, reveal their Final Health token. If they came back to life, place them at the Junction ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The hull tears open and the void pulls at everything.

terror_cards.name: Garbage Day
terror_cards.effect: All Victims adjacent to the Trash Compactor panic. ↓ Everyone at the Trash Compactor receives -1 Health. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The compactor groans, and anyone near it is in trouble.

terror_cards.name: Gas Leak
terror_cards.effect: Roll a die to determine which Maintenance Shaft(s) leak toxic gas: 1: Upper Left and Right 2: Lower Left and Right 3: Upper Left 4: Upper Right 5: Lower Left 6: Lower Right ↓ Everyone in a space adjacent to an affected Maintenance Shaft loses 1 Health. ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A hiss from the maintenance shafts, and the air goes bad.

terror_cards.name: Incinerator Malfunction
terror_cards.effect: All Victims adjacent to the Furnace panic. ↓ Roll a die for everyone at the Furnace and apply the following. 1: Lose 2 Health 2-4: Lose 1 Health 5: No effect. 6: Move 1 space in any direction (your choice). ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The furnace roars to life without anyone touching it.

terror_cards.name: "Let's test the maintenance shafts."
terror_cards.effect: For this turn only, all Enemies can freely move through any Maintenance Shafts. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move Twice > Attack ↓ For each Enemy that moved through a Maintenance Shaft this turn, raise Horror by 1.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A shortcut through the shafts seems like a good idea. It isn't.

terror_cards.name: Solar Interference
terror_cards.effect: Remove all Keycards from the board and all Maintenance cards. Then roll a die for each Keycard and place it as follows: 1: Upper Left Maintenance Shaft 2: Crusher 3: Upper Right Maintenance Shaft 4: Lower Right Maintenance Shaft 5: Incinerator 6: Lower Left Maintenance Shaft ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Static fills the comms and every keycard is wiped.

terror_cards.name: System Reboot
terror_cards.effect: Take all Keycards on the board and on any Maintenance cards and return them to their Keycard Item cards. ↓ If at least one Keycard is returned, raise Horror by 2 ↓ Draw an Event card
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The ship shuts down, and all the access is reset.

locations.flavour_unofficial: A long-haul freighter drifting in the black with a stowaway on board.

locations.name: Station 2891

setup_cards.name: A Nice Stew
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: A pot of stew on the stove and everyone crowded around.

setup_cards.name: Clear the Grounds
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Snow clearing duty outside, in the dark and the cold.

setup_cards.name: Good Morning
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: First light, coffee, and no one's realised yet.

setup_cards.name: Quittin Time
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: End of shift, and the crew are scattered.

setup_cards.name: R & R
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Rest and recreation in the rec room. Nobody's watching the door.

events.name: "Chow time!"
events.effect: The Victim nearest to the Kitchen is now the Chef. During Upkeep, if you and the Chef are in the Kitchen, take either 1 Health or -1 Horror. If the Chef is killed, gain 2 Horror. If the Chef leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: The cook is serving up, and everyone wants a bowl.

events.name: Comms Specialist
events.effect: The Victim closest to (but not in) the Radio Room is now the Comms Specialist. If the Comms Specialist is in the Radio Room, once per Action phase you may roll a die. On a roll of 5 or 6 you may move the Helicopter one space. If the Comms Specialist is killed, discard 2 Action cards of your choice. If the Comms Specialist leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Someone who knows the radio and can maybe call for help.

events.name: "Don't worry! We're here to help!"
events.effect: If the Helicopter has any Victims on board, discard this and draw a new Event. Otherwise, place the Helicopter on the landing pad. Place 3 new Victims in the space with the Helicopter and then panic them first as a group, and then once individually. If any are adjacent to an indoor space, move them to that space. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A helicopter crew arrives full of good intentions.

events.name: Heavy Storm
events.effect: When moving outside, all of your moves are panicked. You may spend 1 Time to reroll, as many times as you wish and can afford.
events.flavour_unofficial: A whiteout storm makes every step outside a struggle.

events.name: Hidden Weapons Cache
events.effect: Shuffle the Armory tokens and place one facedown in each of the four outdoor spaces, excluding the Exit space. If you move into one of these spaces, reveal the token. If the token has an "X", discard it with no effect. If the token has a gun, this is the Armory. This space may now be searched. Take all the Weapon cards from the unused Item cards and shuffle them to create an Armory Item deck. Do NOT reveal the top card. If there are no items left in the Item deck or no Weapon cards in the unused items, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Someone stashed guns around the station, just in case.

events.name: "Pair up!"
events.effect: Remove all of the Victims that are alone in a space from the board and place them 2 at a time in the following locations until none are left: Kitchen, Radio Room, Rec Room, Lab. If there are an odd number of Victims, add one new Victim before placing the final two. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Nobody goes anywhere alone. Not any more.

events.name: "Someone pulled the fire alarm!"
events.effect: You and all Victims in the main building panic. You may spend 2 Time to keep yourself from panicking. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Alarms scream and everyone is forced out into the snow.

events.name: "There's been an accident in the lab!"
events.effect: An explosion has occurred in the Lab! Anyone in the Lab immediately takes 1 Damage. Place the "Hole" token over the bottom wall of the Lab. The Lab is now adjacent to the outdoor space next to it. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: The lab goes up in a burst of glass and smoke.

events.name: "What's up doc?"
events.effect: Choose a Victim. That Victim is now the Doctor. If you are in the same room as the Doctor during the Upkeep phase, gain 2 Health. If the Doctor is killed, +1 Bloodlust. If the Doctor leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: The doctor will see you now, and might patch you up.

events.name: "Who goes there?"
events.effect: Several scientists arrive from another station. Place one new Victim in each outdoor space other than the Exit. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: New arrivals from a neighbouring station, and nobody knows them.

items.name: Axe
items.flavour_unofficial: The camp's woodpile tool, repurposed.

items.name: Char the Alaskan Malamute
items.effect: When an Enemy enters your space, deal 1 Damage to it. The next time you take damage, ignore it and discard this card instead. This ally is not considered in your Backpack, but this card may be kept there.
items.flavour_unofficial: A huge, loyal sled dog who will throw himself at any threat.

items.name: Crucifix
items.effect: Discard to ignore any Horror level increase or to end an Enemy's movement when they're in an adjacent space.
items.flavour_unofficial: Silver and faith, held out at arm's length.

items.name: First Aid Kit
items.effect: Every time you use an Action card to recover health, recover an additional Health.
items.flavour_unofficial: Bandages, antiseptic and hope.

items.name: Flamethrower
items.effect: All damage must be distributed evenly between Victims, Enemies, and you (in that order) in the space that is attacked.
items.flavour_unofficial: Fire in a corridor, fire in a vent, fire everywhere.

items.name: Flare Gun
items.effect: May only be used with Weak Attack. If damage is dealt to the Killer, lose 1 Horror. Alternatively, may be used when outdoors to move all Victims that are outdoors one space closer to you. (Station 2891) Alternatively, discard a Tracking marker and all Victims within 3 spaces move one space closer to you. (Utopia)
items.flavour_unofficial: One flare, one shot, one chance to be seen.

items.name: Knife
items.flavour_unofficial: A kitchen knife, a camping knife, any knife will do.

items.name: List of Things
items.effect: Immediately roll a die. 1-2: Supply Closet 3-4: Tool Shed 5-6: Commander's Hut Reveal all of the Item cards in the associated Item deck, keeping their order the same. Then, discard this card.
items.flavour_unofficial: A scrawled note pointing you toward supplies.

items.name: Lucky Dice
items.effect: Discard to re-roll any or all of your dice.
items.flavour_unofficial: Roll them again. This time luck is on your side.

items.name: Old Revolver
items.effect: The Old Revolver may only modify the Weak Attack Action card.
items.flavour_unofficial: Heavy, old and loud enough to make anyone flinch.

items.name: Roller Skates
items.effect: When resolving movement, do not count hallways as spaces. Move one fewer space when starting your movement outdoors (minimum 1). This item is not considered in you Backpack, but the card may be kept there.
items.flavour_unofficial: Faster down the corridors, if you don't fall over.

items.name: Skidozer Keys
items.effect: You may now use the Skidozer. The Skidozer token must remain outdoors. It may be used for either of the following effects: Move to any outdoor space OR when in the outdoor space just outside the Lab, place the "Hole" token there which makes those two spaces adjacent.
items.flavour_unofficial: A snowmobile key and a chance to get away.

items.name: Thule the Alaskan Malamute
items.effect: When an Enemy enters your space, deal 1 Damage to it. The next time you take damage, ignore it and discard this card instead. This ally is not considered in your Backpack, but the card may be kept there.
items.flavour_unofficial: A big, brave dog who won't let anything near you.

items.name: Two-Way Radio
items.effect: Use to move a Victim one space at the cost of 1 Time. May not be used on the same Victim more than once in a single turn.
items.flavour_unofficial: Crackle, hiss, and a voice telling someone where to go.

terror_cards.name: "It's happy hour!"
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims in play, discard this card and draw another Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Panic all Victims that are indoors. Then, move all Victims from each hallway to the Rec Room. ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack ↓ Increase Frostbite > Move Helicopter
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Somebody's opened the bar. Bad timing.

terror_cards.name: "It's not safe in here!"
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: They're not safe inside, and outside is worse.

terror_cards.name: "Tell me where it is!"
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims in play, discard this card and draw another Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ For each Victim in your space, you may look through one Item deck. Place any Item faceup on the deck and shuffle the others facedown underneath. ↓ Increase Horror by 1 ↓ Increase Frostbite > Move Helicopter
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Tempers snap and people turn on each other.

terror_cards.name: "The generator is out."
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The generator dies and the cold creeps in.

terror_cards.name: "They... just left."
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: They were here a minute ago. Their coats are still on the hook.

terror_cards.name: "We can't stay here"
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims in play, discard this card and draw another Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Panic all Victims that are indoors. Then, panic all Victims that are in a hallway. ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack ↓ Increase Frostbite > Move Helicopter
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Nobody wants to stay, but out there is death.

terror_cards.name: "We'll be dead by morning."
terror_cards.effect: Choose One: +2 Horror OR +1 Bloodlust ↓ Choose One: Panic all Victims OR Panic yourself ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move ↓ Increase Frostbite > Move Helicopter
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Somebody says it, and nobody can argue.

terror_cards.name: "What supplies are in the chopper?"
terror_cards.effect: If the Helicopter is at Station 2891 and you are on an outdoor space, you may take 2 random Item cards from the ones that are out of play. ↓ Draw an Event ↓ Target Final Girl > Move > Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack ↓ Increase Frostbite > Move Helicopter
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Somebody's thinking about the chopper's cargo.

locations.flavour_unofficial: An Antarctic research station where the radio is dead and the trust is gone.

locations.name: Wingard Cottage

setup_cards.name: Couples Weekend
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Two couples, one cottage, and a romantic getaway that goes very wrong.

setup_cards.name: Dysfunctional Family
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: A family that can't stop arguing, which is bad timing.

setup_cards.name: Fishing Trip
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: The boys went fishing and left the lights on.

setup_cards.name: Grad Party
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: A graduation party with a lot of guests and an open door.

setup_cards.name: Special Occasion
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: It's somebody's birthday, and the masks are a surprise.

events.name: Another Way Out
events.effect: Place the Boat token in the Lake and the Neighbor in the Family Room. The Neighbor has the keys to the Boat. When the Neighbor is on the Lakefront, they and up to 3 other Victims on that space may exit and be saved. If the Neighbor leaves play, discard this card and the Boat.
events.flavour_unofficial: There's a boat at the lake and a car in the drive.

events.name: Battle Ready
events.effect: Take the Item cards set aside during setup. Reveal one at a time until either a weapon is revealed (take this Item), or until there are no more of the set aside Item cards to reveal. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: You've been preparing for this. Time to arm up.

events.name: Booby Traps
events.effect: All Victims inside the house panic. Any Victim leaving the house is killed. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Someone has been rigging the house with traps.

events.name: Brainstorming
events.effect: Randomly select 2 Crafted Item cards from the unused Crafted Items. They are now available to Craft. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Pool your ideas and work out what to build.

events.name: Escape Attempt
events.effect: The Victim closest to the Driveway is going to make a run for the exit. Roll 1 die. If the result is a 5 or 6, the Victim moves one space closer to the Driveway (even if there is a Killer on the space). If the result is 1-4, the Victim dies. Repeat until the Victim either reaches the Driveway (where they are automatically saved) or is killed. Discard the card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Someone makes a run for the car.

events.name: Getting Resourceful
events.effect: Crafting requires 1 less Time.
events.flavour_unofficial: You're getting good at making weapons out of nothing.

events.name: Home Security
events.effect: Keep this card until you use it. It can be activated during any Action phase when there are no Enemies in the home. When activated, Enemies are not allowed to enter the house. When an Enemy tries to enter the house, place a token on this card, and they don't move. The alarm is disabled when there are 3 tokens on this card, or when you or a Victim enter or leave the house. If the alarm is disabled, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: An alarm system that might just buy you a second.

events.name: Kick-Scooter
events.effect: Place the Scooter token on the outdoor space closest to you. When you are with the Scooter it moves with you, but it must be left on the last outdoor space if you move indoors. Once per Action phase, you may use the Scooter to move up to 2 spaces. Victims cannot follow you during this movement.
events.flavour_unofficial: A child's scooter, but it's faster than running.

events.name: Loser Boyfriend
events.effect: The Victim farthest from you is your Boyfriend, who has been secretly helping the Killer. The Boyfriend cannot be targeted or killed by Enemies, but you may attack and kill him. If you kill the Boyfriend, lose 3 Horror and do not increase Bloodlust. If the Boyfriend leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: He's useless, but you can't just leave him.

events.name: Marked for Death
events.effect: Place the Outsider in the Bathroom. Whenever the Killer must choose a Target, the Outsider is chosen instead. On its way towards the Outsider, the Killer kills one Victim in each space it moves through, including its starting and ending spaces. If the Outsider leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A stranger in the bathroom who seems to know what's coming.

items.name: 1/8" Chisel
items.effect: Roll 1 die after each use. One a 1-4, discard the Chisel.
items.flavour_unofficial: A tiny chisel that won't last long.

items.name: Blender
items.effect: Can only be used in the house. Discard after use.
items.flavour_unofficial: Not a weapon, but in the kitchen it'll have to do.

items.name: Blueprint
items.effect: Discard the Blueprint to select a Crafted Item card from the unused Crafted Items. It is now available the Craft.
items.flavour_unofficial: Plans for something you can build with what's lying around.

items.name: Energy Drink
items.effect: Discard this during the Action phase and choose one of the following: Gain 3 Time or Move 1 Space Wolfe Asylum only: Gain 3 Time or Move 1 Space or Ignore a Side Effects card
items.flavour_unofficial: Sugar, caffeine and a burst of very bad decisions.

items.name: Fireplace Poker
items.flavour_unofficial: Hot from the fire and heavy in the hand.

items.name: First Aid Kit
items.effect: Every time you use an Action card to recover health, recover an additional Health.
items.flavour_unofficial: Bandages, antiseptic and hope.

items.name: Knife
items.flavour_unofficial: A kitchen knife, a camping knife, any knife will do.

items.name: Lucky Rabbit's Foot
items.effect: Discard during the Action phase to make a Horror roll. For each success, choose one of the following: * Gain 2 Time * Restore Health by 1 * Decrease Horror by 1 * Move 1 Space
items.flavour_unofficial: A charm for luck. You'll need every bit of it.

items.name: Map
items.effect: Discard during the Action phase and then, for each deck of Item cards, do one of the following: If the top card is facedown, reveal it. If the top card is faceup, you may remove it from the game and reveal the next card.
items.flavour_unofficial: A camp map with the shortcuts marked in pen.

items.name: Mysterious Pills
items.effect: Discard this during the Action phase and choose one of the following: Decrease Horror by 1 or Restore Health by 2
items.flavour_unofficial: Unlabelled pills from an unlocked cabinet. What could go wrong?

items.name: Shotgun
items.effect: The Shotgun cannot modify an Action card and must be used without one. Spend 1 Time to make a Horror Roll. Success: Deal 3 Damage to 1 Enemy within range.
items.flavour_unofficial: Two barrels and a lot of noise.

items.name: Trashcan Lid
items.effect: Ignore a Damage.
items.flavour_unofficial: Dented, smelly and surprisingly good at stopping a blow.

items.name: Wooden Bat
items.flavour_unofficial: A trusty bat from the garage.

items.name: Discarded Tools
items.effect: Used for Crafting. 1 Time to pick up.
items.flavour_unofficial: Old tools rusting in the shed.

items.name: Nails
items.effect: Used for Crafting. 1 Time to pick up.
items.flavour_unofficial: A jar of nails. You can always build something with nails.

items.name: Rope
items.effect: Used for Crafting. 1 Time to pick up.
items.flavour_unofficial: A coil of rope from the shed. It'll be useful for something.

items.name: Wood
items.effect: Used for Crafting. 1 Time to pick up.
items.flavour_unofficial: Planks and offcuts from the woodpile.

items.name: Disemboweler (Wooden Bat, Knife, Rope and 2 Time)
items.effect: Recipe: Wooden Bat, Knife, Rope and 2 Time After applying damage to the targeted Enemy, -1 Horror for each other Enemy on the same, or adjacent space.
items.flavour_unofficial: Blades taped to a bat. The name says it all.

items.name: Nail Bat (Wooden Bat, Nails and 2 Time)
items.effect: Recipe: Wooden Bat, Nails and 2 Time.
items.flavour_unofficial: A bat studded with nails. Classic.

items.name: Nail Trap (Wood, Nails, Discarded Tools and 2 Time)
items.effect: Recipe: Wood, Nails, Discarded Tools and 2 Time You may place a Nail Trap token on your space (one per space) during the Action phase for 1 Time. If an Enemy enters a space with a Nail Trap, discard the token and Enemy takes 1 Damage.
items.flavour_unofficial: A board studded with nails and hidden in the grass.

items.name: Nailgun (Nails, Discarded Tools and 2 Time)
items.effect: Recipe: Nails, Discarded Tools and 2 Time At range 1, Nailgun cannot modify an Action card and must be used without one. Spend 1 Time to deal 1 Damage. At range 0, Nailgun modifies the Action card, adding 1 Damage to the attack.
items.flavour_unofficial: A nailgun with the safety disabled.

items.name: Porcupine (Trashcan Lid, Nails and 2 Time)
items.effect: Recipe: Trashcan Lid, Nails and 2 Time Ignore a Damage and deal 1 Damage to the Enemy who attacked.
items.flavour_unofficial: A bin lid bristling with nails. It bites back.

items.name: Sawed-Off Shotgun (Shotgun, Discarded Tools and 2 Time)
items.effect: Recipe: Shotgun, Discarded Tools and 2 Time The Sawed-Off Shotgun cannot modify an Action card and must be used without one. Spend 1 Time to deal 3 Damage to the primary target and 2 Damage to other Enemies on the same space.
items.flavour_unofficial: The barrels cut short for close quarters.

items.name: Snare (Rope, Wood and 1 Time)
items.effect: Recipe: Rope, Wood and 1 Time You may place a Snare token on your space (one per space) during the Action phase for 1 Time. If an Enemy enters a space with a Snare, discard this token and they can no longer move until the end of the turn.
items.flavour_unofficial: A noose of rope hidden underfoot.

items.name: Spear (Knife, Wood and 2 Time)
items.effect: Recipe: Knife, Wood and 2 Time Whenever you damage an Enemy, you may move them to an adjacent space.
items.flavour_unofficial: A knife lashed to a pole. Primitive and effective.

items.name: Spiked Slingshot (Nails, Rope and 2 Time)
items.effect: Recipe: Nails, Rope and 2 Time The Spiked Slingshot may only modify Weak Attack and Furious Strike Action cards. Do not discard Spiked Slingshot after 3 uses. During the Action phase, you may discard Nails to replenish all uses.
items.flavour_unofficial: A slingshot that fires nails. Nasty.

items.name: The Obliterator (Wood, Rope, Discarded Tools, Nails and 4 Time)
items.effect: Recipe: Wood, Rope, Discarded Tools, Nails and 4 Time The Obliterator may not be used to modify Reaction cards and all movement is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 1). When used, receive -1 Health for each "1" in your final Horror roll result.
items.flavour_unofficial: Everything you could find, bolted together into one terrible weapon.

terror_cards.name: "Is Tammy home?"
terror_cards.effect: Place the Killer at the Porch. ↓ +1 Horror
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A polite knock and a question about someone who doesn't live here.

terror_cards.name: "Now get the hell out of my house!"
terror_cards.effect: If you are not in the house, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Draw an Event card. ↓ Place the Killer in your space. If Weak Attack is in your hand, you may play and resolve it. Otherwise: ↓ Target Final Girl > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Your house, your rules, and you've had enough.

terror_cards.name: "Oh my god. What is happening to us?"
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Nobody has any idea what's happening, and that's the scariest part.

terror_cards.name: "That wasn't a random attack"
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack ↓ +1 Horror
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: They chose this house. They chose you.

terror_cards.name: "There's someone out there"
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Target Victim > Move Twice ↓ +1 Horror
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A shape at the edge of the porch light.

terror_cards.name: "They can't get in here. Right?"
terror_cards.effect: Place 2 new Victims in the Bedroom. ↓ +1 Horror
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: You hide in the bedroom and hope the lock holds.

terror_cards.name: "We were passing by and thought we heard a scream."
terror_cards.effect: Place 2 new Victims at the Porch ↓ +1 Horror ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Neighbours heard screaming and came to help. Oh no.

terror_cards.name: "What happened while we were gone?"
terror_cards.effect: Place 3 new Victims at the Boathouse. ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Somebody's back from the boathouse with no idea what's going on.

special_cards.name: Rope
special_cards.effect: Used for Crafting. 1 Time to pick up.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: A coil of rope from the shed. It'll be useful for something.

special_cards.name: Nails
special_cards.effect: Used for Crafting. 1 Time to pick up.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: A jar of nails. You can always build something with nails.

special_cards.name: Wood
special_cards.effect: Used for Crafting. 1 Time to pick up.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: Planks and offcuts from the woodpile.

special_cards.name: Discarded Tools
special_cards.effect: Used for Crafting. 1 Time to pick up.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: Old tools rusting in the shed.

special_cards.name: Nail Trap
special_cards.effect: Uses: 3 Recipe: Wood, Nails, Discarded Tools and 2 Time You may place a Nail Trap token on your space (one per space) during the Action phase for 1 Time. If an Enemy enters a space with a Nail Trap, discard the token and Enemy takes 1 Damage.
special_cards.recipe: Wood, Nails, Discarded Tools and 2 Time
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: A board studded with nails and hidden in the grass.

special_cards.name: Spiked Slingshot
special_cards.effect: Range: 1 Damage: 1 Hands: 2 Uses: 3 Recipe: Nails, Rope and 2 Time The Spiked Slingshot may only modify Weak Attack and Furious Strike Action cards. Do not discard Spiked Slingshot after 3 uses. During the Action phase, you may discard Nails to replenish all uses.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: A slingshot that fires nails. Nasty.

special_cards.name: Nail Bat
special_cards.effect: Range: 0 Damage: 2 Hands: 2 Recipe: Wooden Bat, Nails and 2 Time.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: A bat studded with nails. Classic.

special_cards.name: The Obliterator
special_cards.effect: Range: 0 Damage: 3 Hands: 2 Recipe: Wood, Rope, Discarded Tools, Nails and 4 Time The Obliterator may not be used to modify Reaction cards and all movement is reduced by 1 (to a minimum of 1). When used, receive -1 Health for each "1" in your final Horror roll result.
special_cards.recipe: Wood, Rope, Discarded Tools, Nails and 4 Time
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: Everything you could find, bolted together into one terrible weapon.

special_cards.name: Spear
special_cards.effect: Range: 0 Damage: 1 Hands: 2 Recipe: Knife, Wood and 2 Time Whenever you damage an Enemy, you may move them to an adjacent space.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: A knife lashed to a pole. Primitive and effective.

special_cards.name: Snare
special_cards.effect: Uses: 3 Recipe: Rope, Wood and 1 Time You may place a Snare token on your space (one per space) during the Action phase for 1 Time. If an Enemy enters a space with a Snare, discard this token and they can no longer move until the end of the turn.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: A noose of rope hidden underfoot.

special_cards.name: Nailgun
special_cards.effect: Range: 0-1 Damage: 1 Hands: 1 Uses: 3 Recipe: Nails, Discarded Tools and 2 Time At range 1, Nailgun cannot modify an Action card and must be used without one. Spend 1 Time to deal 1 Damage. At range 0, Nailgun modifies the Action card, adding 1 Damage to the attack.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: A nailgun with the safety disabled.

special_cards.name: Disemboweler
special_cards.effect: Range: 0 Damage: 2 Hands: 2 Recipe: Wooden Bat, Knife, Rope and 2 Time After applying damage to the targeted Enemy, -1 Horror for each other Enemy on the same, or adjacent space.
special_cards.recipe: Wooden Bat, Knife, Rope and 2 Time
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: Blades taped to a bat. The name says it all.

special_cards.name: Porcupine
special_cards.effect: Hands: 1 Uses: 3 Recipe: Trashcan Lid, Nails and 2 Time Ignore a Damage and deal 1 Damage to the Enemy who attacked.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: A bin lid bristling with nails. It bites back.

special_cards.name: Sawed-Off Shotgun
special_cards.effect: Range: 0 Damage: 1* Hands: 1 Uses: 2 Recipe: Shotgun, Discarded Tools and 2 Time The Sawed-Off Shotgun cannot modify an Action card and must be used without one. Spend 1 Time to deal 3 Damage to the primary target and 2 Damage to other Enemies on the same space.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: The barrels cut short for close quarters.

locations.flavour_unofficial: A lakeside cottage with nice furniture, thin walls and a very dark driveway.

locations.name: Storybook Woods

setup_cards.name: Breadcrumb Trail
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: A trail of crumbs leads deeper into the woods.

setup_cards.name: Family Visit
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: The family's come to see Grandma. All of them.

setup_cards.name: Forest Dwellers
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: The woodland folk are out and about tonight.

setup_cards.name: Picnic
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: A blanket, a basket and a clearing in the trees.

setup_cards.name: Scatter!
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Everyone runs in a different direction.

events.name: Breadcrumb Path
events.effect: Choose two of the following spaces: Dell, Meadow, or Clearing. Place a Breadcrumb Path token on them. You may move between these spaces as if they were adjacent. Only you can use the Breadcrumb Path and Victims cannot follow you.
events.flavour_unofficial: A trail of crumbs connects two parts of the woods.

events.name: Fairy Ring
events.effect: All Victims at the Glen disappear, not killed just... somewhere else. Remove them from the game and do not increase Bloodlust. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A ring of mushrooms, and the people in it vanish.

events.name: Furry Friends
events.effect: The woodland creatures realize you are helping keep them safe, but they are making noise wherever you go. The Killer moves 1 space closer to you. The the Killer is in your space or an adjacent space, +1 Bloodlust. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: The animals of the wood are on your side.

events.name: Hansel
events.effect: The Victim closest to you is now Hansel. Once per turn, whenever you move at least 1 space, you may move an additional space as long as Hansel remains with you for your entire movement. At the Gingerbread House, you may replace Hansel with a normal Victim to take any one Item card from the Item deck. If Hansel dies while in your space, +2 Bloodlust. If Hansel leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A boy who knows his way through the woods and leaves breadcrumbs everywhere.

events.name: Harmless Old Woman
events.effect: The Killer is disguised as Grandmother, and the Victims do not realize it! Any Victims in a space adjacent to the Killer moves into the Killer's space. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A sweet old lady on the path. Look closer at her ears.

events.name: Pied Piper
events.effect: Place the Pied Piper in the Village. Any other Victims in the same space as the Pied Piper, now or in the future, are killed. If the Pied Piper leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A piper plays and people follow, whether they want to or not.

events.name: Primrose Flowers
events.effect: Whenever a Victim enters the Meadow or Glen they immediately panic.
events.flavour_unofficial: Pretty flowers with a scent that makes people sleepy.

events.name: The Woodsman
events.effect: The Victim closest to you is now The Woodsman. He will follow you into the Killer's space. When attacking the Killer, the Woodman adds +1 Dice for every 3 Health the Killer has. If you save the Woodsman, double your victim save bonus. If the Woodsman dies while in your space, =3 Time. If the Woodsman leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: An axeman who has been hunting wolves for years.

events.name: Toll Bridge
events.effect: Place the Toll Bridge token anywhere on the river so that it touches two spaces. Those spaces are now adjacent. You must spend 1 Time to cross and an additional Time is a Victim follows you.
events.flavour_unofficial: A troll wants payment before anyone crosses.

events.name: Travelers
events.effect: Place 2 new Victims at the Dell, 2 new Victims at the Meadow, and 2 new Victims at the Clearing. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Travellers walk the forest paths, unaware of what's out there.

items.name: Archery Bow
items.effect: The Archery Bow cannot modify an Action card and must be used without one. It costs 2 Time to fire an arrow.
items.flavour_unofficial: Silent, accurate, and good for keeping your distance.

items.name: Basket
items.effect: Shuffle the unused Item cards and draw 3. Keep the Items that are not weapons.
items.flavour_unofficial: A wicker basket that always seems to have something useful inside.

items.name: Bread
items.effect: Discard during the Action phase and choose one of the following: +3 Time OR Move up to 2 spaces
items.flavour_unofficial: A loaf for the journey, or for laying a trail.

items.name: Cage
items.effect: You may discard this item to retrieve the Songbirds from the Item discard pile or from the unused Item cards.
items.flavour_unofficial: An iron cage that can hold something precious, or someone.

items.name: Candy
items.effect: Discard during the Action phase to make a Horror roll with 5 dice. For each Success, choose one of the following: 2 Health 2 Time Move 1 space
items.flavour_unofficial: Sweets from a gingerbread house. Probably fine.

items.name: Chicken Bones
items.effect: Spend 1 Time to place a Chicken Bones token in your space. If an Enemy enters a space in with Chicken Bones, discard the token and deal 1 Damage to the Enemy.
items.flavour_unofficial: Leftover bones to lure a hungry thing away.

items.name: Flowers
items.effect: May be used once per Action phase (if the Horror level is 2 or higher) for -1 Horror.
items.flavour_unofficial: A bunch of wildflowers that soothes a frightened heart.

items.name: Hatchet
items.effect: You may attack from an adjacent space. If you do, place the Hatchet token in the target's space and this card to the side, out of play. You may discard a Search card while in the space to pick up the Hatchet.
items.flavour_unofficial: A small axe for chopping, or throwing.

items.name: Knife
items.flavour_unofficial: A kitchen knife, a camping knife, any knife will do.

items.name: Lucky Rabbit's Foot
items.effect: Discard during the Action phase to make a Horror roll. For each success, choose one of the following: * Gain 2 Time * Restore Health by 1 * Decrease Horror by 1 * Move 1 Space
items.flavour_unofficial: A charm for luck. You'll need every bit of it.

items.name: Map
items.effect: Discard during the Action phase and then, for each deck of Item cards, do one of the following: If the top card is facedown, reveal it. If the top card is faceup, you may remove it from the game and reveal the next card.
items.flavour_unofficial: A camp map with the shortcuts marked in pen.

items.name: Pitchfork
items.effect: Discard at any time to prevent the damage from a single attack.
items.flavour_unofficial: Garden tools are surprisingly good at keeping something at bay.

items.name: Raft
items.effect: Place each of the 4 Raft tokens so that each is touching both the River and a Raft space. When in one of these spaces, you may use 1 movement to move to any of the other spaces with a Raft token. You must spend 1 Time for each Raft token passed through including the starting and ending tokens.
items.flavour_unofficial: Logs lashed together to cross the river.

items.name: Red Cape
items.effect: For targeting, if there is a tie between you and a Victim, the Killer will target you instead of the Victim.
items.flavour_unofficial: A red hood that draws its eye.

items.name: Slingshot
items.effect: The Slingshot cannot modify an Action card and must be used without one. It can only be used once per round. Do not discard the Slingshot after 2 uses. You may remove a Search card in your hand from the game to replenish the Item's uses.
items.flavour_unofficial: A forked stick and a pocketful of stones.

items.name: Songbirds
items.effect: If the Killer is within two spaces of you, you may spend 3 Time to send the Songbirds to attack, doing 3 Damage to the Killer. Then discard this card.
items.flavour_unofficial: The birds sing a warning when it gets close.

items.name: Thorny Vines
items.effect: Spend 1 Time to place the Thorny Vines token in your space. If the Killer enters a space with the Thorny Vines, discard the token. The Killer takes 2 Damage and the Killer phase immediately ends.
items.flavour_unofficial: A tangle of thorns that slows anything trying to push through.

terror_cards.name: Getting Treats for Grandmother
terror_cards.effect: Take the top card of the Village Item deck. ↓ Target Final Girl > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Someone has gone to fetch treats for Grandma.

terror_cards.name: Have Some Sweets
terror_cards.effect: Place 2 new Victims at the Gingerbread House. ↓ If you are on a Search space you may spend 2 Time to take the top Item card. ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Sweets at the gingerbread house. Who could resist?

terror_cards.name: "I was carried like a rag doll!"
terror_cards.effect: Move the Killer 3 spaces towards Grandmother's House, picking up and moving 1 Victim with the Killer if able. ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It snatches someone up and carries them off like a doll.

terror_cards.name: "It picked me up and I was helpless!"
terror_cards.effect: Move the Killer 2 spaces towards Grandmother's House, picking up and moving 1 Victims with the Killer if able. ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It grabs someone and there's nothing they can do.

terror_cards.name: Once Upon a Time
terror_cards.effect: Place 2 new Victims at Grandmother's House. ↓ The Killer recovers 1 Health ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Grandmother's house, with guests who have no idea.

terror_cards.name: Out of the Woods
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Oherwise: ↓ All Victims that are not in your space move 1 space towards the Village. ↓ Target > Final Girl > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Someone almost made it out of the woods.

terror_cards.name: The Full Moon is Out
terror_cards.effect: Roll a die. Then place the Killer in the space indicated below: 1-2: Clearing 3-4: Meadow 5-6: Glen ↓ All Victims in that space are killed. ↓ If no Victim was killed, draw and resolve the next Terror card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The moon rises full and the wolf goes wherever it likes.

terror_cards.name: "There's something in the trees!"
terror_cards.effect: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move Twice ↓ If there is at least one Victim in the Killer's space, +1 Bloodlust.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Branches snap overhead and something big moves in the trees.

locations.flavour_unofficial: A fairytale forest of breadcrumb trails, gingerbread and something enormous on the path.

locations.name: Wolfe Asylum

setup_cards.name: A Solitary Life
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: The solitary cells are full tonight.

setup_cards.name: Bingo Night
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Bingo night in the common room, and everyone is there.

setup_cards.name: Madhouse Faceoff
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Patients and staff, face to face in the dark.

setup_cards.name: Padded Rooms
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Soft walls, locked doors and screaming that nobody hears.

setup_cards.name: The Dr. Is In
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: The doctor is making his rounds.

events.name: Dangerous Addiction
events.effect: Choose up to 2 Victims that do not share a space with you or each other. Place a facedown Pill token with both, one, or neither of them. For each Pill token you place, 1 Bloodlust. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Two patients desperate for their next fix.

events.name: Dr. Death
events.effect: Place Dr. Death in the Operating Theater. During the Upkeep phase, Dr. Death kills a Victim in his space. If there are none, move Dr. Death one space closer to the nearest Victim. If Dr. Death is killed, gain 2 Time and do not increase Bloodlust. If Dr. Death leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A surgeon who should never have been allowed to operate.

events.name: Dr. Sunshine
events.effect: Place Dr. Sunshine in the Doctor's Office. While Dr. Sunshine is in your space, whenever you take a Pill you may choose what color it is. If Dr. Sunshine is killed in your space, 4 Horror. If Dr. Sunshine leaves play, discard this card.
