events.flavour_unofficial: A cheerful doctor who might actually help.

events.name: Hannibal the Cannibal
events.effect: Place Hannibal in Solitary Confinement along with 2 new Victims. During the Upkeep phase, Hannibal kills a Victim in his space. If there are none, panic Hannibal instead. If Hannibal is saved, 1 Horror. If Hannibal is killed, minus 1 Horror. If Hannibal leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A patient in solitary that no one should ever let out.

events.name: Hospital Gurney
events.effect: Place the Hospital Gurney token in your space. It can move with you and you can place up to 2 Victims on it. You can discard the Gurney to ram it into an Enemy in your space or an adjacent space to inflict 1 Damage plus one additional Damage for each Victim currently on the Gurney. The Victims are then killed. If the Gurney leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A wheeled bed to push people to safety.

events.name: Medical Stockpile
events.effect: The first time in a phase that you or an Enemy recover at least 1 Health, you or the Enemy recover an additional Health.
events.flavour_unofficial: The pharmacy is fully stocked tonight.

events.name: Powerful Meds
events.effect: Whenever you consume a Pill or Pills, draw an additional Side Effects card.
events.flavour_unofficial: The pills here are much stronger than they should be.

events.name: Scratching And Biting
events.effect: Whenever you save a Victim, make a Horror roll. If no stars, lose 1 Health.
events.flavour_unofficial: The patients you save don't go quietly.

events.name: "The New Patients Are Here!"
events.effect: Place 4 new Victims in the Common Room. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Four new arrivals in the common room, right on time.

events.name: Welcome To The Madhouse
events.effect: Place a Skull token in the Common Room. When you or an Enemy enters that space, you or it is dealt 1 Damage.
events.flavour_unofficial: A skull in the common room. It isn't a decoration.

items.name: Adrenaline Shot
items.effect: When you must reveal your black Final Health token, before revealing the token you may discard this card to reveal 3 Final Health tokens from the pool and use one of those instead.
items.flavour_unofficial: A shot to the heart that keeps you on your feet.

items.name: Anaesthesia
items.effect: Stun an Enemy in your space. You may discard this card to place any remaining Tracking markers on the Tranquilizer Gun (if you have it). Anaesthesia starts with two Tracking markers.
items.flavour_unofficial: A dose that puts anything to sleep.

items.name: Bone Saw
items.effect: Whenever you inflict damage with the Bone Saw, 1 Horror.
items.flavour_unofficial: A surgical saw with a very sharp edge.

items.name: Defibrillator
items.effect: After resolving damage, if the Enemy is still alive then they become Stunned.
items.flavour_unofficial: A jolt to bring someone back, or knock something down.

items.name: Doctor's Bag
items.effect: Spend 1 Time to recover 1 Health or spend 3 Time to recover 2 Health. The Doctor's Bag starts with two Tracking markers.
items.flavour_unofficial: A doctor's bag full of everything you need.

items.name: Energy Drink
items.effect: Discard this during the Action phase and choose one of the following: Gain 3 Time or Move 1 Space Wolfe Asylum only: Gain 3 Time or Move 1 Space or Ignore a Side Effects card
items.flavour_unofficial: Sugar, caffeine and a burst of very bad decisions.

items.name: First Aid Kit
items.effect: Every time you use an Action card to recover health, recover an additional Health.
items.flavour_unofficial: Bandages, antiseptic and hope.

items.name: Hook-Handed Bone Hammer
items.effect: Whenever you inflict damage with the Bone Hammer, roll a die. On a 1-4 receive minus 1 Health.
items.flavour_unofficial: A brutal tool from the asylum's darkest ward.

items.name: Knife
items.flavour_unofficial: A kitchen knife, a camping knife, any knife will do.

items.name: Laughing Gas Canister
items.effect: Discard this card to Stun all Enemies in your space and adjacent spaces. Victims in those spaces immediately panic.
items.flavour_unofficial: A hiss of gas and the room starts giggling.

items.name: Mysterious Pills (Wolfe Asylum)
items.effect: Immediately discard this card and take 2 Pill tokens.
items.flavour_unofficial: Unmarked pills from the asylum pharmacy. Each one a gamble.

items.name: Patient Gown
items.effect: You may ignore any movement penalties from special rules. If you take Damage from an attack, you may discard this card to kill a Victim in your space instead.
items.flavour_unofficial: A thin gown that lets you slip past unnoticed.

items.name: Physician's Manual
items.effect: When taking Pill tokens or drawing Amped cards, draw an additional one. Choose which to keep and discard the additional one.
items.flavour_unofficial: A thick medical book with useful notes in the margins.

items.name: Scalpel
items.effect: When using the Scalpel, add an additional Damage for every two stars on your Horror roll. If you roll no stars, then take 1 Damage.
items.flavour_unofficial: A small, precise blade from the surgery.

items.name: Tranquilizer Gun
items.effect: The Tranquilizer Gun cannot modify an Action card and must be used without one. For 2 Time you may fire a tranquilizer at an Enemy in an adjacent space. If still alive, that Enemy becomes Stunned. The Tranquilizer Gun can be recharged with Anaesthesia.
items.flavour_unofficial: One dart puts anything down for a while.

items.name: Trashcan Lid
items.effect: Ignore a Damage.
items.flavour_unofficial: Dented, smelly and surprisingly good at stopping a blow.

terror_cards.name: "4:00... Time for Bingo!"
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ All Victims move 1 space closer to the Common Room. ↓ Count the Victims in the Common Room and do the following: 0 - 3 Horror 1 - 2 Horror 2 - 1 Horror 3+ = No effect.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It's bingo time, and the patients won't be kept from it.

terror_cards.name: "All hail the new master!"
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Move each Victim 1 space closer to the Killer. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack x2
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The patients have a new leader, and it's her.

terror_cards.name: Extreme Paranoia
terror_cards.effect: All Victims in spaces adjacent to the Killer panic. ↓ You take 1 Damage for each Victim that panicked into your space. You may defend. ↓ If no Victims panicked into your space, 2 Horror.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Every patient near her is convinced someone's out to get them.

terror_cards.name: Fueled By Madness
terror_cards.effect: 1 Horror ↓ The Killer recovers Health equal to the number of Victims in its space and adjacent spaces. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Madness fuels her like electricity.

terror_cards.name: "Give us our meds!"
terror_cards.effect: For each Victim in your space, do one of the following: discard a Pill OR take 1 Damage (you may defend). ↓ 1 Horror ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The patients want their meds, and they want them now.

terror_cards.name: "I found some candy!"
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Pill tokens OR Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Move all Victims not in your space 1 space closer to the nearest Pill token. ↓ For each Pill token that has at least 1 Victim in its space, roll a die. 1-2: Discard the Pill token and one Victim dies. 3-4: Discard the Pill token and panic one Victim. 5-6: Nothing happens. ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Someone found a stash of pills and thinks it's candy.

terror_cards.name: "What is this place doing to me?"
terror_cards.effect: Draw 2 Side Effects cards. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The asylum is getting into your head.

terror_cards.name: "Where did everyone go?"
terror_cards.effect: Panic each Victim in your space until there are no longer any Victims in your space. ↓ 2 Horror ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Everyone has vanished and the corridors are silent.

special_cards.name: Extreme Agility
special_cards.effect: Roll +1 die for all Horror rolls.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: Your body moves faster than your thoughts.

special_cards.name: Final Girl 2.0
special_cards.effect: If not already revealed, flip and reveal your Ultimate Ability. Then, take a second Final Girl card of your choice and apply its Ultimate Ability as well.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: An upgraded version of you.

special_cards.name: Rabid Fury
special_cards.effect: Furious Strike is now a 0 cost card.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: A fury that makes every strike come easy.

special_cards.name: Rapid Healing
special_cards.effect: During the Upkeep phase, make a Horror roll. For each star, recover 1 Health.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: Wounds close almost as fast as they open.

special_cards.name: Resistance
special_cards.effect: Ignore all Dark Power and Minor Dark Power effects.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: Nothing dark can touch you now.

special_cards.name: Brain Fog
special_cards.effect: Discard 1 random Item card, if able. Do not draw any more Side Effects cards.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: You can't remember where you put things.

special_cards.name: Normal
special_cards.effect: No effect.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: For once, nothing happens.

special_cards.name: Panic Attack
special_cards.effect: Discard 2 Terror cards. Do not draw any more Side Effects cards.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: Your heart races and the world spins.

special_cards.name: Paralyzation
special_cards.effect: Discard all Action cards that allow movement. Do not draw any more Side Effects cards.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: Your legs won't move.

special_cards.name: Reset
special_cards.effect: Shuffle this and all other Side Effects cards back into the deck.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: The side effects wear off, for now.

locations.flavour_unofficial: A sprawling asylum of locked wards, dim corridors and pills that change you.

locations.name: Sunnydaze Mall

setup_cards.name: Black Friday
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: The doors open for the big sale and the crowd floods in.

setup_cards.name: Family Dinner
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: A family meal in the food court.

setup_cards.name: Foodcourt Faceoff
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: A stand-off in the food court.

setup_cards.name: High Score!
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Somebody's chasing a high score in the arcade.

setup_cards.name: Special Delivery
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: A delivery arrives at the loading dock.

events.name: Bart the Mall Cop
events.effect: Place Bart the Mall Cop in Security. Bart will not follow you. During the Upkeep phase, roll a die and move Bart that many spaces clockwise along the spaces surrounding the Food Court. If you ever share a space with Bart, -2 Time. If he enters an Enemy's space, do 2 Damage to the Enemy and then Bart is killed. If the Bart the Mall Cop leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: The mall cop takes his job very, very seriously.

events.name: Busted Escalators
events.effect: Lose 2 Time when moving through an escalator space.
events.flavour_unofficial: The escalators are broken and the stairs are a long way off.

events.name: Fire Sale!
events.effect: Move all Victims that are adjacent to a store into the store. You, any Allies, and all Enemies in a store with at least 1 Victim receive -1 Health. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Everything must go, including the shoppers.

events.name: Flash Mob!
events.effect: Place 6 new Victims at the Food Court, 3 on each side. Then, panic all Victims in the Food Court. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A crowd breaks into a choreographed dance.

events.name: Food Fight!
events.effect: If you, an Ally, or an Enemy enters the Food Court, they receive 1 Damage if there is at least 1 Victim in either Food Court space.
events.flavour_unofficial: Food flies across the court and the floor is a mess.

events.name: Lockdown!
events.effect: Both Exit spaces are sealed off. Place a Lockdown token in Security. If you end the Action phase there, remove the token. As long as the Lockdown token is on the board, no one can be saved or exit at an Exit space. Discard this card when the Lockdown token is removed.
events.flavour_unofficial: The doors are locked. No one gets in or out.

events.name: Renovations
events.effect: Roll a die and place a Destroyed Wall token on one of that store's walls if possible. Roll a second die and repeat. 1: Military Surplus 'R Us 2: Boards 'n Bones 3: Zap Shack 4: Joystick Heroes 5: Stan's Sporting Goods 6: Smokin' Subject
events.flavour_unofficial: A wall comes down and the floor plan changes.

events.name: Rise of the Nerds!
events.effect: Place a new Victim at both Boards 'n Bones and Joystick Heroes. Whenever you end the Action phase in either store with a Victim in your space, choose one of the following: +3 Time -1 Horror +1 Health
events.flavour_unofficial: The nerds have taken over the game shop.

events.name: The Savior's Girl
events.effect: The Victim closest to the Savior is now the Savior's Girl. While the Savior's Girl is in your space, +1 Dice when resolving Build Trust Action cards. If the Savior's Girl dies, decrease Trust twice and +1 Bloodlust. If the Savior's Girl leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: The Saviour has a girlfriend, and she needs protecting too.

events.name: Wet Floors
events.effect: Whenever a Victim in a Railing space panics, roll twice and apply the lower result.
events.flavour_unofficial: Wet floors near the railings. One slip and it's a long way down.

items.name: Banana Peel
items.effect: While in a Railing space, spend 1 Time to place a Banana Peel token in our space (limit 1 per space). If an Enemy enters a space with a Banana Peel, discard the token and the Enemy falls over the railing, ending their movement.
items.flavour_unofficial: A banana peel on the railing. Comedy gold, or death.

items.name: Boomstick
items.effect: If the Enemy is blown off of a Railing space or through a store wall, +1 Damage. If there is a 1 in the final Horror roll result, discard the Boomstick. If you have a Boomstick in each hand, you may use both when attacking.
items.flavour_unofficial: A boomstick to blow something off the railing.

items.name: Caffeinated Beverage
items.effect: Discard this during the Action phase and choose one of the following: +4 Time OR Move up to 2 spaces
items.flavour_unofficial: A jumbo coffee with five extra shots.

items.name: Chopper Keys
items.effect: While with the Chopper and you move at least 1 space, you may move up to 2 additional spaces with the Chopper. The Chopper can carry you and one Victim or Ally, and cannot enter stores. If you enter a space with an Enemy, you may discard the Chopper to do 4 Damage to the Enemy and -1 Health to each person riding the Chopper.
items.flavour_unofficial: Keys to a chopper parked out back.

items.name: Cigarettes
items.effect: When the Savior is in your space, discard to increase Trust by 1.
items.flavour_unofficial: The Saviour won't listen, but he'll take a smoke.

items.name: Flower Box
items.effect: If you have a Boomstick in your other hand you may discard the Flower Box to immediately deal 2 Damage to an Enemy that has just entered your space or is in your space. If in the Backpack, you may discard for -1 Horror.
items.flavour_unofficial: A planter box to hide behind, or blow apart.

items.name: Giftcard
items.effect: Discard this during the Action phase and choose one of the following: Take 4 Time worth of Action cards OR If at a Search space, look at the tope 2 Item cards and take 1.
items.flavour_unofficial: Store credit, just when you need something.

items.name: Grenade
items.effect: Sunnydaze Mall: Discard during the Action phase and spend 2 Time to deal 2 Damage to an Enemy in an adjacent space OR to add a Destroyed Wall token to a wall of the store you are currently in. Pesadilla Verde: When in hand, discard during the Action phase and spend 2 Time to deal 2 Damage to an Enemy in an adjacent space. When in your backpack, discard while using the Compound Bow to add 2 Damage to the attack.
items.flavour_unofficial: Pull the pin and count to three.

items.name: Hackmaster9000
items.effect: While at Security, spend 2 Time to place an Alarm token in any store (limit of 1 on the board). Whenever the Killer must choose a target, they will choose the Alarm instead. Discard the Alarm token when the Killer enters the space where it is located.
items.flavour_unofficial: A hacking device to take over the mall's security.

items.name: Knife
items.flavour_unofficial: A kitchen knife, a camping knife, any knife will do.

items.name: Leather Jacket
items.effect: When resolving Build Trust Action cards, you may reroll any of your dice once. Discard the Leather Jacket to ignore up to 2 Damage.
items.flavour_unofficial: A leather jacket that earns a rebel's trust.

items.name: Lucky Rabbit's Foot
items.effect: Discard during the Action phase to make a Horror roll. For each success, choose one of the following: * Gain 2 Time * Restore Health by 1 * Decrease Horror by 1 * Move 1 Space
items.flavour_unofficial: A charm for luck. You'll need every bit of it.

items.name: Self-Help Book
items.effect: Build Trust Action cards now cost 1 Time.
items.flavour_unofficial: A self-help book on building trust, finally useful.

items.name: Sneakers
items.effect: Do not roll a die when voluntarily jumping off a Railing space.
items.flavour_unofficial: Fresh trainers for running away.

items.name: Titanium Bat
items.effect: Whenever you inflict damage to the Killer with the Titanium Bat, you may immediately discard a Minor Dark Power, including any Health markers remaining on the card.
items.flavour_unofficial: An aluminium bat with a titanium core.

items.name: Walkie-Talkie
items.effect: Play a Build Trust Action card when not in the same space as the Savior.
items.flavour_unofficial: A walkie-talkie to get through to the Saviour.

minor_dark_powers.name: Twisted Bond
minor_dark_powers.effect: During the Upkeep phase, move the Savior 1 space closer to the Killer. Ignore this effect if the Savior has left play.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: The machine and its target are bound together.

terror_cards.name: Twisted Bond
terror_cards.effect: During the Upkeep phase, move the Savior 1 space closer to the Killer. Ignore this effect if the Savior has left play. Bonus Health: 2
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The machine and its target are bound together.

terror_cards.name: Collateral Damage
terror_cards.effect: Target Final Girl > Move Twice ↓ For each Railing space containing at least 1 Victim that the Killer moves through, including its starting and ending spaces, push 1 Victim over the railing.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Everything around you gets caught in the crossfire.

terror_cards.name: Fire Alarm
terror_cards.effect: +1 Horror ↓ Panic all Victims twice. ↓ Target Final Girl > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Alarms blare and shoppers stampede.

terror_cards.name: "It hits like a freight train!"
terror_cards.effect: Target Final Girl > Move > Attack ↓ If either you or the Savior are attacked in a store or in a Railing space, they receive an additional -1 Health.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It hits like a freight train, and it doesn't stop.

terror_cards.name: "It's coming for me! I gotta hide!"
terror_cards.effect: If the Savior is not on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Panic the Savior 3 times. ↓ +1 Horror ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Somebody's terrified and running for cover.

terror_cards.name: Mall Rats
terror_cards.effect: If the Savior is not on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Place 2 new Victims with the Savior. ↓ Immediately resolve a Savior card. ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The local teenagers who hang around the mall.

terror_cards.name: Paranoia
terror_cards.effect: If the Savior is not on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Make a Horror roll. ↓ 2 Successes: Increase Trust by 1. 1 Success: No Effect. 0 Successes: Decrease Trust by 1 and resolve this card again.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Everyone thinks the machine is right behind them.

terror_cards.name: Relentless Pursuit
terror_cards.effect: Draw an Event card. ↓ Target Final Girl > Move Twice > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It never stops, never slows, never gives up.

special_cards.name: "You're full of shit. I'm not in danger!"
special_cards.effect: I Believe You!: -1 Horror I Guess You're OK: No effect. Eat Me: +1 Horror Go to Hell!: +2 Horror
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: He doesn't believe he's in danger. He'd better start.

special_cards.name: "I'll hang out with whomever I want to!"
special_cards.effect: I Believe You!: Move the Savior up to 2 spaces away from the Killer. I Guess You're OK: Move the Savior up to 1 space away from the Killer. Eat Me: Move the Savior 1 space towards the Killer. Go to Hell!: Move the Savior 2 spaces towards the Killer.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: He'll hang out with whoever he wants, thanks.

special_cards.name: "Watch this!"
special_cards.effect: I Believe you!: Move the Savior up to 1 space in any direction. I Guess You're OK: No effect. Eat Me: Move the Savior up to 1 space towards the nearest Railing space. If he's in a Railing space, he jumps over the railing. Go to Hell!: Move the Savior up to 2 spaces towards the nearest Railing space. If he's in a Railing space, he jumps over the railing.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: He wants to show off a trick. Now is not the time.

special_cards.name: "I'm not stealing... I'm just borrowing."
special_cards.effect: I Believe You!: Take the top card from any Item deck. I Guess You're OK: No effect. Eat Me: Move the Savior to the nearest Search space and discard the top Item card. Go to Hell!: Move the Savior to the nearest Search space and discard the top 2 Item cards.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: He's just borrowing it, he swears.

special_cards.name: "You won't be needing this..."
special_cards.effect: I Believe You!: +2 Time I Guess You're OK: No effect. Eat Me: Discard 1 random Item. If you are unable to discard an Item, -2 Time. Go to Hell!: Discard 2 random Items. For each Item you are unable to discard, -2 Time.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: He takes something you might need.

special_cards.name: "I'm not going anywhere with you!"
special_cards.effect: I Believe You: +2 Time I Guess You're OK: +1 Time Eat Me: -1 Time Go to Hell!: -3 Time
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: He's not going anywhere with you. Not yet.

special_cards.name: "You're not the boss of me!"
special_cards.effect: I Believe You!: Move the Savior up to 2 spaces in any direction. I Guess You're OK: Move the Savior up to 1 space in any direction. Eat Me: Move the Savior 2 spaces away from you. Go to Hell!: Move the Savior 3 spaces away from you.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: He doesn't take orders.

special_cards.name: "Let go, you're hurting me!"
special_cards.effect: I Believe You!: You recover 1 Health. I Guess You're OK: No effect. Eat Me: You lose 1 Health. Go to Hell!: You lose 2 Health.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: You grab his arm a bit too hard.

locations.flavour_unofficial: A neon-lit shopping mall where a machine from the future is hunting.

locations.name: Hellscape

setup_cards.name: Depravity
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Every chamber here was built to corrupt.

setup_cards.name: Ecstasy
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: A bliss so sharp it cuts.

setup_cards.name: Rapture
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Joy and agony become impossible to tell apart.

setup_cards.name: Revelation
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Something long hidden is about to show its face.

setup_cards.name: Sensation
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Every nerve sings, and none of them happily.

events.name: Barrier of Blood
events.effect: Place the Barrier of Blood token over the Nexus on the side of your choice. It is now only an EXIT or SEARCH space, but not both.
events.flavour_unofficial: A curtain of blood seals the way through.

events.name: Chaotic Transference
events.effect: Swap the Sepulchre of Blood and the House of Mutilation Item decks. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: The chambers lurch and swap places while you blink.

events.name: Curious Wretch
events.effect: The Victim closest to you is now the Wretch. When the Wretch moves at least one space, -1 Time. If you save the Wretch, -1 Horror and +1 Health. If the Wretch leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A ragged soul who can't stop poking at the horrors.

events.name: Delight in Pain
events.effect: When you Search in the Sepulchre of Blood, +1 Health.
events.flavour_unofficial: In the Sepulchre, the pain starts to feel almost kind.

events.name: Endless Suffering
events.effect: When you Search in the House of Mutilation, -1 Health.
events.flavour_unofficial: Search the House of Mutilation and it searches you back.

events.name: Lost in Excess
events.effect: When the Horror level increases or decreases beyond the limit, do not increase Bloodlust or Time.
events.flavour_unofficial: Too much of everything, and all of it hungry.

events.name: Masochistic Peon
events.effect: The Victim closest to you is now the Peon. Place 4 Health markers on this card. If the Peon is in your space at the end of the Action phase, you may gain 1 Health from this card. The Peon also loses Health when attacked. When the Peon loses its final Health marker, it dies. If the Peon leaves play, discard the card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A grovelling servant who'd thank you for the whip.

events.name: Sadistic Seeker
events.effect: The Victim closest to you is now the Seeker. If the Seeker is in your space during the Upkeep phase, -1 Health. If the Seeker dies while in your space, -4 Horror. If the Seeker leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A connoisseur of cruelty who wants to watch.

events.name: Stare Into The Abyss...
events.effect: Whenever you move to a Hellscape tile, -1 Health.
events.flavour_unofficial: Look down into the dark long enough and it looks up.

events.name: Torture Chambers
events.effect: Roll the Hellscape dice. For each die result, place a Torture Chamber token on that Hellscape tile in the space of your choice. When a Victim dies in either of those spaces, +1 Horror.
events.flavour_unofficial: The torture rooms rattle into new positions.

items.name: Amulet of Hell
items.effect: Whenever you end your movement on a Hellscape tile, +1 Time.
items.flavour_unofficial: A charm that hums when Hell shifts beneath you.

items.name: Ancient Sword
items.effect: Whenever you damage the Killer, -1 Horror.
items.flavour_unofficial: A blade older than any religion, steady in the hand.

items.name: Bone Key
items.effect: Place the Bone Chariot in the closest Hellscape tile space. Once per Action phase while with the Chariot, -2 Time to move with the Chariot to ANY Hellscape tile space. The Chariot may move with you during normal movement but may not by moved off of a Hellscape tile.
items.flavour_unofficial: A key carved from bone that summons a chariot of it.

items.name: Book of Ecstasy
items.effect: Prevent +1 Horror.
items.flavour_unofficial: Its pages make the fear feel distant.

items.name: Control Node
items.effect: Immediately place yourself and up to 1 Victim in your space on any Exit space.
items.flavour_unofficial: A device that pulls you and others across the realm.

items.name: Discipline of Choices
items.effect: Once per Action phase you may lose 1 Health to gain 2 Time.
items.flavour_unofficial: A lash that asks you to choose who bleeds.

items.name: Discipline of Courage
items.effect: Once per Action phase you may lose 1 Health to lose 1 Horror.
items.flavour_unofficial: Pay in pain, receive courage.

items.name: Discipline of Cruelty
items.effect: Once per Action phase you may lose 2 Health to deal 1 Damage to any Enemy on the board.
items.flavour_unofficial: Cruelty, wrapped round a handle, reaching everyone.

items.name: Gambler's Cube
items.effect: Discard during the Action phase and roll a die: 1-2: -1 Health AND roll again. 3-4: +2 Time OR roll again. 5: Take any top Item card. 6: Take any Action card.
items.flavour_unofficial: Roll the cube and let Hell decide.

items.name: Goblet of Blood
items.effect: +2 Health
items.flavour_unofficial: Drink deep. Don't ask whose it was.

items.name: Haladie
items.effect: If the target is on a Hellscape tile, do an additional Damage.
items.flavour_unofficial: A twin-bladed dagger that cuts deeper on cursed ground.

items.name: Hellish Contract
items.effect: Spend 1 Time to place a Contract token in your space. Whenever the Killer enters a space with a Contract token, you may lose 1 Health to lose 3 Horror.
items.flavour_unofficial: Sign here, in red, and the realm owes you a favour.

items.name: Miracle of Faith
items.effect: Discard during the Action phase and choose one of the following: Recover All Health OR reduce Horror to the minimum.
items.flavour_unofficial: Even here, faith can still do something.

items.name: Nexus Controller
items.effect: Rearrange the Hellscape tiles as you choose.
items.flavour_unofficial: Hold the controls of Hell in your hands for a moment.

items.name: Pins of Pain & Pleasure
items.effect: Once per Action phase when you are in the Killer's space, the Killer recovers 1 Health. Then, +3 Time.
items.flavour_unofficial: Pins that turn pain into pleasure, or the other way round.

items.name: Rusty Flesh Hook
items.flavour_unofficial: Rusted, barbed and still sticky.

items.name: Seething Orb
items.flavour_unofficial: A glass globe roiling with something that wants out.

items.name: Spiked Whip
items.effect: If you damage an Enemy with the Spiked Whip, you may move them 1 space.
items.flavour_unofficial: A whip that leaves its barbs behind.

terror_cards.name: Death Labyrinth
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ All Victims panic. All Victims that enter the Killer's space are killed. ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A maze whose every turn ends badly.

terror_cards.name: Devoid of Life
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims in your space, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Kill 1 Victim in your space or lose 1 Health. ↓ +1 Horror
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A chamber so empty it feels like it's watching.

terror_cards.name: Home to Endless Appetites
terror_cards.effect: Place 1 new Victim on each named space. ↓ Draw an Event card. ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The realm is always hungry for new arrivals.

terror_cards.name: Hunger for Suffering
terror_cards.effect: Rolle the Hellscape dice. For each die result, place a Victim on that Hellscape tile in the space of your choice. ↓ Target Final Girl of Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The chambers groan, eager for screams.

terror_cards.name: Planes of Torment
terror_cards.effect: If the Final Girl or the Killer are on a Hellscape tile, +1 Horror. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Planes of torment grind past each other like gears.

terror_cards.name: Seductive Hellpit
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Move each Victim that is adjacent to a named space into the named space. ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A pit that sings sweetly and swallows whole.

terror_cards.name: Spiral of Death
terror_cards.effect: Shift each Hellscape tile 1 space counterclockwise. ↓ Place 1 new Victim on the Star tile and 1 new Victim on the Square tile in the spaces of your choice. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The realm spins and you spin with it.

terror_cards.name: Spiral of Horrors
terror_cards.effect: Shift each Hellscape tile 1 space clockwise. ↓ Place 1 new Victim on the Clover tile and 1 new Victim on the Hourglass tile in the spaces of your choice. ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Round and round, and every turn is worse.

special_cards.name: Hellshift
special_cards.effect: [Results] 2 Successes: Rearrange all Hellscape tiles as you choose. 1 Success: Swap any 1 Hellscape tiles of your choice > -1 Time 0 Successes: -2 Time
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: You twist the puzzle and the realm twists with it.

locations.flavour_unofficial: A realm of hooks and shifting chambers where pain is a currency.

locations.name: Falconwood

setup_cards.name: 4th of July Weekend
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Fireworks over the river, and something in the dark watching them.

setup_cards.name: Back to School
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: First day back at school, and someone's missing from register.

setup_cards.name: Election Day
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Everyone's out voting, and nobody's watching the streets.

setup_cards.name: Halloween
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Masks on every doorstep, and one of them isn't a costume.

setup_cards.name: New Year's Eve
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Countdown to midnight, and something counting down with you.

events.name: Bridge Repair
events.effect: Place the Under Construction token on a bridge of your choice. That bridge can no longer be used for the rest of the game and the spaces it was connected to are no longer considered adjacent.
events.flavour_unofficial: The bridge is closed for repairs. Of course it is.

events.name: Conspiracy Theorist
events.effect: Place the Conspiracy Theorist at the Shopping Mall. The Theorist will follow you into the Killer's space and can only be attacked if there are no other Victims in their space. While the Theorist is in your space, if an Enemy in your space attacks you or a Victim, that Enemy takes 1 Damage. If the Theorist is killed in your space, +1 Horror. If the Conspiracy Theorist leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: He's been ranting about the lab for years. He was right.

events.name: Dry Spell
events.effect: You can use all River Crossings until it rains. At the start of each Action phase, roll the d20. On a 1-4, it rains and you discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: The river runs low and every crossing opens up.

events.name: Freaks and Geeks
events.effect: One less Victim will follow you (to a minimum of 1), unless you're with a Special Victim.
events.flavour_unofficial: The weird kids won't follow just anyone.

events.name: Game of Chance
events.effect: Choose how many Dice you want to roll (max 6). Roll them along with the d20. If the total value of the Dice results is less than or equal to the value on the d20, +2 Horror. If the Dice total is greater than the value on the d20, apply the following effect based on how many Dice you used. 6: -2 Time 5: -1 Time 4: +1 Time 3: +3 Time 2: -3 Horror 1: -6 Horror Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Roll the dice and see if the town smiles on you.

events.name: Grand Opening
events.effect: Cover the River Crossing of your choice with the Bridge token. Those spaces are now adjacent.
events.flavour_unofficial: A new crossing is opened with ribbon and speeches.

events.name: Head Researcher
events.effect: Place the Head Researcher at the Government Lab. During the Upkeep phase, 1 normal Victim at the Government Lab is killed. Then, the closest normal Victim to the Government Lab moves 1 space closer to it. If the Head Researcher is killed, +2 Bloodlust. If the Head Researcher leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: She knows what the lab really did, and she's terrified.

events.name: Helping Hands
events.effect: Gain Progress on the Mission. Refer to the Mission sheet for details. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A few brave locals lend a hand with your mission.

events.name: Packed Bridge
events.effect: Lose 2 Time when crossing a bridge.
events.flavour_unofficial: Gridlock on the bridge, horns blaring.

events.name: Pizza Delivery
events.effect: Place the Van token in your space. The token may move with you, except over River Crossings. As long as the Van remains with you for the entire movement. 1 additional Victim may follow you and you get +2 movement when resolving Actions that provide movement. However, your first move must be panicked.
events.flavour_unofficial: The pizza van, keys in, engine running.

items.name: Spell Book (Mission Item)
items.effect: Discard during the Action phase and choose an adjacent space. Roll the d20. Everyone in that space takes damage based on the result: 1-10: 2 Damage 11-19: 4 Damage 20: 8 Damage
items.flavour_unofficial: Pages of strange symbols that bend the world a little.

items.name: Telekinesis (Mission Item)
items.effect: When attacked, lose 1 Health to ignore all Damage. Then move the Enemy who attacked to an adjacent space and deal them 1 Damage. This Item is not considered in your Backpack, but the card may be kept there if it's not in your hand.
items.flavour_unofficial: Your mind reaches out and the world moves.

items.name: AK-47
items.effect: The AK-47 cannot modify an Action card and must be used without one. Once per Action phase, spend 3 Time to deal 3 Damage to 1 Enemy within range or 1 Damage to to all Enemies within range.
items.flavour_unofficial: Smuggled out of the lab's armoury. Loud, heavy and very effective.

items.name: Army Knife
items.flavour_unofficial: A pocket knife with a blade for every occasion.

items.name: Axe
items.flavour_unofficial: The camp's woodpile tool, repurposed.

items.name: Binoculars
items.effect: Once per turn, while on or adjacent to a Search space, spend 1 Time to look at the top 2 cards of that space's Item deck. Return each card to the bottom or top of the deck in any order.
items.flavour_unofficial: Watch the far bank without getting close.

items.name: Dragon's Breath
items.effect: Discard during the Action phase to deal 3 Damage to an Enemy in your space or an adjacent space.
items.flavour_unofficial: Firework shells packed with fire and fury.

items.name: First Aid Kit
items.effect: Every time you use an Action card to recover health, recover an additional Health.
items.flavour_unofficial: Bandages, antiseptic and hope.

items.name: Flamethrower
items.effect: This must be kept in your hands and you may not have any Items in your Backpack. May be used once per Action phase to deal damage equal to half the Killer's current health, rounded down OR to kill all Minions in your space.
items.flavour_unofficial: Fire in a corridor, fire in a vent, fire everywhere.

items.name: Lucky Dragon's Foot
items.effect: Discard during the Action phase to roll a d20. Choose from the effects below based on your result. You can choose the same effect multiple times. 1-5: Choose 1 6-10: Choose 2 11-15: Choose 3 16-20: Choose 4 +2 Time +1 Health -1 Horror Move 1 Space
items.flavour_unofficial: A lucky charm that someone swore came from a dragon.

items.name: Old Revolver
items.effect: The Old Revolver may only modify the Weak Attack Action card.
items.flavour_unofficial: Heavy, old and loud enough to make anyone flinch.

items.name: Pool Noodle
items.effect: You may use the River Crossings but only 1 Victim may follow you.
items.flavour_unofficial: A neon float that gets you across the river. Somehow.

items.name: Shock Stick
items.effect: Whenever you damage an Enemy, you may move them to an adjacent space.
items.flavour_unofficial: A cattle prod repurposed for something worse than cattle.

items.name: Shotgun
items.effect: The Shotgun cannot modify an Action card and must be used without one. Spend 1 Time to make a Horror Roll. Success: Deal 3 Damage to 1 Enemy within range.
items.flavour_unofficial: Two barrels and a lot of noise.

items.name: Slingshot
items.effect: [Storybook Woods] Range: 1 Damage: 2 Hands: 2 Uses: 2 The Slingshot cannot modify an Action card and must be used without one. It can only be used once per round. Do not discard the Slingshot after 2 uses. You may remove a Search card in your hand from the game to replenish the Item's uses. [Santa's Village] Range: 1 Damage: 1 Hands: 2 Uses: 2 The Slingshot may only modify the Weak Attack Action card.
items.flavour_unofficial: A forked stick and a pocketful of stones.

items.name: Trashcan Lid
items.effect: Ignore a Damage.
items.flavour_unofficial: Dented, smelly and surprisingly good at stopping a blow.

items.name: Waffles
items.effect: Discard during the Action phase and choose one of the following: -1 Horror OR +2 Health
items.flavour_unofficial: Hot waffles at the diner. Some things are worth fighting for.

items.name: Wooden Bat
items.flavour_unofficial: A trusty bat from the garage.

terror_cards.name: Code Blue
terror_cards.effect: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack Twice ↓ +1 Horror
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Code Blue over the hospital speakers, and running feet.

terror_cards.name: "I saw them leaving the make-out closet."
terror_cards.effect: Place 2 new Victims at the School. ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Two teens sneaking out of the closet at exactly the wrong moment.

terror_cards.name: Neverending Attacks
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: He doesn't let up. Not for a second.

terror_cards.name: "Retreat! Retreat!"
terror_cards.effect: Place the Killer in your space. ↓ Roll the d20 three times and do the following for each result. 1-6: Target Final Girl > Attack 7-20: No effect. ↓ If you were not attacked, +1 Bloodlust.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The agents are falling back, and that's not a good sign.

terror_cards.name: "Run! Up that hill!"
terror_cards.effect: Target Final Girl > Move Twice > Attack ↓ +1 Horror
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Running uphill, lungs burning, with him close behind.

terror_cards.name: Survive the Hunt
terror_cards.effect: (If another effect causes this card to be discarded, resolve this card's effect before discarding. Start the Survive the Hunt Mission. Refer to the Mission rules for instructions on what to do next. This Terror card should only be present in the Terror deck if the "Survive the Hunt" mission was chosen at the start of the game.
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Run, hide, survive the night.

terror_cards.name: "This indecision's bugging me."
terror_cards.effect: Choose 1: * Lose Progress on the Mission (refer to the Mission sheet for details) * Discard a random Item card * +2 Horror ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: You can't decide, and every second costs you.

terror_cards.name: "Were you two in the changing room this whole time?"
terror_cards.effect: Place 2 new Victims at the Community Pool. ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Two teens stumble out of the changing room, oblivious.

terror_cards.name: "You scared the crap out of me!"
terror_cards.effect: Place 2 new Victims at Fanghorn Forest. ↓ +1 Horror ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Someone leaps out of the trees and nearly gives you a heart attack.

special_cards.name: Adopted Father
special_cards.effect: While the Adopted Father is in your space, change 1 Die to a Success when resolving Action cards that deal damage and deal 1 additional Damage. If the Adopted Father is killed in your space, +2 Horror. If the Adopted Father leaves play, discard this card.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: Your adopted dad, who'll stand between you and anything.

special_cards.name: Jockette
special_cards.effect: While the Jockette is in your space, change 1 die to a Success when resolving Action cards that provide movement and 1 additional Victim may follow you. You may use the River Crossings while with the Jockette. If the Jockette leaves play, discard this card.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: A sporty girl who can get across any river.

special_cards.name: Reporter
special_cards.effect: While the Reporter is in your space, change 1 Die to a Success when resolving Search and you may draw and keep one additional Item card. While the Reporter is in play, reveal the top card of all Item decks. If the Reporter leaves play, discard this card.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: A reporter chasing the story of a lifetime.

special_cards.name: Kind Scientist
special_cards.effect: While the Kind Scientist is in your space, change 1 Die to a Success when resolving Action cards that recover health and recover 1 additional Health. If the Kind Scientist leaves play, discard this card.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: A scientist who wants to undo what the lab did.

special_cards.name: Best Friend
special_cards.effect: While the Best Friend is in your space, Horror levels cannot go up for any reason. If the Best Friend is killed, +4 Horror. If the Best Friend leaves play, discard this card.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: Your best friend, who'd follow you into the dark.

special_cards.name: Survive the Hunt (Mission)
special_cards.effect: [Setup] * Place the Kind Scientist Friend card and the Telekinesis Mission Item card near the play area. * Place the 4 Agent tokens near the play area. * Build the Terror deck with one less Terror card and then shuffle the "Survive the Hunt" Terror card with the first 7 Terror cards so that it's one of the top 8 cards. [Rules] When the "Survive the Hunt" Terror card is revealed, place the 4 Agent tokens in the following spaces: Town Fair, Shopping Mall, Government Lab, and Best Friend's House. Agents are not considered Minions, but the rules for attacking them are the same as for attacking Minions. Agents have 1 Health, a Movement value of 2, and an Attack value of 2. Each Agent performs the following Action at the end of each Killer phase: Target Final Girl > Move > Attack During the Panic phase, Victims on an Agent's space will panic. The Mission is complete when all Agents are killed. Place the Kind Scientist on your space. Take the Telekinesis Mission Item card, recover 3 Health, and -2 Horror. [Gaining Progress] If the Mission has already started, kill 1 Agent of your choice. If it hasn't started, when you start the Mission, start it with 3 Agents instead of 4. You choose which space to remove the Agent from. [Losing Progress] Agents now have an Attack value of 3.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: Survive the hunt with the help of the one scientist who cares.

special_cards.name: Expose the Lab
special_cards.effect: [Setup] * Place the Reporter Friend card near the play area. * Place 3 random Mission tokens face down on the Government Lab space, setting aside the other 3 Mission tokens for now. Have the Token Reference card nearby. [Rules] Reveal the first Mission token when you enter the Government Lab space. It will have a number from 1 to 6 corresponding to a space on the board. The Token Reference card will show which number corresponds to which space. Place the Mission token faceup on the space indicated by the number. Only one revealed Mission token may be on the board at a time. When you end your movement on the space with the newly revealed Mission token, you may discard a Search Action card to retrieve the token and place it on this sheet. Then, immediately reveal the next Mission token on the Government Lab and place it on the corresponding space. Repeat until there are 3 Mission tokens on this sheet. The Mission is complete when you end your movement at the Police Station and discard the 3 Mission tokens from the sheet. Place the Reporter at the Police Station. Look through the Item deck at the Police Station and that 2 Items of your choice, shuffling the remaining Items together to form the Item deck for that space. [Gaining Progress] One less Mission token is required to complete the Mission. [Losing Progress] Add a fourth Mission token to the Government Lab. An additional Mission token needs to be retrieved and discarded at the Police Station in order to complete the Mission.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: Get proof of what the lab did and get it out.

special_cards.name: Crack the Code
special_cards.effect: [Setup] * Place the Jockette Friend card near the play area. * Shuffle the 6 Mission tokens and randomly place one face down in each of the 6 named spaces that aren't Search spaces. [Rules] When you end your movement on spaces with Mission tokens, you may spend 1 Time to reveal and place the token on this sheet. The token will have a value from 1 to 6. During the Action phase, you may try to crack the code by performing the following steps while at the Shopping Mall. # Spend 3 Time to roll the d20. # Add the values of all Mission tokens on this sheet to the value on the die. # If the total is less than 20, you've failed to crack the code and will have to try again (either this turn if you still have time you wish to spend, or a future turn), starting at step 1. The Mission is complete when the total is greater than or equal to 20. Place the Jockette at the Shopping Mall. Look through the Item deck at the Shopping Mall and take 1 Item of your choice, shuffling the remaining Items together to form the Item deck for that space. [Gaining Progress] Reveal a Mission token of your choice and place it on the sheet. [Losing Progress] Place the highest valued Mission token on this sheet back on the Location board, in the space farthest from you.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: Strange numbers on the radio. Crack them before he does.

special_cards.name: Save Your Father
special_cards.effect: [Setup] * Place the Adopted Father Friend card near the play area. * Separate the 3 blank tokens and place them facedown in the play area (or place them in a bag or opaque cup). * For the remaining Mission tokens, place 2 facedown o. each of the following spaces: Government Lab, Shopping Mall, and the Best Friend's House. [Rules] When you end your movement in spaces with Mission tokens, you may discard a Search Action card to place both tokens facedown in the play area, shuffling them with other Mission tokens there. This is the Mission token pool. Once per Action phase, you may help your father escape by performing the following steps while at the Police Station: # Spend 1 Time to reveal 1 token from the Mission token pool and place it in front of you. # If you have revealed a 2nd blank token or have run out of time to spend, you must stop, otherwise, you may choose to stop or repeat, starting at step 1. If you revealed 2 blank tokens, immediately end the Action phase. All Mission tokes revealed this turn are shuffled back into the Mission token pool facedown. If you stopped before revealing 2 blank tokens, remove any revealed blank tokens from the game and place all revealed tokens with keys onto this sheet. Keep trying on future turns until there are 3 "key" tokens on this sheet, at which point the Mission is complete. When the Mission is complete, place the Adopted Father at the Police Station. Look through the Item deck of the Police Station and take 1 Item of your choice, shuffling the remaining Items together to form the Item deck for that space. [Gaining Progress] One less "key" token is required to complete the Mission. [Losing Progress] One more "key" token is required to complete the Mission.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: They've taken your father. Get him out.

special_cards.name: Missing Friend
special_cards.effect: [Setup] * Place the Best Friend Friend card and the Spell Book Mission Item card near the play area. * Shuffle the 6 Mission tokens and randomly place one face down in each of the 6 named spaces that aren't Search spaces. Have the Token Reference card nearby. [Rules] When you end your movement on spaces with Mission tokens, you may spend 1 Time to reveal the token. The token will have a letter (A, B, or C) with a number (1 or 2) next to it. The Token Reference card will explain what each letter-number combination means. If you reveal a token with a letter that has been previously placed on this sheet, discard it. Otherwise, place the token on this sheet. When there are three tokens on this sheet, one with each letter (A, B, and C), the clues will identify a unique space on the board (e.g. tokens A1, B1, and C1 would identify the Library). Place the Best Friend on its side on the identified space. Enemies and all effects ignore the Best Friend while the meeple is on its side. You may go to that space and discard any Action card that recovers health (e.g. Short Rest), to revive the Best Friend (stand the meeple up) and complete the Mission. The Best Friend is now available to you. Take the Spell Book Mission Item and reduce the Horror to level 0. [Gaining Progress] Reveal the Mission token of your choice and place it on this sheet or discard it if it's a duplicate letter. [Losing Progress] Return one of the Mission tokens on this sheet back on the Location board, in the space furthest from you.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: Your friend went missing near the lab. Find them.

special_cards.name: Spell Book
special_cards.effect: Hands: 1 Discard during the Action phase and choose an adjacent space. Roll the d20. Everyone in that space takes damage based on the result: 1-10: 2 Damage 11-19: 4 Damage 20: 8 Damage
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: Pages of strange symbols that bend the world a little.

special_cards.name: Telekinesis
special_cards.effect: Uses: 2 When attacked, lose 1 Health to ignore all Damage. Then move the Enemy who attacked to an adjacent space and deal them 1 Damage. This Item is not considered in your Backpack, but the card may be kept there if it's not in your hand.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: Your mind reaches out and the world moves.

locations.flavour_unofficial: A sleepy town with a secret lab, a rift to somewhere else and kids who've seen too much.

locations.name: Marrek Warehouse

setup_cards.name: Daily Huddle
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: The morning huddle, the last normal moment of the day.

setup_cards.name: Shift Change
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: People moving between shifts, nobody quite where they should be.

setup_cards.name: Units per Hour
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: The targets keep climbing and nobody's looking up.

setup_cards.name: Unloading
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Trucks backed up to the bay and everybody's hands full.

setup_cards.name: You're Fired
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: The word comes down: you're fired. All of you.

events.name: Good Ole Zipp
events.effect: Replace the Victim that is furthest from the Killer with Zipp. While Zipp is with you, you may treat Exit spaces as Unlocked. If Zipp is killed, +1 Bloodlust. If Zipp leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Old Zipp knows every lock in this place.

events.name: Help on the Racks
events.effect: Panic all Victims in spaces adjacent to Rack spaces, but only move them if they panic into a Rack space. Repeat this process until at least 2 Victims have moved into a Rack space, or until there are no more Victims in spaces adjacent to Rack spaces. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Someone's stuck up on the racks and needs help down.

events.name: Heroic Best Friend
events.effect: Replace the Victim of your choice with the Best Friend. The Best Friend cannot be saved unless there are no other Victims on the board. If you would take damage and the Best Friend is in your space or an adjacent space, then they move to your space and take the damage instead. If the Best Friend leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A best friend who'll take the hit meant for you.

events.name: "It has been 0 days since..."
events.effect: Whenever a Victim is a Rack space panics to a normal space, it is killed.
events.flavour_unofficial: The safety sign resets to zero days. Again.

events.name: Scatter!
events.effect: Panic all Victims. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Everyone runs in every direction at once.

events.name: Smarter Than They Look
events.effect: When an Exit space becomes Unlocked, you may save any Victims on that space, even if you are not there. Take the Victim Saved benefits at the start of the next Action phase.
events.flavour_unofficial: They're quicker than they look, and they find a way out.

events.name: The Supervisor
events.effect: Place the Supervisor and 2 new Victims in the Supply Cage. When panicking Victims in the Supervisor's space, roll 1 die and move all Victims (including the Supervisor) according to the result. If the Supervisor leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: The supervisor takes charge, like it matters now.

events.name: Trucks Are Here!
events.effect: Place 1 new Victim on each Loading Dock. If either Loading Dock space (or both) is Locked, place the affected Victim(s) near the Locked space(s), out of play. The Victim enters play when the space becomes Unlocked. Discard this card once both new Victims have entered play.
events.flavour_unofficial: More trucks, more workers, more people to save.

events.name: Tumbling Boxes
events.effect: Place the 4 Severed Head tokens in 4 different non-adjacent spaces (do not place them in Rack spaces). When you move into a space with a token, +1 Horror and then remove it from play. Discard this card when the last token leaves play.
events.flavour_unofficial: Boxes topple from the top shelves, and something rolls out.

events.name: "You aren't going anywhere"
events.effect: All Unlocked Exit spaces are Locked again. Return the Locked token(s) to the Unlocked space(s). Remove all Click! Terror cards from the discard pile and shuffle them back into the Terror deck. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Every door slams. Nobody leaves.

items.name: .44 Magnum
items.effect: The .44 Magnum cannot modify the Weak Attack Action card.
items.flavour_unofficial: A huge revolver with a kick like a mule.

items.name: A List of Things in the...
items.effect: Immediately roll a die. 1-2: Garage 3-4: Closet 5-6: Attic (CM) 1-2: Supply Cage 3-4: Receiving Area 5-6: Manager's Office (MW) Reveal all of the Item cards in the associated Item deck, keeping their order the same. Then, discard this card.
items.flavour_unofficial: A scribbled note leading you to something in the house.

items.name: Bolt Cutters
items.effect: Ignore a Damage OR Unlock the Exit space you are on.
items.flavour_unofficial: Cut a lock or cut a chain. Either way, you're free.

items.name: Bowling Ball
items.effect: Discard during the Action phase while in a Rack space to deal 3 Damage to an Enemy in an adjacent space.
items.flavour_unofficial: Drop it from the racks and watch it land.

items.name: Chainsaw
items.effect: The Chainsaw may not be used to modify Reaction cards. When you use the Chainsaw, add the End Phase effect to the end of the Action card result.
items.flavour_unofficial: It roars to life and the whole floor hears it.

items.name: First Aid Kit
items.effect: Every time you use an Action card to recover health, recover an additional Health.
items.flavour_unofficial: Bandages, antiseptic and hope.

items.name: Forklift Keys
items.effect: You may now use the Forklift. The Forklift may move with you, but may not enter Search or Rack spaces. While with the Forklift, you may spend 1 Time to safely move a Victim from an adjacent Rack space to your space.
items.flavour_unofficial: Keys to the forklift. Time to move some heavy things.

items.name: Hard Hat
items.effect: Place a random Final Health token on this card. When you reveal your Final Health token, you may also reveal this one and choose ONE to resolve. This Item is not considered in your backpack, but the card may be kept there.
items.flavour_unofficial: A hard hat, which might save more than your head.

items.name: Knife
items.flavour_unofficial: A kitchen knife, a camping knife, any knife will do.

items.name: Megaphone
items.effect: Once per Action phase, you may move any Victim on the board 1 space. ↓ Killer (S1) or All Enemies (S3) target Final Girl > Move
items.flavour_unofficial: Bellow instructions and people actually move.

items.name: Odds and Ends
items.effect: You may place a Booby Trap token on your space (one per space) during the Action phase. If an Enemy enters a space with a Booby Trap, discard the token and the Enemy takes 2 Damage.
items.flavour_unofficial: A drawer of spare odds and ends, good for traps.

items.name: Plank
items.effect: Place the Plank token so it is touching two different Rack spaces. These spaces are now considered adjacent and Victims panicking from either space will always move to the other.
items.flavour_unofficial: A plank across the gap between racks.

items.name: Power Drill
items.effect: You may discard the Power Drill to Unlock the Exit space you are on.
items.flavour_unofficial: A cordless drill to take a lock apart.

items.name: Trashcan Lid
items.effect: Ignore a Damage.
items.flavour_unofficial: Dented, smelly and surprisingly good at stopping a blow.

items.name: Two-Way Radio
items.effect: Use to move a Victim one space at the cost of 1 Time. May not be used on the same Victim more than once in a single turn.
items.flavour_unofficial: Crackle, hiss, and a voice telling someone where to go.

items.name: Whip
items.effect: (SG) 0-1 (MW) If you damage an Enemy with the Whip, you may move them 1 space.
items.flavour_unofficial: Crack it and they jump.

terror_cards.name: Click!
terror_cards.effect: If any effect causes this card to be discarded, unlock the exit as described below but do not apply any other effects. (Named Location) is now Unlocked. ↓ Draw an Event card. (Exclusive to Loading Dock cards.) ↓ Draw the next Terror card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A lock clicks open somewhere in the warehouse.

terror_cards.name: "I think I saw the killer..."
terror_cards.effect: +1 Horror ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Someone saw a shape between the racks.

terror_cards.name: "Let's open some of these boxes!"
terror_cards.effect: You may roll a die for each unused Item card that was set aside during setup. -1 Time for each card you choose to roll for: 1-4: Do not reveal the Item. It remains out of the game. 5-6: Reveal and take the Item.
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Some of these boxes hold something useful. Some hold something else.

terror_cards.name: "The killer could be anywhere..."
terror_cards.effect: +1 Horror for each space between you and the Killer (max 3). Do not count your space or the Killer's space. ↓ Target Final Girl > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Every aisle could be the one.

terror_cards.name: "We'll be safer up there!"
terror_cards.effect: All Victims adjacent to Rack spaces panic. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Up on the racks, where it feels safer.

terror_cards.name: "Were they pushed?"
terror_cards.effect: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack ↓ All Victims in Rack spaces panic. If after panicking they are no longer in a Rack space, they fall to their death and are killed.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: They fell from the racks. Did they?

special_cards.name: Climb
special_cards.effect: [Results] 2 Successes: Move to an adjacent Rack space > -1 Time 1 Success: Move to an adjacent Rack space > -2 Time No Successes: -1 Health > Return this card to your hand
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: Grab, haul and pray the shelving holds.

special_cards.name: Leap
special_cards.effect: [Results] 2 Successes: Move directly to another Rack space > -1 Time 1 Success: Move directly to another Rack space > -2 Time No Successes: You MUST move 1 space > -2 Health
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: A running jump between racks, high above the floor.

locations.flavour_unofficial: A vast warehouse of racks, crates and locked doors, run by someone who loves a game.

locations.name: Utopia

setup_cards.name: Bouldering
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Scramble up onto the boulders, where the sand can't reach.

setup_cards.name: Monstrous Stench
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: A stench rolls in off the desert. Something big died, or is coming.

setup_cards.name: Sundown
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: The sun drops behind the canyon walls and the shadows stretch.

setup_cards.name: Trash Day
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Bins clattering in the street. Every clang an invitation.

setup_cards.name: Welcome to Utopia
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Welcome to Utopia. Mind your step.

events.name: Defiant Teenager
events.effect: Place the Teenager in the General Store. This kid is a showoff and during Upkeep moves 2 spaces towards the largest group of Victims. Other Victims will not follow you while the Teenager is in your space. If the Teenager leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A teenager who won't do what they're told, even now.

events.name: Dehydration
events.effect: At the end of the Planning phase, reset your time to 5 (or 4 for Extreme Horror mode) unless you end the phase with one or more time left over.
events.flavour_unofficial: The sun is merciless, and the water is running out.

events.name: Doomsday Planners
events.effect: Place one of the Doomsday Planners in the Bunker and the other in the General Store. While with a Doomsday Planner, you may roll +1 Die when resolving a Search at the General Store and you may roll +1 Die when resolving an attack at the Bunker. If the Doomsday Planners leave play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: They've been ready for the end of the world for years.

events.name: Earthquake!
events.effect: A sinkhole opens up! Roll to determine which space collapses: 1-3: Crossroads 4-6: Trailer Park Place a Sinkhole token in the collapsed space and apply the Sinkhole effects. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: The ground opens with a roar.

events.name: "Get on the roof!"
events.effect: If either the House or Water Tower space collapses, you and any Victims in the space do not take damage but still panic. If both spaces have collapsed, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Get on the roof! Off the ground, now!

events.name: Landslide!
events.effect: Place a Landslide token on the Mountain Pass. It is no longer considered an Exit space.
events.flavour_unofficial: Rocks thunder down and a way out is gone.

events.name: Maintenance Check
events.effect: Place two additional Victims at the Electrical Tower. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: The maintenance crew wander in, toolboxes rattling.

events.name: Stalkers
events.effect: When this Event is revealed, immediately shuffle the Sand Snake discard pile back into the deck. When drawing for Sand Snakes, resolve 3 Sand Snake cards, instead of 2. If all 3 cards would result in a Victim death, you may choose one to ignore.
events.flavour_unofficial: Something is following, just under the surface.

events.name: "We have to stick together!"
events.effect: 1 additional Victim may follow you.
events.flavour_unofficial: Stick together. It's the only chance.

events.name: "We need a plan!"
events.effect: Take the Planning Action card into your hand. If it is already in your hand, take an Improvise Action card instead. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Stop, think, plan. Quietly.

items.name: Bulldozer Keys
items.effect: Place the Bulldozer token in your space. The Bulldozer may move with you. While with the Bulldozer, you and all Victims in your space may ignore the effects of Sand Snakes.
items.flavour_unofficial: A bulldozer heavy enough to keep the worms at bay.

items.name: Canned Chili
items.effect: Ignore the effects of a Sand Snake attack in your space or an adjacent space for you and or any other Victims present.
items.flavour_unofficial: Canned chili that something underground can't stand.

items.name: Canteen
items.effect: Discard during the Action phase to choose one of the following: Discard the Dehydration Event OR +6 Time
items.flavour_unofficial: Water. In the desert, it's everything.

items.name: Crowbar
items.effect: Discard this card to add one success to a Search Action card.
items.flavour_unofficial: A crowbar for prying open doors and other things.

items.name: Elephant Gun
items.effect: May only be used with Critical Blow. If this card is revealed during setup, swap it with the faceup Item card at the Bunker.
items.flavour_unofficial: One huge round for one huge target.

items.name: First Aid Kit
items.effect: Every time you use an Action card to recover health, recover an additional Health.
items.flavour_unofficial: Bandages, antiseptic and hope.

items.name: Flare Gun
items.effect: May only be used with Weak Attack. If damage is dealt to the Killer, lose 1 Horror. Alternatively, may be used when outdoors to move all Victims that are outdoors one space closer to you. (Station 2891) Alternatively, discard a Tracking marker and all Victims within 3 spaces move one space closer to you. (Utopia)
items.flavour_unofficial: One flare, one shot, one chance to be seen.

items.name: Household Chemicals
items.effect: Discard during the Action phase and choose your space or an adjacent space. Then, roll a die and deal Damage equal to the result to everyone in the target space.
items.flavour_unofficial: Mix the right bottles and something will regret it.

items.name: Hub Cap
items.effect: Ignore a Damage OR discard all remaining uses to deal Damage to an Enemy in an adjacent space.
items.flavour_unofficial: A hubcap held up like a shield. It works.

items.name: Old Map
items.effect: You may play a Search Action card while adjacent to a Search space to immediately move to that space and resolve the Search Action card with +1 Die.
items.flavour_unofficial: An old prospector's map of the canyon.

items.name: Pickaxe
items.effect: You may add one success to an attack with the Pickaxe. If you do, discard the Pickaxe after resolving the attack.
items.flavour_unofficial: A pickaxe for rock and for anything under it.

items.name: Scoped Rifle
items.effect: May be used at a range of 4 while you are on a Boulder space.
items.flavour_unofficial: A scoped rifle for long shots from the boulders.

items.name: Seismometer
items.effect: Once during each Action phase, you may look at the top 2 cards of the Sand Snake deck. You are only attacked by the Sand Snakes if there are no other targets in your space.
items.flavour_unofficial: The needle twitches when something moves underground.

items.name: Six-Shooter
items.effect: May be used at a Range of 2 while you are on a Boulder space.
items.flavour_unofficial: A six-shooter, quick and loud.

items.name: Telescoping 10' Pole
items.effect: You may skip one space when moving from a Boulder space. No effects are triggered in the skipped space and no Victims may follow you when using this Item.
items.flavour_unofficial: A long pole for reaching the unreachable.

terror_cards.name: "All the sheep are dead!"
terror_cards.effect: +2 Horror ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The whole flock is gone, pulled under the sand.

terror_cards.name: "How many are there?"
terror_cards.effect: Sand Snakes attack doing 2 Damage to ONE TARGET in each space with 2 or more targets (including Enemies), using the following priority: Killer > Minion > You > Victim ↓ If no Victims were killed by the Sand Snakes +1 Bloodlust ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: How many are there? Too many.

terror_cards.name: "If we stay here we will starve!"
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on any of the Boulder spaces, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Panic all Victims on Boulder spaces. ↓ +1 Horror ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Stay put and starve, or go out and get eaten.

terror_cards.name: "Lots of ways to die out here."
terror_cards.effect: A Rattlesnake appears! You may play Action cards that inflict damage if you wish. Then, if the Rattlesnake is still alive: ↓ You take 2 Damage. You may defend as normal. ↓ If you take any damage, +1 Bloodlust. ↓ The Rattlesnake slithers away.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A rattle in the rocks, then a strike.

terror_cards.name: Sinkhole!
terror_cards.effect: The Crossroads collapses (if it hasn't already). ↓ Roll to see which other space collapses (reroll if it already collapsed): 1-2: Water Tower 3-4: House 5-6: Trailer Park ↓ Place a Sinkhole token in the collapsed space(s) and apply the Sinkhole effects.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The crossroads drops into the earth.

terror_cards.name: "These two have no idea what they just walked into."
terror_cards.effect: Roll a die and place 2 new Victims in the following space: 1-2: Scrap Yard 3-4: General Store 5-6: Sheep Farm ↓ +1 Horror ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Two strangers drive in, completely oblivious.

terror_cards.name: "Untimely encounter"
terror_cards.effect: Place the Killer in your space. ↓ Target Final Girl > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It surfaces right next to you.

locations.flavour_unofficial: A dusty canyon town where any sound brings death up through the sand.

locations.name: Shady Acres

setup_cards.name: Demands of the Earth
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: The earth wants feeding.

setup_cards.name: Dusk Sacrifice
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: A sacrifice made as the sun goes down.

setup_cards.name: Final Crop
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: The last crop of the year, and the darkest.

setup_cards.name: Harvest Season
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Everyone's in the fields for the harvest.

setup_cards.name: Reap What You Sow
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: What you sow in blood, you reap in blood.

events.name: Acres of Hatred
events.effect: For each Field space with at least 1 Victim, lose 1 Health (max 2). Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Hatred seeps up through the furrows.

events.name: Festering Rot
events.effect: Whenever a Victim is killed in a Field space, plus 1 Horror.
events.flavour_unofficial: Rot spreads wherever blood is spilled in the fields.

events.name: Harvest Cultist
events.effect: The closest Victim to you is now the Harvest Cultist. During the Upkeep phase, move the Harvest Cultist 1 space towards you and if they are in your space, you both move 1 space toward the Killer. If you save the Harvest Cultist, minus 2 Horror. If the Harvest Cultist leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A cultist who welcomes the harvest god.

events.name: It Hungers for Us
events.effect: All Victims panic. For each Victim in the Killer's space or an adjacent space, add 1 Horror (max 3). Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: It hungers for everyone, and everyone runs.

events.name: It Lurks Between the Rows
events.effect: Panic every Victim in a Field space. All Victims that panic into the Killer's space are killed. Discard this card.
