events.flavour_unofficial: Something moves between the rows.

events.name: Ralph the Mechanic
events.effect: Place Ralph in Ralph's Garage. While with Ralph, if you take any Items with limited uses, add an extra Tracking marker even though it will exceed the number of circular spaces. If Ralph leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Ralph the mechanic, oil-stained and useful.

events.name: Sally McCoy
events.effect: Place Sally in the McCoy Farmhouse. When Sally is saved, find the Combine Keys Item card. Reshuffle the Item deck(s) if necessary. If you already have the Combine Keys, gain 1 Time. If Sally McCoy leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Sally McCoy, who knows every inch of the farm.

events.name: "The fields are moving..."
events.effect: Place a Field token in both the Hayfield and Cow Pasture spaces. They are now considered Field spaces.
events.flavour_unofficial: The fields are moving, and the corn has eyes.

events.name: The Ravens Are Circling
events.effect: Each Child moves 2 spaces towards the Killer. Place Health markers on this card equal to the amount of Children in its space. When the Killer takes damage, remove the Health markers from this card. Discard this card when there are no Health markers on it.
events.flavour_unofficial: Ravens circle and the children follow them.

events.name: Umbral Evocation
events.effect: Place the Harvest Shadow token in the Killer's space. Each time you or a Victim enters that space, plus 1 Bloodlust.
events.flavour_unofficial: A shadow rises from the earth and spreads.

items.name: Bag of Feed
items.effect: Hop on a nearby cow! Discard to move up to 4 spaces.
items.flavour_unofficial: A bag of feed and a willing cow. Hold on tight.

items.name: Children's Toys
items.effect: Replace a Child in your space with a normal Victim.
items.flavour_unofficial: A rag doll or a wooden horse to calm a child, for now.

items.name: Combine Keys
items.effect: Place the Combine in your space. When moving with the Combine and resolving a Walk Action card, you may move an additional space. When moving into a Field space with the Combine, place a Harvested token in that space. It is no longer considered a Field space.
items.flavour_unofficial: A combine harvester and the keys to run it.

items.name: Corn Cob Pipe
items.effect: Discard for -3 Horror.
items.flavour_unofficial: A corn cob pipe and a slow, steadying breath.

items.name: Cornhusk Effigy
items.effect: Discard to remove an active Ancient Curse from the game.
items.flavour_unofficial: A corn-husk figure that wards off the old curses.

items.name: Cowboy Boots
items.effect: Use to move up to 2 spaces.
items.flavour_unofficial: Well-worn cowboy boots, made for running.

items.name: Decrepit Plow
items.flavour_unofficial: A rusted plough blade, heavy and cruel.

items.name: Farmer's Almanac
items.effect: After drawing a Terror card but before resolving it, you may place it on the bottom of the deck and draw the next Terror card.
items.flavour_unofficial: The almanac predicts what's coming, sometimes.

items.name: Locus of Insanity
items.effect: Once per turn, you may add 1 Horror to place yourself in any Field space.
items.flavour_unofficial: A strange object that warps your thoughts.

items.name: Mechanic's Toolbox
items.effect: Discard to take 1 discarded Item card back into your inventory, restoring all uses (if any).
items.flavour_unofficial: Everything a mechanic needs to fix something you broke.

items.name: Moonshine Jug
items.effect: Discard to recover 4 Health.
items.flavour_unofficial: A swig of moonshine and you're back on your feet.

items.name: Pilgrim's Hat
items.effect: You may move an additional space when starting your movement in a Field space.
items.flavour_unofficial: A pilgrim's hat for quick feet.

items.name: Pilgrim's Musket
items.effect: This weapon cannot be used to attack Enemies in a Field space.
items.flavour_unofficial: An ancient musket from the settlers.

items.name: Rusty Pitchfork
items.effect: If there are no successes in your final Horror Roll result, discard the Rusty Pitchfork.
items.flavour_unofficial: Rusty tines, still sharp enough.

items.name: Scythe
items.effect: When attacking Enemies in a Field space, you may distribute the damage between those Enemies. Then, place a Harvested token in that space. It is no longer a Field space.
items.flavour_unofficial: A scythe that cuts through the fields like they're nothing.

items.name: Sickle
items.flavour_unofficial: A hand sickle, just like his.

terror_cards.name: Chow Time
terror_cards.effect: Place 2 new Victims in the Old Barn and 2 new Victims in the Cow Pasture. ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The barn's dinner bell rings and people come running.

terror_cards.name: "It knows I'm here."
terror_cards.effect: The Killer treats all Field spaces as adjacent to each other. ↓ Target Final Girl > move > attack ↓ 1 Horror
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It knows you're here. It always knows.

terror_cards.name: Never Ending Rows
terror_cards.effect: The Killer treats all Field spaces as adjacent to each other. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > move > attack ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The rows go on forever, and so does he.

terror_cards.name: "Nobody knows where they take them..."
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims or Children on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Panic all Victims in the same space as a Child. ↓ For each Child with a Victim in their space, resolve Abduct action as if you had rolled a 1.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Nobody knows where the children take them.

terror_cards.name: Out of Gas
terror_cards.effect: Place 3 new Victims in the road space connected to the Hayfield. ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A car out of fuel on a lonely farm road.

terror_cards.name: "Something's wrong with the kids."
terror_cards.effect: The Children treat all Field spaces as adjacent to each other. ↓ Children only: Target Final Girl or Victim > move > Abduct ↓ 1 Horror
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The children are standing in the field, staring at the house.

terror_cards.name: "You belong to the fields now."
terror_cards.effect: If you are in a Field space, place the Killer in your space. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > move > attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: You belong to the fields now.

special_cards.name: Chthonic Possession
special_cards.effect: The Children have a Movement Value of 2.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: Something ancient lives inside the children.

special_cards.name: Dark Fields
special_cards.effect: Children treat Field spaces as adjacent to each other.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: The children cut through the corn as though it isn't there.

special_cards.name: Decaying Earth
special_cards.effect: Whenever you enter a Field space, lose 1 Health.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: The earth crumbles away under your feet.

special_cards.name: Gnarled Stalks
special_cards.effect: Lose 2 Time when moving into a Field space.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: Gnarled stalks grab at your legs.

special_cards.name: Malevolent Aura
special_cards.effect: Whenever you enter a space with one or more Children, 1 Horror.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: An aura of malice hangs around the children.

special_cards.name: Omen of Blood
special_cards.effect: Once per Killer phase, when the Killer kills a Victim, lose 1 Health.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: A sign in blood, and a price for every death.

special_cards.name: Omen of Death
special_cards.effect: Whenever the Killer kills a Victim, the Killer recovers 1 Health.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: A sign of death, and a debt that keeps growing.

special_cards.name: Omen of Plague
special_cards.effect: During the Upkeep phase, choose a space with 2 or more Victims and kill 1 Victim in that space.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: A plague spreads through the farm.

locations.flavour_unofficial: An old farm of endless corn, cursed soil and children who stare too long.

locations.name: L'Armes Abbey

setup_cards.name: Daily Chores
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: The sisters at their chores, unaware of what's below.

setup_cards.name: Reflection & Meditation
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Silent prayer in the cloister.

setup_cards.name: Sunday Mass
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Sunday Mass in the chapel, every pew full.

setup_cards.name: Supper Time
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Supper in the refectory, plates clattering.

setup_cards.name: Tourism Bus
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: A coachload of tourists pulls up to the abbey gates.

events.name: Black Mass
events.effect: During the Upkeep phase, add a Malice token if no Malice tokens were added this turn.
events.flavour_unofficial: Someone is holding a black mass in the crypt.

events.name: Breaking the Curse
events.effect: Take a Benediction Action card from the Action Tableau. If both are in your hand, decrease Horror level.
events.flavour_unofficial: A chance to break the curse, if the blessing holds.

events.name: Demonic Crocodile
events.effect: Place the Crocodile token in the Museum. It cannot be targeted or killed by Enemies, but you may attack and kill it. It has a Movement, Attack, and health value of 1. At the end of the Killer phase, resolve the following for the Crocodile: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack Then, panic all Victims in its space. If the Crocodile is killed, discard this card and the token.
events.flavour_unofficial: Something scaly in the moat, with demon eyes.

events.name: Father Damian
events.effect: Place Father Damian in the Sacristy. He will follow you into the Killer's space and can only be attacked if there are no other Victims in his space. While he is in your space, Blessed Die for all Horror Rolls and, once per Action phase, you may remove a Malice token in your space. If he is killed in your space, increase Horror by 3. If Father Damian leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Father Damian, here to drive it out.

events.name: Leap of Faith
events.effect: Look through the unused Item cards and take 1.
events.flavour_unofficial: A leap of faith, and something waiting to catch you.

events.name: Maddening Nursery Rhyme
events.effect: In the space with the most Victims, a Victim is killed and every other Victim in that space panics. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A nursery rhyme that won't stop and drives people mad.

events.name: Pilgrimage
events.effect: Place 2 Victims in the Hospitium, 2 Victims in the Refectory, and 2 Victims in the Sanctuary. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Pilgrims arrive, eager and devout.

events.name: Sins of the Past
events.effect: Roll 3 dice. If the result is 6-6-6, you are the Devil's child and immediately lose. For any other result, place the Repentance token in the Sanctuary. While the token is on the board, you must ignore all Blessed Die effects. The Repentance token can be removed by going to the Sanctuary and spending 3 Time.
events.flavour_unofficial: Old sins come back to haunt the abbey.

events.name: The Abbess
events.effect: Place the Abbess in the Abbess' Office. During Upkeep, move the Abbess one space towards the closest normal Victim not in the Dormitory. Any normal Victims in the Abbess' starting and ending space move 2 spaces toward the Dormitory.
events.flavour_unofficial: The Abbess, who has kept this secret too long.

events.name: The Quebecer
events.effect: Place the Quebecer in the Dormitory. Normal Victims in the Quebecer's space will not follow you unless he is coming as well. While with the Quebecer, an additional Victim may follow you. If he is in your space during the Upkeep phase, lose 1 Time per Victim in your space.
events.flavour_unofficial: A visitor from Quebec with questions.

items.name: Aspergillum
items.effect: If you have Holy Water in your other hand, you may use one of its remaining uses to deal an additional Damage.
items.flavour_unofficial: A holy water sprinkler, a priest's weapon.

items.name: Crucifix
items.effect: Discard to ignore any Horror level increase or to end an Enemy's movement when they're in an adjacent space.
items.flavour_unofficial: Silver and faith, held out at arm's length.

items.name: Holy Bible
items.effect: +1 Blessed Die when resolving the Benediction or Expel Demon Action cards.
items.flavour_unofficial: A Bible to steady your voice.

items.name: Holy Chalice
items.effect: Discard during the Action phase for 3 Health or OR discard when your black Final Health token is revealed. If it is blank, you come back with 1 Health instead.
items.flavour_unofficial: A chalice of blessed wine.

items.name: Holy Water
items.effect: Blessed Die for a Horror Roll OR remove a Malice token in your space. If you have the Aspergillum in your other hand, also remove a Malice token in an additional space.
items.flavour_unofficial: Blessed water, burning to the damned.

items.name: Knife
items.flavour_unofficial: A kitchen knife, a camping knife, any knife will do.

items.name: Padlock Key
items.effect: The Donkey may move with you. While moving with the Donkey, roll a die. * 1-3: Move 1 less space (min. of 1) * 4-6: Move 1 extra space Once per Action phase, while in a space with the Donkey and an Enemy, roll a die. On a 5-6, the Enemy is dealt 2 Damage. Discard to ignore any Horror level increase OR to end an Enemy's movement when they're in an adjacent space.
items.flavour_unofficial: The key to the stable, and a donkey to ride.

items.name: Rosary
items.effect: Spend 2 Time during the Killer phase to ignore a Horror level increase.
items.flavour_unofficial: Beads for prayer, worn smooth.

items.name: St Constantine's Shield
items.effect: Ignore up to 2 Damage.
items.flavour_unofficial: The shield of a saint, still holy.

items.name: St. Joan's Armor
items.effect: Blessed Die when resolving Reaction cards.
items.flavour_unofficial: The armour of a saint, still unbroken.

items.name: St. Longinus' Spear
items.effect: Blessed Die when resolving Action cards that perform attacks. If you damage an Enemy with the Spear, you may move them 1 space.
items.flavour_unofficial: The spear that pierced divinity.

items.name: St. Lucy's Eyes
items.effect: Blessed Die when resolving Action cards that allow you to take Item cards. Draw and keep 1 additional Item card.
items.flavour_unofficial: The eyes of a saint, seeing truly.

items.name: St. Martin's Cloak
items.effect: Blessed Die when resolving Action cards that provide movement.
items.flavour_unofficial: The cloak of a saint, shared with the needy.

items.name: St. Paul's Chains
items.effect: Blessed Die when resolving Action cards that perform attacks. You may discard when you damage an Enemy to place the Chain token in their space. The next time the Enemy resolves an attack, ignore it and discard the Chain token instead.
items.flavour_unofficial: The chains of a saint, which held firm.

items.name: St. Peter's Sword
items.effect: Blessed Die when resolving Action cards that perform attacks. The Sword may not be used to modify Reaction cards.
items.flavour_unofficial: The sword of a saint, still sharp.

items.name: Thurible
items.effect: If used at range 1, discard this card.
items.flavour_unofficial: A swinging thurible of smoke and fire.

terror_cards.name: Envy
terror_cards.effect: The closest Victim to you in a space with a Malice token is killed. If you're in a space with a Malice token, you take 2 Damage. You may defend as normal. ↓ Until the next Killer phase, use a Cursed Die when resolving Action cards that perform attacks. ↓ Event ↓ 2 Malice tokens
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Envy takes hold of someone, and they turn.

terror_cards.name: Gluttony
terror_cards.effect: The closest Victim to you in a space with a Malice token is killed. If you're in a space with a Malice token, you take 2 Damage. You may defend as normal. ↓ If you have 7 or more Action cards in your hand, randomly discard 2. ↓ Event ↓ 1 Horror and 1 Malice token
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Gluttony takes hold of someone, and they turn.

terror_cards.name: Greed
terror_cards.effect: The closest Victim to you in a space with a Malice token is killed. If you're in a space with a Malice token, you take 2 Damage. You may defend as normal. ↓ Until the next Killer phase, use a Cursed Die when resolving Action cards that allow you to take items. ↓ Killer: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack ↓ 2 Malice tokens
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Greed takes hold of someone, and they turn.

terror_cards.name: Lust
terror_cards.effect: The closest Victim to you in a space with a Malice token is killed. If you're in a space with a Malice token, you take 2 Damage. You may defend as normal. ↓ A Victim in your space is killed. ↓ Event ↓ 1 Horror and 1 Malice tokens
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Lust takes hold of someone, and they turn.

terror_cards.name: Pride
terror_cards.effect: The closest Victim to you in a space with a Malice token is killed. If you're in a space with a Malice token, you take 2 Damage. You may defend as normal. ↓ If you have more than 1 Item card, randomly discard 1 Item card. ↓ Event ↓ 1 Horror and 1 Malice token
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Pride takes hold of someone, and they turn.

terror_cards.name: Sloth
terror_cards.effect: The closest Victim to you in a space with a Malice token is killed. If you're in a space with a Malice token, you take 2 Damage. You may defend as normal. ↓ Until the next Killer phase, use a Cursed Die when resolving Action cards that provide movement. ↓ Killer targets Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack ↓ 2 Malice tokens
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Sloth takes hold of someone, and they turn.

terror_cards.name: Witch's Totem
terror_cards.effect: Place 2 Victims at the Entry Hall. ↓ Target a Victim > Move x2 > Attack x2 ↓ 2 Malice tokens
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A totem made from bones and hair.

terror_cards.name: Wrath
terror_cards.effect: The closest Victim to you in a space with a Malice token is killed. If you're in a space with a Malice token, you take 2 Damage. You may defend as normal. ↓ Until the next Terror card is drawn, use a Cursed Die when resolving Reaction cards. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack ↓ 2 Malice tokens
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Wrath takes hold of someone, and they turn.

locations.flavour_unofficial: A remote abbey of relics and prayers, with a fallen angel nesting beneath.

locations.name: Buddyland

setup_cards.name: Buddy Day
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Buddy Day, and the place is heaving with kids.

setup_cards.name: Birthday Bash
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: A birthday party in the party room, balloons and all.

setup_cards.name: Hide and Seek
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Hide and seek, and some of the hiders won't be found.

setup_cards.name: Pizza Party
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Pizza for everyone, and the band starts up.

setup_cards.name: Playin' Hooky
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Kids bunking off school, sneaking in the back.

events.name: Birthday Girl
events.effect: Place the Birthday Girl in the Party Room. If the Birthday Girl is alone during the Panic phase she panics. If you save the Birthday Girl, gain +4 Time. If the Birthday Girl is killed, +1 Bloodlust. If the Birthday Girl leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: The birthday girl, crown on, and no idea.

events.name: Broken Machine
events.effect: If there are any Victims in Arcade spaces, Enemies will move towards the closest Victim in an Arcade space when targeting 'Final Girl or Victim' or 'Victim'. Discard this card when a Victim in an Arcade space in killed.
events.flavour_unofficial: An arcade machine sparking and smoking.

events.name: Buddy Up
events.effect: When saving Victims, you must save 2 or more at a time. You may ignore this effect for an entire Action phase by discarding an Improvise or Distraction action card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Buddy up. Nobody goes alone.

events.name: Hidden Prizes
events.effect: Discard all faceup Item cards from the Item decks. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Prizes hidden all over the restaurant.

events.name: Nick the Janitor
events.effect: Place Nick in the Janitor's Closet. He can follow you into the Killer's space. When Nick enters a space with an Enemy, he deals 2 Damage to the Enemy. Then remove Nick from the board and during the next Upkeep phase place him back in the Janitor's Closet. If Nick is killed, +2 Bloodlust. If Nick leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Nick the janitor, who's seen things on the night shift.

events.name: Party Time
events.effect: Move all Victims one space closer to the Party Room. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Party time! Everyone to the stage!

events.name: Pizza Delivery
events.effect: The Victim closest to the Entrance is now the Pizza Guy. While the Pizza Guy is in your space, you may roll +2 Dice when resolving a Search Action card. If the Pizza Guy is killed, all Victims in his space and adjacent spaces immediately panic. If the Pizza Guy leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A pizza delivery driver walks in at the worst moment.

events.name: Playtime Shenanigans
events.effect: Place 2 new Victims in the Ball Pit and 2 new Victims in the Jungle Gym. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Kids running wild in the ball pit.

events.name: Sing-A-Long
events.effect: During each Upkeep, +1 Horror. Discard this card when the Horror Level reaches the Red area.
events.flavour_unofficial: A sing-along that won't stop, louder every round.

events.name: Tragic Collapse
events.effect: Roll a die and place the Broken token in the: 1-2: Jungle Gym 3-4: Kitchen 5-6: Bathroom Everyone currently in or later entering that space takes 1 Damage.
events.flavour_unofficial: Something comes crashing down.

items.name: Arcade Token
items.effect: Discard while in an Arcade space to spend 3 Time for -3 Horror.
items.flavour_unofficial: One more go on the arcade, for luck.

items.name: Bag of Marbles
items.effect: Spend 1 Time to place a Marbles token in an adjacent space without one. If anyone enters a space with a Marbles token, discard it an they lose 1 Helath.
items.flavour_unofficial: Marbles scattered across the tiles, perfect for tripping things up.

items.name: Birthday Cake
items.effect: You may use this to ignore +1 Horror during the Killer phase.
items.flavour_unofficial: Frosting, candles and a moment of normal.

items.name: Chain
items.effect: You may discard when you damage an Enemy to place the Chain token in their space. Until the Chain token is removed, that Enemy cannot move or attack. Remove the Chain token at the end of the Killer phase.
items.flavour_unofficial: A heavy chain from the storeroom.

items.name: Claw Machine Token
items.effect: Discard while in an Arcade space to look through the unused Item cards and take one of your choice.
items.flavour_unofficial: One shot at the claw machine. Win something useful.

items.name: Energy Drink
items.effect: Discard this during the Action phase and choose one of the following: +5 Time OR Move up to 2 spaces
items.flavour_unofficial: Sugar, caffeine and a burst of very bad decisions.

items.name: Extension Cord
items.effect: If you are in or adjacent to an Arcade space, you may attack any Arcade space regardless of range.
items.flavour_unofficial: A long orange cord and a bad idea about electricity.

items.name: Fire Axe
items.effect: When attacking a Minion, 2 Damage instead.
items.flavour_unofficial: The emergency axe, finally in an emergency.

items.name: Flash Camera
items.effect: Use when an Enemy would move into your space to instead make it stop in an adjacent space.
items.flavour_unofficial: One flash in the dark and they freeze.

items.name: Food Tray
items.effect: Ignore a Damage.
items.flavour_unofficial: A plastic tray that takes a hit better than you'd think.

items.name: Janitor's Mop
items.effect: Once per Action phase, you may spend 2 Time while alone in a space for -1 Horror.
items.flavour_unofficial: The janitor's mop, wet floor and all.

items.name: Leftover Pizza
items.effect: Use during the Action phase to choose one: -1 Horror OR +2 Health
items.flavour_unofficial: Cold, a bit chewy, still pizza.

items.name: Pinball Machine Token
items.effect: Discard while in an Arcade space for +1 Die when resolving Action cards for the rest of the Action phase.
items.flavour_unofficial: Tilt the pinball machine and see what drops out.

items.name: Security Badge
items.effect: Take the Planning Action card when you take the Item. Victims in your space never panic.
items.flavour_unofficial: A badge that opens the staff-only doors.

items.name: Security Bot
items.effect: Place the Bot token in your space. When you gain movement effects, you may use them to move the Bot instead. Up to 2 Victims may follow the Bot and Victims in a Exit space with the Bot can be saved.
items.flavour_unofficial: A little security robot that's on your side, for once.

items.name: Skee-Ball Token
items.effect: Do not place the 4 Tracking markers (aka Skee-Balls) on this card until you are in a Arcade space. +1 Die when attacking with a Skee-Ball.
items.flavour_unofficial: Skee-ball tickets, worth more than they look.

terror_cards.name: Earthquake!
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The floor heaves, the arcade cabinets topple and the dark comes in.

terror_cards.name: "How'd they sneak in?"
terror_cards.effect: Roll 3 dice and place one Victim for each die result as follows: 1-2: Jungle Gym 3-4: Dining Area 5-6: Party Room ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Nobody saw them come in. Everyone saw them come out.

terror_cards.name: Hungry for Blood
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims in the Kitchen, Party Room, or Dining Area, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Place the Killer in the Kitchen, Party Room, or Dining Area, whichever has the most Victims. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack Twice
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The kitchen smells of pepperoni and something metallic.

terror_cards.name: "It's play time!"
terror_cards.effect: Roll a die and apply the following result: 1-3: Place the Killer with the closest target. 4-6: Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack ↓ Repeat the above effect 5 more times. You may reduce the number of times by 1 for each Action card you discard from your hand, but you must decide all at once before repeating the effect.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It's playtime, and you're the toy.

terror_cards.name: No Time for Games
terror_cards.effect: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move ↓ Roll a die and apply the following result: 1: +1 Horror OR -1 Health: then roll again. 2: +1 Horror OR -1 Health. 3-4: +2 Horror 5: All Enemies: Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack 6: No effect.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The fun is over. He's serious now.

terror_cards.name: Panic at the Disco
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Strobe lights, a thumping beat and a stampede for the doors.

terror_cards.name: Solitary Danger
terror_cards.effect: Target Final Girl > Move Twice > Attack ↓ If the Killer is not in the same space as you, the Killer recovered 2 Health.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: You're alone in the dark with him, and that's the problem.

terror_cards.name: "They want her!"
terror_cards.effect: Panic all Victims in your space. ↓ Move all Enemies one space towards you. ↓ +1 Horror for each Enemy in your space. ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: They want her, and they'll go through anyone to get her.

locations.flavour_unofficial: A neon pizza parlour and arcade where the animatronic band never stops performing.

locations.name: Pesadilla Verde

setup_cards.name: Cave Dwellers
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Shelter in the caves, where it's dark and close.

setup_cards.name: High Ground
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Up on the ridge, where you can see it coming. Maybe.

setup_cards.name: Jungle Madness
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: The heat gets into people's heads.

setup_cards.name: Rebel Yell
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: The rebels are shouting and the jungle is listening.

setup_cards.name: River Rats
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Down by the river, wading through the shallows.

events.name: Archeologist
events.effect: Roll a die and place the Archeologist at that space. 1-2: Ancient Ruins 3-4: Rebel Camp 5-6: Supply Depot Roll 1 fewer die when searching at a space with the Archeologist unless you pat 3 Time. Resolve this card again during each Upkeep phase. If the Archeologist leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: An archaeologist digging for something better left buried.

events.name: Cursed Temple (Event)
events.effect: Place the Cursed token at the Cursed Temple. Whenever you enter the Cursed Temple, lose 3 Health. Then, discard the token. Discard this card once the Cursed token is discarded.
events.flavour_unofficial: The old temple stirs, and the curse wakes with it.

events.name: "Get to the Choppa!"
events.effect: If the Huey token is not on the board, place it in the Clearing. For each Victim saved with the Huey, choose one of the following: * Gain 2 Health * Gain 3 Time * Lower Horror level by 1 * Take an Action card (max 2 Time cost) Discard this card when the Huey token is removed from the board.
events.flavour_unofficial: A helicopter is coming. Get to it.

events.name: Heavy Rains
events.effect: Unless you are moving from a River space, it costs 2 Time to enter a River space.
events.flavour_unofficial: The rain falls in sheets and the rivers rise.

events.name: "Piranhas!"
events.effect: Roll a die and place the Piranhas! token in: * 1-2: Lower River * 3-4: Central River * 5-6: Upper River Everyone in the space loses 1 Health. Whenever anyone enters that space, they lose 1 Health.
events.flavour_unofficial: The water boils with teeth.

events.name: Rebel Leader
events.effect: Place the Rebel Leader at the Rebel Camp. During the Upkeep phase, move the Rebel Leader one space closer to the nearest Victim who is NOT at the Rebel Camp. Then, move 1 Victim in their space to the Rebel Camp. Soldiers at the Rebel Camp cannot be ordered to take Actions. The Rebel Leader will not follow you. If the Rebel Leader leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: The rebel commander, who has his own plans.

events.name: Rebel Raiding Party
events.effect: Roll a die to choose which space is targeted: * 1-3: Ancient Ruins * 4-6: Supply Depot Take all Items at that space, shuffle them facedown, and place them at the bottom of the Rebel Camp Item deck. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A rebel raiding party sweeps through.

events.name: Sgt. Weathers
events.effect: Place Sgt. Weathers in the space with the most Victims. He is considered a Soldier. When ordered, Sgt. Weathers and any Victims with him can move 1 additional space and add +1 to their attack range. If Sgt. Weathers is killed, increase Horror level by 2. If Sgt. Weathers leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A hard-bitten sergeant who has seen too much.

events.name: Supply Drop
events.effect: Take 3 random Item cards that were not used and place each of them faceup next to the Supply Depot's Item deck. When successfully searching there, you may choose one of the faceup cards instead of drawing from the deck. Discard this card when all 3 additional Item cards are no longer next to the Item deck.
events.flavour_unofficial: Crates drop from the sky.

events.name: Twitchy Soldiers
events.effect: If you have Unlocked the "No Friendly Fire Upgrade, immediately Lock it. When rolling for friendly fire, Soldiers are killed on a result of 1-3. Discard this card if the "No Friendly Fire" Upgrade is Unlocked.
events.flavour_unofficial: The soldiers are jumpy and their fingers are on the triggers.

items.name: Axe
items.flavour_unofficial: The camp's woodpile tool, repurposed.

items.name: Backpack Radio
items.effect: Discard this card and spend 3 Time to either: Move ALL Soldiers up to 2 spaces OR Call in an airstrike! Choose a space and roll a die: 1-2: Lose 1 Health to everyone in your chosen space and each adjacent space 3-6: Lose 4 Health to everyone in your chosen space
items.flavour_unofficial: A field radio for calling in help.

items.name: Booby Trap
items.effect: Spend 3 Time to place the Booby Trap token in your space. If an Enemy enters the space where it is located, discard the token and this card and the Enemy takes 3 Damage.
items.flavour_unofficial: A tripwire and a nasty surprise.

items.name: Bowie Knife
items.flavour_unofficial: A big knife for a big jungle.

items.name: Cigar
items.effect: Roll a +1 Die when resolving a Train Action card. The Cigar comes with three tokens.
items.flavour_unofficial: A fat cigar for steady nerves.

items.name: Compound Bow
items.effect: The Compound Bow cannot modify an Action card and must be used without one. It costs 2 Time to fire an arrow. The Compound Bow comes with three tokens. The Compound Bow can be combined with the Grenade for extra damage.
items.flavour_unofficial: A compound bow for silent shots.

items.name: Cursed Idol
items.effect: If the Cursed Idol is faceup anywhere, you may no longer resolve Search Action cards. When entering the Search space with the Cursed Idol, or if revealed while searching, you must take it. It may only be discarded while at the Cursed Temple.
items.flavour_unofficial: A cursed idol from the temple. Put it down.

items.name: First Aid Kit
items.effect: Every time you use an Action card to recover health, recover an additional Health.
items.flavour_unofficial: Bandages, antiseptic and hope.

items.name: Grenade
items.effect: Sunnydaze Mall: Discard during the Action phase and spend 2 Time to deal 2 Damage to an Enemy in an adjacent space OR to add a Destroyed Wall token to a wall of the store you are currently in. Pesadilla Verde: When in hand, discard during the Action phase and spend 2 Time to deal 2 Damage to an Enemy in an adjacent space. When in your backpack, discard while using the Compound Bow to add 2 Damage to the attack.
items.flavour_unofficial: Pull the pin and count to three.

items.name: M16
items.effect: Damage: The M16 adds 2 Damage at a range of 1 and adds 1 Damage at a range of 2.
items.flavour_unofficial: A standard-issue rifle with plenty of punch.

items.name: Mini-Gun
items.effect: Damage: When attacking, deal an additional Damage for each Star in our final Horror Roll result. When moving, move 1 less space (minimum of 1 space). The Mini-Gun cannot be placed in your backpack. The Mini-Gun comes with two tokens.
items.flavour_unofficial: A heavy rotary gun that chews through the trees.

items.name: MRE's
items.effect: Advance all cubes on the Soldier card 1 space to the right. MRE's come with two tokens.
items.flavour_unofficial: Ration packs that keep the soldiers going.

items.name: Mysterious Pills
items.effect: Discard this during the Action phase and choose one of the following: Decrease Horror by 1 or Restore Health by 2
items.flavour_unofficial: Unlabelled pills from an unlocked cabinet. What could go wrong?

items.name: River Mud
items.effect: When resolving Target Final Girl or Target Final Girl or Victim, roll a die. On a 5-6, you cannot be the target. When entering a River space, place a Tracking marker below. When every space is filled, discard this card.
items.flavour_unofficial: Cover yourself in mud and it can't see you.

items.name: Walkie-Talkies
items.effect: Soldiers may more 1 additional space when moving,
items.flavour_unofficial: Walkie-talkies to coordinate the soldiers.

items.name: Wet Suit
items.effect: You may move upriver, but Victims cannot follow you. You are no longer affected by the Flash Flood Terror card, the Heavy Rains Event card, or the "Piranhas!" Event card.
items.flavour_unofficial: A wet suit for swimming against the current.

minor_dark_powers.name: Rivermaster
minor_dark_powers.effect: The Killer may now move upriver. The Killer is no longer affected by the Flash Flood Terror Card and the "Piranhas!" Event card. Extend the Killer's health by 2 points.
minor_dark_powers.flavour_unofficial: It moves through the water like it was born there.

terror_cards.name: Rivermaster
terror_cards.effect: The Killer may now move upriver. The Killer is no longer affected by the Flash Flood Terror Card and the "Piranhas!" Event card. Extend the Killer's health by 2 points.
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It moves through the water like it was born there.

terror_cards.name: Cave Collapse
terror_cards.effect: Everyone at the Cave loses 1 Health. Then, panic everyone still at the Cave. ↓ Place the Collapsed token at the Cave. The Cave is no longer considered a Exit space. ↓ Event ↓ Increase Horror level by 1.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The cave roof comes down.

terror_cards.name: Cursed Sacrifice
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Move all Victims 1 space closer to the Cursed Temple. ↓ Kill all Victims at the Cursed Temple. ↓ If no Victims died, kill the 2 closest Victims to the Cursed Temple.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A sacrifice at the cursed temple.

terror_cards.name: Flash Flood
terror_cards.effect: Event ↓ Everyone at the Waterfall, Upper River, and Central River are moved down the river one space. ↓ Everyone at the Lower River loses 2 Health.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A wall of water comes over the falls.

terror_cards.name: The Green Nightmare
terror_cards.effect: If this is the final Terror card in the deck, discard it with no effect. Otherwise: ↓ Choose one of the following: * Increase Horror level by 3 * Increase Horror level by 1. Then, reshuffle this card back into the Terror deck.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The jungle itself turns against you.

terror_cards.name: "I saw the jungle move! Open fire!"
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Roll a die for each space with 2 or more Victims. On a result of 1-3, kill one of the Victims in that space. ↓ Event
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Somebody saw the jungle move, and everyone opens fire.

terror_cards.name: Jungle Heat
terror_cards.effect: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move x2 ↓ Panic all Victims adjacent to the Killer's space. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack x2 ↓ Event
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The heat is unbearable and so is the hunter.

terror_cards.name: Low Morale
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Lock an Upgrade. ↓ Target Victim > Move x2 > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The soldiers are losing heart.

special_cards.name: Booby Trap
special_cards.effect: Spend 3 Time to place the Booby Trap token in your space. If an Enemy enters the space where it is located, discard the token and this card and the Enemy takes 3 Damage.
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: A tripwire and a nasty surprise.

locations.flavour_unofficial: A steaming jungle of rivers, ruins and rebel camps, with a hunter in the canopy.

locations.name: Isla Lagarto

events.name: Herbal Remedies
events.effect: Beneficial event (exact effect not reported).
events.flavour_unofficial: Leaves and roots that soothe wounds.

events.name: The Game Makers
events.effect: Harmful event (exact effect not reported).
events.flavour_unofficial: The organisers have a twist for you.

events.name: Supply Drop
events.effect: Gain an item if near a beach or cliff.
events.flavour_unofficial: Supplies parachute onto the beach.

events.name: Fierce Competitors
events.effect: Lose Time each time a victim is saved.
events.flavour_unofficial: The other contestants are just as desperate as you.

items.name: Tranquilizer Gun
items.effect: Can be used at any time to stop the Killer.
items.flavour_unofficial: One dart puts anything down for a while.

items.name: Safari Rifle
items.effect: Ranged damage.
items.flavour_unofficial: A big-game rifle for big game.

items.name: Throwing Axe
items.effect: Ranged damage.
items.flavour_unofficial: One flick of the wrist and it's across the tent.

items.name: Shotgun
items.effect: Strong against minions and strong attacks.
items.flavour_unofficial: Two barrels and a lot of noise.

items.name: Bush Plane
items.effect: When a victim is saved at the Airstrip, save one extra victim anywhere.
items.flavour_unofficial: A small plane on the airstrip and a way out for someone.

items.name: Goat
items.effect: Bait.
items.flavour_unofficial: A goat on a rope. The raptors will love it.

items.name: Rover
items.effect: Helps escape and rescue.
items.flavour_unofficial: A rugged off-road vehicle.

items.name: Net
items.effect: Negates a second Killer attack.
items.flavour_unofficial: A heavy net to tangle something with claws.

items.name: Electric Fence Codes
items.effect: Engage or disengage a fence.
items.flavour_unofficial: The codes to the electric fences.

items.name: Enhanced Goggles
items.effect: Always move 1 space regardless of the roll.
items.flavour_unofficial: Night-vision goggles with a few extra tricks.

locations.notes: Spaces include the Airstrip, Dino Pen, cliffs, beaches, exits and the Volcano. Electric fences (A/B/C) toggle via the fence die; Setup card shows which fences start active. Volcano erupts on the first volcano symbol then spreads lava.

terror_cards.name: Brontosaurus Stampede
terror_cards.effect: Devastating to anyone near the Airstrip.
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The ground shakes as the giants run.

locations.flavour_unofficial: A prehistoric island turned into a game show, with fences, a volcano and very hungry locals.

locations.name: MegaBGCon

setup_cards.name: Busiest Day
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: The busiest day of the con, shoulder to shoulder.

setup_cards.name: Family Day
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Families with prams and children everywhere.

setup_cards.name: First Day
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: The doors open on day one.

setup_cards.name: Last Day
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: The last day, and everyone's exhausted.

setup_cards.name: Mega Events
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: The big events are about to start.

events.name: Annoying Reporter
events.effect: Place the Annoying Reporter in your space. She MUST follow you when you move and you lose 1 action if she is in your space at the end of the Action phase. In order to save her, discard the Weak Attack Action card while in an escape space. If the Annoying Reporter leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A reporter who keeps getting in your face.

events.name: Food Trucks Are Here!
events.effect: You may save Victims from the Side Hallway even if you are not in their space. When one or more Victims are saved without your presence, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: The food trucks are here, and so is everyone else.

events.name: Industry Bad Boy
events.effect: Reveal a Booth card and place the Bad Boy in that space. Immediately choose him to be your Friend or Enemy. Friend is saved: Minus two Horror. Enemy is saved: Regain one Heart. Friend is Killed: Plus two Horror. Enemy is Killed: Do NOT increase Bloodlust. If the Bad Boy leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A designer with a reputation, and a crowd around him.

events.name: Lunch Time!
events.effect: Put two Tracking markers on this card. During the next two Action phases, Victims will follow you out of booth spaces. Remove a tracking marker at the end of the Action phase. Discard this card when there are no Tracking markers on it.
events.flavour_unofficial: Lunch time, and the queues are endless.

events.name: Media Starlet
events.effect: Reveal a Booth card and place the Media Starlet in that space. The Media Starlet will not follow you under ANY circumstances. If you save the Media Starlet, you may look through the unused Item cards and choose one to take. If the Media Starlet leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: An influencer with a camera crew.

events.name: Nervous Attendees
events.effect: Add one die to your Horror Rolls when resolving the Create a Panic Action card.
events.flavour_unofficial: The attendees are nervous, and so are you.

events.name: Popular Game Designer
events.effect: Reveal a Booth card and place the Game Designer in that space. While in the same space with the Game Designer, you may re-roll a die of your choice once per Action phase. If the Game Designer is killed, plus one Bloodlust. If the Game Designer leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A beloved designer signing games.

events.name: Stampede
events.effect: Panic all Victims in the Main and Side Hallways but only move them if they move into a booth space. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Something spooks the crowd and they stampede.

events.name: SWAG Roulette
events.effect: Reveal 3 Booth cards and place a Victim in each space along with a facedown SWAG token under each Victim. The token followsthe Victim and if the Victim is saved, flip the token and receive the benefit. If the Victim is killed, discard the token without looking at it. Discard when all Victims with SWAG tokens have been removed from play.
events.flavour_unofficial: Free swag at random booths.

events.name: Ticketed Events
events.effect: Place 2 new Victims in the Event Hall. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Ticketed events in the main hall.

events.name: Cosplay Conundrum
events.effect: Move all Victims one space closer to the Killer. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A cosplay that's a little too convincing.

events.name: Free Promo Card!
events.effect: Move all Victims from adjacent spaces into the Booth space. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Free promo cards, and a crowd at the booth.

events.name: Mega Sale!
events.effect: Place the Mega Sale token in the Booth space. You may roll an additional die when searching in this space.
events.flavour_unofficial: Everything at the booth is half price.

events.name: New Hotness
events.effect: Place 2 new Victims in the Booth space. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: The newest game on the block, and everyone wants a look.

events.name: Shady Practices
events.effect: Place the Killer in the Booth space. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Something shady is going on at that booth.

events.name: Shoulder to Shoulder
events.effect: Place the Crowd token in the Booth space. While you are in this space, you must roll one fewer die (minimum of 1) when resolving Action cards.
events.flavour_unofficial: The booth is packed shoulder to shoulder.

events.name: Sold Out!
events.effect: Panic all Victims in the Booth space. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: It's sold out, and people are not happy.

events.name: Star Sighting
events.effect: If there are no Special Victims in play, reveal Event cards until you find one with a Special Victim and resolve it. Then shuffle the revealed cards back into the Event deck. Take the Special Victim closest to the Booth and place it in the Booth space. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A celebrity spotted at the booth.

events.name: Tragic Accident
events.effect: Kill one Victim in the Booth space. If no Victim is in the space, increase Bloodlust by 1 instead. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A display collapses at the booth.

events.name: Wet Floor
events.effect: Place the Wet Floor token in the Booth space. When you move to this space you must end your movement there.
events.flavour_unofficial: Someone has spilled a drink at the booth.

items.name: Box Cutter (x2)
items.flavour_unofficial: A box cutter from the vendor tables.

items.name: Cash Money (x2)
items.effect: Use to take a Search Action card into your hand (from anywhere).
items.flavour_unofficial: Cold, hard cash.

items.name: Convention Beer
items.effect: Use to roll one additional die for all Horror Rolls for the rest of the Action phase. Discard this Item and all cards in your hand at the end of the Action phase.
items.flavour_unofficial: An overpriced convention beer.

items.name: Convention Program
items.effect: You may look at the top card of the Booth and/or Booth Event deck at any time.
items.flavour_unofficial: The programme lists what's happening next.

items.name: Convention Staff Badge
items.effect: Victims will follow you when leaving a Booth space.
items.flavour_unofficial: A staff badge that people will follow.

items.name: Coupon Book
items.effect: Roll an additional die when resolving the Search Action card in a booth space.
items.flavour_unofficial: A book of coupons for the vendor hall.

items.name: Deodorant
items.effect: Choose a Victim in your space and panic that Victim. You may re-roll once, keeping the new result.
items.flavour_unofficial: A can of deodorant. You'll be popular.

items.name: Energy Drink (MegaBGCon)
items.effect: Discard to skip the next Killer phase.
items.flavour_unofficial: A canned energy drink from the convention stand.

items.name: Folding Chair
items.effect: If used at range 1, discard this card.
items.flavour_unofficial: A folding chair, the classic weapon.

items.name: Food
items.effect: Roll a die and recover half that many Health (rounded up).
items.flavour_unofficial: Convention food. It's something.

items.name: Giant Board Game
items.flavour_unofficial: A giant board game, heavy enough to hurt.

items.name: Hammer
items.effect: Roll an additional die when resolving the Create a Panic Action card.
items.flavour_unofficial: A hammer from the booth build.

items.name: LARP Shield
items.effect: Use if taking 2 or more Damage to reduce it by 1.
items.flavour_unofficial: A foam shield from the LARP area. It actually helps.

items.name: Magic Potion
items.effect: Discard and roll a die: 1-2: Minus three Horror. 3-4: Take any Action card 5: Reveal your Ultimate Ability 6: One additional die for the rest of the game
items.flavour_unofficial: A potion from a fantasy booth. Who knows what it does?

items.name: Medical Buggy Keys
items.effect: Place the Medical Buggy miniature in your space; it may move with you. When moving with the Medical Buggy into a space, you must panic all Victims except the ones following you. When moving into an Enemy's space, you may discard this to deal 2 Damage to that Enemy.
items.flavour_unofficial: The keys to the medical buggy.

items.name: Van Ryder Games Bag
items.effect: Immediately discard this and take the top 2 Item cards from any Item deck.
items.flavour_unofficial: A branded tote bag full of goodies.

terror_cards.name: "A Lot Going On Today!"
terror_cards.effect: Draw an Event card. ↓ If there is 1 or fewer Events* in play, increase Horror by 2. ↓ If there are 2 or more Events* in play, resolve another Terror card. *Do not include Booth Events.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: There's a lot happening today.

terror_cards.name: Angry Customers
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims in any Booth spaces, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Reveal a Booth card until you reveal a Booth with 1 or more Victims in that space. ↓ ONE target on that space is attacked using the following target priority: You -> Minion -> Killer The target receives damage equal to the number of Victims in that space. ↓ If no one was attacked, increase Horror by 2.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Customers at the booths are getting angry.

terror_cards.name: Deadly Encounter
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack ↓ Target Victim > Move
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: A deadly encounter in the crowd.

terror_cards.name: Killer Choices
terror_cards.effect: Target Final Girl > Move ↓ Target Victim > Move ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The killer makes a choice.

terror_cards.name: "No One Is Safe!"
terror_cards.effect: Reveal a Booth card and place the Killer in that space. ↓ Target Final Girl or Victim > Attack ↓ Repeat the above effects two more times. ↓ If no one was attacked, increase Bloodlust by 2.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: No one is safe at the con.

terror_cards.name: Organized Theft
terror_cards.effect: Remove the top card from each Item deck. ↓ For each card removed apply the following effect based on the facing of the card: Faceup: Lose 1 Time. Facedown: Increase Horror level by 1. ↓ Draw an Event card
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Someone has been stealing from the vendors.

terror_cards.name: "Someone Is Following Me!"
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Panic all Victims in or adjacent to the Killer's space. ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Someone is following you through the crowd.

terror_cards.name: "What's The Commotion?"
terror_cards.effect: Target Final Girl or Victim > Move > Attack ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Something is happening across the hall.

special_cards.name: Create a Panic
special_cards.effect: [Results] 2 Successes: Panic each Victim in your space in the direction of your choice. > -1 Time 1 Success: Panic each Victim in your space. You may modify each Panic roll result by 1. > -1 Time No Successes: Panic each Victim in your space. > -1 Time
special_cards.flavour_unofficial: You start a panic on purpose.

locations.flavour_unofficial: A huge board game convention: crowded halls, booths, cosplay and a killer in the crowd.

locations.name: Santa's Village

setup_cards.name: Back With Lumber
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: The elves are back from the woods with lumber.

setup_cards.name: Gather Round
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Everyone gathers round for the story.

setup_cards.name: Reindeer Games
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: The reindeer are playing games in the snow.

setup_cards.name: Story Time
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Story time in the village centre.

setup_cards.name: Toys! Toys! Toys!
setup_cards.flavour_unofficial: Toys, toys, toys, piled up everywhere.

events.name: Blizzard
events.effect: Place a Blizzard token in each space adjacent to the Village Center. During each Upkeep phase, move each Blizzard token one space clockwise in the spaces surrounding the Village Center. You may not move INTO a space with a Blizzard token.
events.flavour_unofficial: A blizzard sweeps through the village.

events.name: Busy! Busy! Busy!
events.effect: Draw two Event cards. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: There's so much to do before Christmas.

events.name: Caroling
events.effect: If you end the Action phase in a space with 3 or more Victims, -2 Horror and discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: Carolers in the square lift everyone's spirits.

events.name: Christmas Eve
events.effect: During Upkeep, roll a die and remove the top Item card from the game of the following Search space: 1-2: Santa's House 3-4: Santa's Workshop 5-6: Stables
events.flavour_unofficial: Christmas Eve, and the shelves are emptying.

events.name: "Coming in for a landing!"
events.effect: Place 2 new Victims at the Runway and 2 new Victims at the Stables. Then, if Santa is in play, place him at the Runway. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A sleigh comes in for a landing on the runway.

events.name: Head Elf
events.effect: Place the Head Elf in Santa's Workshop. While the Head Elf is with you, once per turn you may resolve a Search Action card as though it was in your hand. If the Head Elf is killed, +1 Bloodlust. If the Head Elf leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: The head elf, who knows the workshop inside out.

events.name: "It's Santa!"
events.effect: Place Santa in Santa's House. While Santa is with you, there is no limit to the number of Victims that will follow you. Santa can only be attacked if there are no other Victims in his space. If Santa is killed, +2 Bloodlust and +2 Horror. If Santa leaves play, discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: It's Santa! He's home.

events.name: Northern Lights
events.effect: You may roll an additional die when resolving a Distraction Action card. You must roll one fewer die (to a minimum of one) when resolving a Focus Action card.
events.flavour_unofficial: The northern lights fill the sky.

events.name: Tree Lighting Ceremony
events.effect: Move all Victims one space closer to the Village Center. Discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: The tree-lighting ceremony in the square.

events.name: Yeti
events.effect: Place the Yeti in the Exit space of your choice. The Yeti will not follow you and cannot be targeted, saved, or killed. During Upkeep, panic the Yeti. The Yeti will do 2 Damage to someone in the space according to the following priority: Killer > Minion > You > Victim When there are no other Victims on the board, remove the Yeti from the board and discard this card.
events.flavour_unofficial: A yeti comes down from the mountains.

items.name: BB Gun
items.effect: The BB Gun may only modify the Weak Attack Action card. When you damage the Killer with the BB Gun, -1 Horror.
items.flavour_unofficial: A BB gun from the toy shelves.

items.name: Candy
items.effect: Discard during the Action phase to make a Horror roll with 5 dice. For each Success, choose one of the following: 2 Health 2 Time Move 1 space
items.flavour_unofficial: Sweets from a gingerbread house. Probably fine.

items.name: Comet
items.effect: Place Comet in your space. Comet can move with you. Once each Action phase while with Comet, you and Comet may move directly to the Runway. Victims cannot follow you when using this effect.
items.flavour_unofficial: Comet the reindeer, ready to fly.

items.name: Ice Skate
items.flavour_unofficial: An ice skate with a sharp blade.

items.name: Milk and Cookies
items.effect: Discard during the Action phase to recover all Health.
items.flavour_unofficial: Milk and cookies, left out for Santa.

items.name: Misfit Toys
items.effect: Place a Misfit Toy token in each Exit space. During Upkeep, move each Misfit Toy one space closer to the Killer. When a Misfit Toy shares the same space as an Enemy, discard the token and deal 1 Damage to that Enemy.
items.flavour_unofficial: Broken toys that still want to play.

items.name: Pepper Spray
items.effect: If the Killer is in your space, you may discard this to immediately end the Killer phase. Ignore their remaining movement, attacks, and any other effects.
items.flavour_unofficial: Right in the eyes, then run.

items.name: Red Wagon
items.effect: One additional Victim may follow you.
items.flavour_unofficial: A red wagon for pulling someone along.

items.name: Santa's Sack
items.effect: Discard Santa's Sack to look at all the Item cards set aside during setup and take one of your choice.
items.flavour_unofficial: Santa's sack, full of surprises.

items.name: Slingshot
items.effect: The Slingshot may only modify the Weak Attack Action card.
items.flavour_unofficial: A forked stick and a pocketful of stones.

items.name: Snowballs
items.effect: When this card is revealed, immediately take it (no Search Action required). You may discard the Snowballs when adjacent to the Killer to take a Distraction Action card.
items.flavour_unofficial: Snowballs, packed hard.

items.name: Tree Star
items.effect: If the Tree Star is used from range 1, do one extra Damage and discard the Tree Star.
items.flavour_unofficial: The star from the top of the tree. Throw it.

items.name: Whistle
items.effect: Spend 1 Time to use the Whistle once per Action phase. When used, all Enemies and Victims will move 1 space towards you.
items.flavour_unofficial: Loud enough to gather the campers, and everything else.

items.name: Woodcutter's Axe
items.flavour_unofficial: A woodcutter's axe from the workshop.

items.name: Workshop Hammer
items.effect: You only lose 1 Time when entering a space with Victims no matter how many are in the space.
items.flavour_unofficial: A workshop hammer for building toys, or not.

terror_cards.name: Elf Hunt
terror_cards.effect: If there are no Victims on the board, discard and draw the next Terror card. Otherwise: ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack ↓ Target Victim > Move > Attack
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Krampus is hunting elves through the village.

terror_cards.name: "Fire!"
terror_cards.effect: Roll a die to determine which space bursts into flames: 1-2: Cabins (CHT) Santa's House (SV) 3-4: Utility Shed (CHT) Santa's Workshop (SV) 5-6: Dock (CHT) Stables (SV) ↓ All Victims in that space are killed. Discard all Item cards from that space. If you or an Enemy are there, you each lose 1 Health.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Smoke on the horizon and flames between the cabins.

terror_cards.name: Prayer Vigil
terror_cards.effect: Place 3 new Victims in the Village Center. ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The elves gather in the square to pray for Santa.

terror_cards.name: Public Execution
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: An elf is dragged to the square for punishment.

terror_cards.name: "Santa, where are you?"
terror_cards.effect: +1 Horror ↓ Target Final Girl > Move > Attack ↓ If you were not attacked, +1 Horror.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Santa, where are you? The elves are calling.

terror_cards.name: "Something is happening..."
terror_cards.effect: +1 Horror ↓ Draw an Event card.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: Something strange is happening in the village.

terror_cards.name: The Elves Are Fighting Back!
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: The elves grab hammers and fight back.

terror_cards.name: "Where did it go?"
terror_cards.effect: Place this card face up on top of the Terror deck and place the Killer on this card. ↓ Draw an Event card. ↓ At the start of the next Killer Phase, place the Killer in your space and remove this card from the game.
terror_cards.effect_notation: Text before '↓' resolves first; text after '↓' is the killer action
terror_cards.flavour_unofficial: It was here, and now it's gone.

locations.flavour_unofficial: The North Pole village, all lights, workshops and very chatty elves.

final_girls.name: Alice Cranston
final_girls.ultimate_ability: Choose one named Action card. For the remainder of the game, whenever you play that named Action card, always roll exactly 5 dice regardless of the Horror level or any other modifiers.

unlockable_item.name: Alice's Shotgun
unlockable_item.effect: Range: 0 Damage: *1 Hands: 2 Alice's Shotgun cannot modify an Action card and must be used without one. Once per turn, you may discard 1 card from your hand and roll 6 Dice. Deal 1 damage to each enemy in your space for each Success rolled. If at least half of the dice are blank, discard Alice's Shotgun. Only Alice may use this Item.
unlockable_item.flavour_unofficial: Her shotgun, loaded with something extra for spirits.

final_girls.save_rewards_text: Alice has 4 Health, and requires 6 Victims to be saved before she can use her Ultimate Ability. Saving each victim lets her choose a benefit from her card, shown on the left. Any additional victims saved heal her by 1.
final_girls.flavour_unofficial: A sharp, sceptical medium who isn't scared of ghosts any more.

final_girls.name: Adelaide Jordan
final_girls.ultimate_ability: Choose one of the following immediate effects: * Decrease one type of Wrath to 1 * Recover all health * Take up to 6 cost worth of Action cards into your hand

unlockable_item.name: Adelaide's Bat & Shield
unlockable_item.effect: Range: 0 Damage: 2 Hands: 2 Whenever you roll at least 1 Success with the Guard Reaction card, do 1 Damage to the Enemy that attacked you. Only Adelaide may use this Item.
unlockable_item.flavour_unofficial: A bat in one hand, a shield in the other, ready for a god.

final_girls.save_rewards_text: Adelaide has 6 Health, and requires 5 Victims to be saved before she can use her Ultimate Ability. Saving each victim lets her choose a benefit from her card, shown on the left. Any additional victims saved decrease the horror by 1.
final_girls.flavour_unofficial: A tough, practical woman who adapts on the fly.

final_girls.name: Barbara Romero
final_girls.ultimate_ability: Victims will move into the Killer's space with you. When you damage an Enemy in your space, you may do an additional damage for each Victim present. For each additional damage done, a Victim is killed. Do NOT increase Bloodlust for Victims killed in this way.

unlockable_item.name: Barbara's Rifle
unlockable_item.effect: Range: 1-4 Damage: 1 Hands: 2 Uses: 4 Barbara's Rifle can only modify the Weak Attack Action card. Only Barbara may use this Item.
unlockable_item.flavour_unofficial: Her hunting rifle, which has never missed a deer.

final_girls.save_rewards_text: Barbara has 7 Health, and requires 5 Victims to be saved before she can use her Ultimate Ability. Saving each victim lets her choose a benefit from her card, shown on the left. Any additional victims saved increase her Time by 1
final_girls.flavour_unofficial: Fearless, and she brings everyone with her into the fight.

final_girls.name: Ava Tyler
final_girls.ultimate_ability: When making a Horror Roll, you may reroll all 1 results.

unlockable_item.name: Ava's Nail Bat and Porcupine
unlockable_item.effect: Range: 0 Damage: 2 Hands: 2 Discard this to ignore all Damage and deal 2 Damage to every Enemy in your space. Only Ava can use this Item.
unlockable_item.flavour_unofficial: Homemade nail bat and spiked shield, built in a panic.

final_girls.save_rewards_text: Ava has 5 Health, and requires 5 Victims to be saved before she can use her Ultimate Ability. Saving each victim lets her choose a benefit from her card, shown on the left. Any additional victims saved reduce Horror by 1.
final_girls.flavour_unofficial: A survivor who keeps her head when the fear rises.

final_girls.name: Chantelle "Red" Gilliam
final_girls.ultimate_ability: Once per Action phase, if an Enemy is within 2 spaces of you, you may move 1 space for free.

unlockable_item.name: Red's Crossbow
unlockable_item.effect: Range: 1-3 Damage: 1 Hands: 2 Uses: 5 The Crossbow cannot modify an Action card and must be used without one. It costs 2 Time to fire an arrow. Only Red may use this Item.
unlockable_item.flavour_unofficial: Grandma's old crossbow, kept loaded by the door.

final_girls.save_rewards_text: Red has 5 Health, and requires 6 Victims to be saved in order to use her Ultimate Ability. Saving a Victim lets her take one of the following benefits: * +1 Time * Take any top Item card * +2 Time * Take an Action card (max 2 Time) * +1 Health * Move up to 2 spaces. Any additional Victims saved heal Red by 2.
final_girls.flavour_unofficial: A girl in a red hood with a crossbow and a grudge.

final_girls.name: Agnes Crane

unlockable_item.name: Agnes' Magnum
unlockable_item.effect: Range: 1-2 Damage: 2 Hands: 1 Uses: 3 For every 2 Damage (rounded down) dealt while using Agnes' Magnum, -1 Horror. Only Agnes may use this Item.
unlockable_item.flavour_unofficial: A heavy Magnum and a heavier grudge.

final_girls.flavour_unofficial: A hard-bitten survivor with a big revolver.

final_girls.name: Carolyn Johnson

unlockable_item.name: Mr. Floppy (Attuned)
unlockable_item.effect: Hands: 1 You may resolve the Psychic Attack Action card at ranges 0-2. You may discard Mr. Floppy to remove the Dark Power from the game. Only Carolyn may use this Item.
unlockable_item.flavour_unofficial: Her old stuffed rabbit, now humming with the house's power.

final_girls.flavour_unofficial: The girl from Creech Manor, grown up and done being afraid.

final_girls.name: Alois
final_girls.ultimate_ability: Roll 6 Dice for Horror Rolls, regardless of the Horror level.

unlockable_item.name: Alois's Mini-Gun
unlockable_item.effect: Range: 0-1 Damage: * (When attacking, deal and additional damage for each star in your final Horror Roll result.) Hands: 2 Uses: 2 When moving, move 1 less space (minimum of 1 space). Alois's Mini-Gun cannot be placed in your backpack. Before determining your final Horror Roll result, you may reroll 1s and 2s once. Only Alois may use this Item.
unlockable_item.flavour_unofficial: A mini-gun she carries like a handbag.

final_girls.save_rewards_text: Alois has 5 health and needs to save 5 victims to unlock her Ultimate ability. Saving each victim costs health: # -1 Health # -1 Health # -2 Health # -2 Health # -3 Health Each additional victim will +1 Health.
final_girls.flavour_unofficial: A soldier who never lets fear win.

final_girls.name: Laurie Carpenter
final_girls.ultimate_ability: Whenever you are in the same space as an Enemy and inflict damage, do an additional damage.

unlockable_item.name: Laurie's Bow
unlockable_item.effect: Range: 1-3 Damage: 1 Hands: 2 Uses: 3 Laurie's Bow cannot modify an Action card and must be used without one. It costs 1 Time to fire an arrow. Only Laurie may use this item
unlockable_item.flavour_unofficial: Her own bow, strung and tuned just right.

final_girls.save_rewards_text: Laurie has 5 Health, and requires 6 Victims to be saved before she can use her Ultimate Ability. Saving each victim lets her choose a benefit from her card, shown on the left. Any additional victims saved increase her Time by 1.
final_girls.flavour_unofficial: A camp counsellor who never backs down.

final_girls.name: Reiko Rivers
final_girls.ultimate_ability: Once per Action phase if an Enemy is within 2 spaces, you may move to that Enemy's space for free.

unlockable_item.name: Reiko's Axe
unlockable_item.effect: Range: 0 Damage: 2 Hands: 2 You may roll an additional die when resolving the Weak Attack action card. Only Reiko may use this item.
unlockable_item.flavour_unofficial: Her axe, and her nerve.

final_girls.save_rewards_text: Reiko has 6 Health, and requires 5 Victims to be saved before she can use her Ultimate Ability. Saving each Victim lets her choose a benefit from her card, shown on the left. Any additional Victims saved increase her Time by 1.
final_girls.flavour_unofficial: A quick-thinking camper who knows when to strike.

final_girls.name: Selena Villanueva
final_girls.ultimate_ability: When resolving a Search Action card, roll 2 additional dice.

unlockable_item.name: Selena's Flashlight
unlockable_item.effect: Once per Action phase, you may look at the top card of the Terror deck. Leave it on top or place it on the bottom of the deck. You may discard this card while on a Search space to take the top Item card. Only Selena may use this Item.
unlockable_item.flavour_unofficial: Her torch, which always finds what she needs.

final_girls.save_rewards_text: Selena has 6 Health, and requires 4 Victims to be saved before she can use her Ultimate Ability. Saving each victim lets her choose a benefit from her card, shown on the left. Any additional victims saved increase her Time by 2.
final_girls.flavour_unofficial: A calm presence who knows where to look.

final_girls.name: Eihi Asami
final_girls.ultimate_ability: Whenever you draw at least one Item card, draw an extra card and choose one. You are immune to Item Trap cards.

unlockable_item.name: Asami's Knife Belt
unlockable_item.effect: Range: 0-1 Damage: 1 Hands: 1 When using Asami's Knife Belt, you may divide the damage as you choose between any Enemies within range. Only Asami may use this Item.
unlockable_item.flavour_unofficial: Her belt of throwing knives.

final_girls.save_rewards_text: Asami has 5 Health, and requires 4 Victims to be saved before she can use her Ultimate Ability. Saving each victim lets her choose a benefit from her card, shown on the left. Any additional victims saved heal her by 1.
final_girls.flavour_unofficial: A knife-thrower from the carnival who never misses.

final_girls.name: Charlie Aja
final_girls.ultimate_ability: During the Action phase, you may lose 3 health to take the Critical Blow Action card directly into your hand.

unlockable_item.name: Charlie's Giant Hammer
unlockable_item.effect: Range: 0 Damage: 3 Hands: 2 You must have 2 or more Health to attack with this weapon. After resolving an attack with this weapon: -1 Health > End Turn Only Charlie may use this Item.
unlockable_item.flavour_unofficial: A giant hammer, swung like it weighs nothing.

final_girls.save_rewards_text: Charlie has 7 Health, and requires 6 Victims to be saved before she can use her Ultimate Ability. Saving each victim lets her choose a benefit from her card, shown on the left. Any additional victims saved increase time by 1.
final_girls.flavour_unofficial: The carnival strongwoman, lifting things you wouldn't believe.

final_girls.name: Nancy Lang
final_girls.ultimate_ability: Each time you lose normal health, you may reveal a black Final Health token from the general pool and swap it with your black Final Health token if you wish. If you do not, remove it from the game. You cannot do this with a white Final Health token.

unlockable_item.name: Nancy's Machetes
unlockable_item.effect: Range: 0 Damage: 3 Hands: 2 Victims will not follow you. Each time you enter the Killer's space, +1 Bloodlust. Only Nancy may use this Item.
unlockable_item.flavour_unofficial: Twin machetes, and she knows how to use them.
